publicationDetails.detailsText: CEPOS (Center for Political Studies) Research Paper No. 2026/01
publicationDetails.journalName: CEPOS (Center for Political Studies) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the productivity in Danish primary and lower secondary schools, comparing both private and public schools for the school year 2023/2024. The analysis is conducted at a school level using the Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) method. In the main model (model 1), the input variables are salary expenses and a socioeconomic reference (expected grade point average on school-level based on pupils’ individual socioeconomic background), where the purpose of the socioeconomic reference is to ensure comparability between schools. The output variables are the actual grade point average, the share of pupils receiving special education in a normal classroom and the share of pupils receiving special education in a separate special class. The main model shows an average input-oriented score of 0.72, meaning that salary costs could be reduced by 28% if all schools matched the productivity of the most efficient peers. The average output-oriented score was 1.11, which translates into that pupil performance could increase by 0.8 grade points (on a scale from -3 to +12). Additionally, private schools demonstrate significantly higher productivity than public schools. A second-stage Tobit regression model identifies key factors influencing productivity, revealing that school size, employee composition and pupil well-being/parent satisfaction are significantly correlated with school productivity.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用DEA方法分析2023/2024学年丹麦中小学（公立与私立）的生产效率，发现私立学校效率显著更高，若所有学校达到最优效率水平，薪资成本可降28%或学生成绩可提0.8分。学校规模、员工构成及学生福祉/家长满意度是影响效率的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 丹麦公立与私立中小学的生产效率如何？哪些因素影响学校的生产效率？
AI.motivation: 教育资源配置的效率对公共财政和学生学习成果至关重要，理解不同所有制学校（公立vs私立）的生产效率差异，以及影响效率的关键因素，可为教育政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产效率理论；数据包络分析（DEA）方法；Tobit回归模型
AI.method: 采用数据包络分析（DEA）在学校层面进行效率测算，分别计算投入导向和产出导向的效率得分；第二阶段使用Tobit回归模型分析影响生产效率的关键因素。
AI.findings: （1）投入导向平均效率得分0.72，意味着若所有学校达到最优效率水平，薪资成本可降低28%；（2）产出导向平均效率得分1.11，对应学生成绩可提升0.8分（-3至+12分制）；（3）私立学校生产效率显著高于公立学校；（4）学校规模、员工构成、学生福祉/家长满意度与生产效率显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将DEA方法系统应用于丹麦中小学教育生产效率的比较分析，为教育生产效率研究提供了跨国实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为丹麦教育政策制定者提供了关于学校效率优化的量化参考，揭示了通过降低薪资成本或提升学生成绩实现效率改进的空间，并指出学校规模、人员配置及学生福祉等可干预因素。

title: How Inflation Cycles Shaped 20th Century Stock Returns:  A Study in Four Charts May 29, 2026
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: How Inflation Cycles Shaped 20th Century Stock Returns:  A Study in Four Charts May 29, 2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: In the 20th century three inflation cycles determined the variations in stock returns. Rising inflation expanded earnings-to-price ratios, reducing returns, and declining inflation depressed them, increasing returns. The 21st century has not experienced an inflation cycle equal to the length or depth of any of the 20th century cycles, but is still experiencing a surge in returns. These outsize returns have been caused by the sharp rise in the profit share of corporate output, the compression of earnings-to price ratios and latterly by a massive increase in the money supply and the artificial intelligence boom.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了20世纪三次通胀周期对股票回报的影响，以及21世纪虽无同等长度或深度的通胀周期，但股票回报仍大幅上升的原因，主要归因于利润份额上升、盈利价格比压缩、货币供应量激增以及人工智能热潮。
AI.research_question: 通胀周期如何影响股票回报？21世纪缺乏深度通胀周期的情况下，股票回报为何仍大幅上升？
AI.motivation: 解释20世纪通胀周期与股票回报的关系，并阐明21世纪在缺乏类似通胀周期条件下股票回报仍持续攀升的驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通胀周期理论、盈利价格比（E/P）与股票回报关系、利润份额理论、货币供给与资产价格关系。
AI.method: 历史比较分析，对20世纪三次通胀周期与21世纪市场数据进行对比。
AI.findings: 20世纪通胀上升扩大盈利价格比、降低回报，通胀下降则相反；21世纪虽无长深度通胀周期，但利润份额上升、盈利价格比压缩、货币供给激增和人工智能热潮驱动了回报飙升。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了通胀与股票回报关系的跨世纪比较视角，识别了21世纪替代通胀的新驱动因素（利润份额、货币供给、AI）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解不同通胀环境下股票回报的驱动机制提供参考，提示关注利润结构、货币政策和技术变革对市场的影响。

title: Second Opinions and the Return Option: Disclosure and Commitment in Credence Goods Markets
affiliations: Catholic University of Milan and Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore

detail.title: Second Opinions and the Return Option: Disclosure and Commitment in Credence Goods Markets
detail.abstract: We study second opinions in credence goods markets when consumers can disclose a prior recommendation. Standard models impose a no-going-back rule, implying that second opinions are sought in secrecy. Yet, in practice, especially in health care, prior visits are often disclosed. First, we develop a model in which, after receiving a second opinion, the consumer returns to the initial expert with an exogenously given probability. We show that when this probability exceeds a threshold, disclosure is incentive compatible, as it induces truthful recommendations by the second expert, which in turn alters the first expert's incentives in a non-trivial way. We then make the return probability endogenous in a doctor-patient setting, introducing a strategic commitment problem through the choice of distance, and show that if the cost of returning to the first doctor is not too high, the patient chooses a sufficiently distant second doctor, incurring travel costs that act as a commitment device to sustain a positive probability of return, making both disclosure and return incentive compatible in equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文研究信用品市场中消费者可以披露先前推荐意见的情况下寻求第二意见的策略。模型发现，当返回第一专家的概率超过某个阈值时，披露是激励相容的，可以诱导第二专家提供真实推荐，并改变第一专家的激励。在医患场景中，患者会选择距离足够远的第二位医生，通过旅行成本作为承诺机制来维持一定概率的返回，使披露和返回在均衡中均激励相容。
AI.research_question: 在信用品市场中，当消费者可以披露第一专家的推荐意见时，寻求第二意见如何影响专家之间的激励和均衡结果？
AI.motivation: 标准信用品模型假设"不返回规则"，即消费者寻求第二意见时不披露先前信息。但在医疗等实践中，患者常会告知医生之前的诊断意见。现有理论忽略了这一重要现实特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用品市场理论、激励相容理论、承诺机制理论、博弈论
AI.method: 理论建模，先假设外生返回概率，再内生化返回概率（通过距离选择）建立博弈模型
AI.findings: (1) 当返回第一专家的概率超过阈值时，披露是激励相容的，可使第二专家说真话，并倒逼第一专家改变激励；(2) 在医患场景中，若返回成本不太高，患者会选择足够远的第二位医生，旅行成本作为承诺机制维持返回概率，使披露和返回在均衡中均成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 打破了信用品市场标准模型中的"不返回规则"假设，在理论上证明了披露先前推荐意见在特定条件下可以改善专家激励，丰富了信用品市场的委托代理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗等信用品市场中患者寻求第二意见的行为提供策略指导，揭示了距离选择作为承诺工具的价值，对医疗政策设计和患者决策具有启示意义。

title: Inflation, Central Bank Reaction, and Equity Trading Volumes: Closing the Missing Link Through Knightian Uncertainty in Monetary Policy

detail.title: Inflation, Central Bank Reaction, and Equity Trading Volumes: Closing the Missing Link Through Knightian Uncertainty in Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a unified theoretical framework connecting goods-market inflation to equity trading volumes through the central bank reaction function. The literature has long established two separate facts: trading volume and return volatility co-move with information arrival, generating leptokurtosis in asset returns (Clark, 1973; Epps and Epps, 1976; Tauchen and Pitts, 1983; Karpoff, 1987); and Knightian uncertainty-the absence of assignable probabilities-induces investor paralysis and collapses trading volume (Dow and Werlang, 1992). The theoretical bridge between goods-market inflation and these market-microstructure outcomes has, however, remained largely unspecified. We argue that this bridge runs through monetary policy: elevated or volatile inflation destabilises the central bank's reaction function, generating ambiguity-rather than mere quantifiable risk-over the future path of interest rates. Drawing on the event-study methodology of Bernanke and Kuttner (2005), which shows that unexpected Federal Reserve policy changes exert a quantitatively significant effect on equity prices and excess return expectations, we contend that it is the unpredictability of policy under high inflation that constitutes the Knightian dimension of monetary uncertainty. We formalise this chain through three layers: parameter uncertainty about the Taylor-rule coefficients, model uncertainty about the inflation regime, and preference uncertainty about the central bank's mandate trade-off. Each layer widens the set of priors held by rational investors in the sense of Dow and Werlang (1992), ultimately suppressing trading activity. The paper closes with an empirical strategy exploiting CPI announcement windows during the 2021-2023 Federal Reserve hiking cycle as a natural experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个统一理论框架，将商品市场通胀与股票交易量通过央行反应函数联系起来。通胀上升或不稳定会模糊央行政策路径，产生奈特不确定性，导致投资者瘫痪并压低交易量。论文利用2021-2023年美联储加息周期的CPI公告窗口作为自然实验进行实证检验。
AI.research_question: 商品市场通胀如何通过央行货币政策反应函数影响股票市场交易量？具体而言，通胀如何通过产生奈特不确定性来抑制交易活动？
AI.motivation: 已有文献分别建立了交易量与信息到达（Clark等）以及奈特不确定性导致投资者瘫痪（Dow & Werlang）的关系，但商品市场通胀与这些市场微观结构结果之间的理论桥梁尚未被阐明。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 混合分布假说（Clark, 1973; Epps & Epps, 1976等）——交易量与波动性随信息到达共动；2) 奈特不确定性理论（Dow & Werlang, 1992）——不可分配概率的不确定性导致投资者行动瘫痪；3) 泰勒规则与央行反应函数；4) Bernanke & Kuttner (2005)事件研究法——意外货币政策变化对股价有显著影响。
AI.method: 理论构建三层形式化模型：泰勒规则参数不确定性、通胀体制模型不确定性、央行使命权衡偏好不确定性。实证策略：以2021-2023年美联储加息周期中的CPI公告窗口作为自然实验。
AI.findings: 通胀上升或波动增大使央行反应函数不稳定，产生对利率路径的奈特不确定性（而非可量化的风险），通过三层不确定性（参数、模型、偏好）拓宽理性投资者的先验集合，最终抑制交易活动。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将商品市场通胀与股市交易量通过央行反应函数中的奈特不确定性建立统一理论桥梁，将宏观经济学中的货币政策不确定性与金融微观结构中的交易量行为联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解高通胀时期股市交易量萎缩提供理论解释；为政策制定者提供通胀影响金融市场功能的新视角；实证策略可推广至其他央行周期。

title: Gold and the External Wealth of Nations
affiliations: , European Central Bank (ECB) and

detail.title: Gold and the External Wealth of Nations

publicationDetails.journalName: Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We analyse the portfolio-reallocation incentives faced by NIIP-surplus economies under cross-border seizure risk. Assets, such as gold, can be physically imported and held domestically in contrast to financial claims on other jurisdictions. Gold purchases not only reduce the NIIP but can also drive steep increases in gold prices. We review the history of gold as an international settlement asset, the evolution of financial sanctions, and the global distribution of NIIP and gold holdings. We calibrate a simple model to recent gold mining cost curves and show that (assuming a current account balance of zero) closing one trillion dollars of NIIP per year through newly mined gold could push prices above USD 8,500 per ounce, while a ten-trillion-dollar target could be consistent with USD 67,000 per ounce. In an extended model, NIIP surplus countries face a trade-off between rapid NIIP reduction, with subsequent valuation losses, versus gradual adjustment, which tempers price impacts but lengthens the period of exposure to cross-border seizure risks. We also model the case of an elastic supply from mobilization of existing private holdings in the rest of the world via a simple portfolio reallocation channel.

AI.tldr: 本文分析在跨境扣押风险下，净国际投资头寸（NIIP）盈余经济体面临的资产组合再平衡激励。研究发现，黄金购入虽然能降低NIIP，但会显著推高金价。模型测算显示，若通过新开采黄金每年减少1万亿美元NIIP，金价可能升至8500美元/盎司以上；若目标为10万亿美元，金价可达67000美元/盎司。盈余国家面临快速调整（伴随估值损失）与渐进调整（延长风险暴露期）之间的权衡。
AI.research_question: 在跨境扣押风险下，NIIP盈余经济体如何通过黄金再平衡其对外资产组合？不同调整路径对金价和福利有何影响？
AI.motivation: 近年来金融制裁（如资产冻结）的频繁使用，使持有大量外国金融资产的NIIP盈余国家面临跨境扣押风险。黄金作为可实物进口并持有的资产，提供了替代性储备选择，但大规模黄金购买的价格效应尚缺乏系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合再平衡理论，结合国际收支约束与黄金供给曲线，构建了包含跨境扣押风险、黄金作为避险资产以及估值效应的动态调整模型。
AI.method: 历史回顾与描述性统计（黄金作为国际结算资产的历史、金融制裁演变、NIIP与黄金持有分布）+ 结构化模型校准（基于黄金开采成本曲线进行数值模拟）
AI.findings: (1) 在经常账户平衡假设下，每年通过新开采黄金减少1万亿美元NIIP，金价可达8500美元/盎司以上；(2) 10万亿美元目标对应金价约67000美元/盎司；(3) 盈余国家面临快速调整（高估值损失）与渐进调整（长期风险暴露）的权衡；(4) 若考虑全球私人黄金储备的弹性供给，可通过简单的投资组合再平衡渠道缓解价格压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将跨境扣押风险引入国际投资组合选择理论，揭示了黄金作为"非主权"储备资产在降低国家资产负债表脆弱性方面的独特作用，以及大规模资产再平衡的价格反馈机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NIIP盈余经济体（如中国、石油出口国）的外汇储备管理策略提供决策参考；为央行黄金购买行为的价格影响提供定量基准；为理解金融制裁对国际货币体系的影响提供分析框架。

title: Decolonizing the Frontline: Why INGOs Fail in Multi-Polar Warfare and Why Localization Is the Only Path to Survival

detail.title: Decolonizing the Frontline: Why INGOs Fail in Multi-Polar Warfare and Why Localization Is the Only Path to Survival

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently.

detail.abstract:
The classical INGO operational model — centralized command, international staff visibility, and neutrality declarations as access mechanisms — was designed for a world of unified sovereign authority. It is structurally incompatible with the multi-polar conflict environments that now define the majority of active humanitarian crises.

This paper introduces the Intermediary Paralysis Factor (Ωip), an original quantitative instrument that measures the rate at which centralized INGO networks fail under multi-actor disruption. The formula captures four variables: the number of distinct armed actors with veto power (N_actors), the mean hostility coefficient across actors (β_hostility), local operational capacity as the resilience denominator (C_local), the network redundancy score (γ_redundancy), and the population dependency coefficient (δ_dependency). When Ωip exceeds the critical threshold of 2.0, centralized INGO architecture is structurally unable to maintain operational access.

Three empirical theaters validate the framework. Yemen (2024–2026) produces Ωip > 3.8: 69+ UN staff arbitrarily detained, one WFP worker killed in detention, operations suspended across governorates, and 80% of the population losing access to aid alternatives. The Afghanistan-Iran forced displacement corridor (2024–2026) produces Ωip ~ 2.4: 2.8 million Afghans deported from Iran with zero INGO access to processing centers and local absorption capacity at zero. Sudan (2023–2025) produces Ωip ~ 3.2: RSF-SAF dual control environment, systematic aid diversion and taxation, and 7.4 million internally displaced with collapsing humanitarian space.

The paper proposes the Distributed Resilience Architecture as the structural remedy: a localized, redundant operational model in which γ_redundancy — the network's capacity to absorb INGO exit without service collapse — becomes the primary organizational performance metric. Localization is not an ideological preference. In multi-polar conflict environments, it is the only operational architecture capable of surviving the conditions that define contemporary humanitarian frontlines.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，传统国际非政府组织（INGO）的集中式运作模式（中央指挥、国际人员可见性、中立声明作为准入机制）在多极冲突环境中结构性失灵。作者提出了"中介瘫痪因子（Ωip）"这一量化指标，衡量集中式INGO网络在多行为体干扰下的失效速率，并基于也门、阿富汗-伊朗强迫流离失所走廊、苏丹三个实证案例验证该模型。当Ωip超过临界阈值2.0时，集中式INGO架构在结构上无法维持行动准入。论文提出"分布式韧性架构"作为结构性解决方案，将网络冗余度（γ_redundancy）作为核心绩效指标，主张本地化运作是多极冲突环境下唯一可行的运作模式。
AI.research_question: 传统INGO集中式运作模式为何在多极冲突环境中结构性失灵？如何构建量化指标衡量这种失灵，并提出替代性运作架构？
AI.motivation: 当代人道主义危机绝大多数发生在多极冲突环境中，传统INGO运作模式（中央指挥、国际人员可见性、中立声明）在这些环境中持续遭遇准入失败，亟需理论诊断和结构性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中介瘫痪因子（Ωip）模型，包含五个变量：拥有否决权的武装行为体数量（N_actors）、平均敌意系数（β_hostility）、本地运作能力（C_local）、网络冗余度（γ_redundancy）、人口依赖系数（δ_dependency）。临界阈值为2.0。
AI.method: 提出Ωip量化公式，并在也门（2024-2026）、阿富汗-伊朗强迫流离失所走廊（2024-2026）、苏丹（2023-2025）三个实证战区进行验证。
AI.findings: 也门Ωip > 3.8（69+联合国人员被任意拘留，1名WFP工作人员在拘留中死亡，80%人口失去援助替代方案）；阿富汗-伊朗走廊Ωip ~ 2.4（280万阿富汗人被驱逐，INGO零准入）；苏丹Ωip ~ 3.2（RSF-SAF双重控制，系统性援助转移和征税，740万境内流离失所者）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出可量化的INGO运作失灵指标Ωip及其临界阈值，将集中式运作的结构性失败从经验观察提升为可测量、可预测的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"分布式韧性架构"作为替代方案，主张以网络冗余度（γ_redundancy）而非集中控制作为核心组织绩效指标，为多极冲突环境中的INGO运作提供可操作的结构性改革方向。

detail.abstract:
Throughout history, Black communities in the United States have faced aggressive and heightened policing, criminalization, and incarceration compared with their peers. At the same time, Black communities have been denied equal access to safe and affordable housing. Together, the criminal legal system and the housing sector create a reinforcing feedback loop that traps people in a cycle of criminalization and homelessness. Due to historic and ongoing structural racism, Black people are disproportionately ensnared in this cycle, with serious consequences for community safety, public health, and civil rights. The Legal Defense Fund’s Thurgood Marshall Institute (TMI) envisions a future where government leaders address homelessness through the provision of housing and supportive services instead of punishment, and all people—regardless of their prior involvement with the criminal legal system—have access to safe communities and housing.

This Report offers two major contributions to existing literature on this subject. First, it centers the experiences of Black people within the criminalization and homelessness conversation, and grounds this conversation in the long history of anti-Black laws used to police the movement of Black people in public spaces. Second, it examines Atlanta, Georgia, as a case study in which the cycle of criminalization and homelessness plays out with devastating consequences for Black people, presenting original data analysis on racial disparities in arrests for vagrancy charges using nationwide and Atlanta-specific arrest data reported by the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI).

AI.tldr: 本报告聚焦美国黑人群体在刑事司法与住房领域面临的系统性歧视，揭示了"刑事定罪—无家可归"的恶性循环，并以亚特兰大为案例进行实证分析，指出结构性种族主义如何导致黑人被不成比例地卷入这一循环。
AI.research_question: 黑人群体如何在美国刑事司法系统和住房市场的交互作用下陷入"刑事定罪与无家可归"的恶性循环？这一循环在亚特兰大市的具体表现和种族差异如何？
AI.motivation: 历史上黑人社区长期面临过度警务、刑事定罪和监禁，同时被剥夺平等获得安全可负担住房的权利；这两个系统的相互强化形成反馈回路，对社区安全、公共卫生和公民权利产生严重后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性种族主义理论；刑事司法系统与住房市场的反馈循环理论；反黑人法律的历史分析框架。
AI.method: 定性分析（历史梳理与案例研究）+ 定量分析（基于FBI全国及亚特兰大特定数据的流浪罪逮捕种族差异分析）。
AI.findings: 黑人群体在流浪罪逮捕中面临显著的种族差异；刑事司法系统与住房市场的交互作用形成了"刑事定罪→无家可归→进一步刑事定罪"的恶性循环；亚特兰大案例显示了这一循环对黑人社区的毁灭性后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将黑人经历置于刑事定罪与无家可归讨论的中心；将讨论扎根于历史上用于监管黑人在公共空间活动的反黑人法律传统。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁政府领导者通过提供住房和支持性服务而非惩罚来解决无家可归问题；主张无论是否有犯罪记录，所有人都应享有安全社区和住房的权利。

detail.abstract:
This paper examines a structural challenge in Luxembourg’s macroprudential framework: the limited integration of housing-market risk monitoring, supervisory visibility, and emerging wholesale settlement innovation. As a highly interconnected AAA-rated financial centre, Luxembourg benefits from strong institutional foundations but faces growing pressures from housing affordability constraints, demographic change, cross-border labour dependence, and evolving financial-market infrastructure requirements.

The paper proposes a Supervisory Visibility Infrastructure (SVI) framework designed to strengthen macroprudential resilience through enhanced monitoring, data integration, and coordinated supervisory oversight. It argues that improving visibility across housing-market indicators, financial-sector exposures, and systemic risk channels can support earlier policy intervention and more effective risk management. The framework also explores the potential role of controlled wholesale settlement innovation within existing Eurosystem arrangements, emphasizing that central bank money remains the anchor of settlement and that any innovation should operate within established regulatory and monetary-policy boundaries.

In addition, the paper assesses institutional coordination among Luxembourg’s supervisory and macroprudential authorities, including the Comité du Risque Systémique (CdRS), and identifies opportunities to improve information-sharing, escalation pathways, and operational preparedness. Rather than advocating radical structural change, the paper presents a phased and pragmatic policy blueprint aimed at strengthening resilience, preserving financial stability, and supporting Luxembourg’s long-term competitiveness as an international financial centre.

AI.tldr: 本文针对卢森堡宏观审慎框架中住房市场风险监测、监管可见性与批发结算创新整合不足的结构性挑战，提出"监管可见性基础设施"（SVI）框架，通过增强数据整合与协调监督来提升宏观审慎韧性，并提出在欧元体系框架内审慎探索批发结算创新。
AI.research_question: 如何解决卢森堡宏观审慎框架中住房市场风险监测、监管可见性与批发结算创新之间缺乏整合的结构性问题？
AI.motivation: 卢森堡作为高互联、AAA评级的国际金融中心，面临住房可负担性压力、人口结构变化、跨境劳动力依赖及金融基础设施演变等多重挑战，现有框架在风险监测与监管协调方面存在不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观审慎监管理论、系统性风险监测框架、监管可见性理论、欧元体系货币结算安排
AI.method: 概念框架设计与政策分析，基于现有制度安排（欧元体系、CdRS等）进行制度评估与蓝图构建
AI.findings: 提出SVI框架可增强住房市场指标、金融部门风险暴露与系统性风险渠道的监测可见性，支持更早的政策干预；批发结算创新应在央行货币锚定与现有监管货币边界内进行；识别了CdRS等机构间信息共享、升级路径和操作准备度的改进机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"监管可见性基础设施"（SVI）这一概念框架，丰富了宏观审慎监管中多维度可见性与风险监测整合的理论探讨。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卢森堡监管当局提供了分阶段、务实的政策蓝图，涵盖数据整合、机构协调、批发结算创新路径，在不进行激进结构性变革的前提下增强金融稳定与国际竞争力。

detail.abstract: This working paper  seeks to design an empirical strategy to assess the causal effect of the COVID-19 pandemic on gender gaps in employment and unemployment in OECD countries. To this end, a difference-indifferences design is proposed with panel data for 38 OECD countries during 2015-2021, comparing 2015-2019 (pre-COVID) with 2020-2021 (post-COVID). Control variables include human capital, total factor productivity, population, and GDP per capita. Preliminary results suggest a heterogeneous pattern rather than a systematic widening of gender gaps. Statistically significant reductions are observed for the total unemployment gap, the youth unemployment gap (15-24 years), and the adult employment gap (15-64 years). In contrast, a statistically significant increase is observed for the youth employment gap (15-24 years). The total employment gap and adult unemployment gap show no statistically significant effects. Preliminary conclusion: The pandemic did not uniformly widen gender gaps. Instead, it generated a heterogeneous pattern of convergence and divergence depending on the age group and labor indicator considered. Recovery policies with a gender perspective should consider age-specific interventions. These findings require confirmation with extended data and additional robustness analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文使用双重差分法分析了2015-2021年38个OECD国家的面板数据，发现新冠疫情对性别就业与失业差距的影响并非系统性扩大，而是呈现异质性模式——部分差距缩小，部分差距扩大，具体取决于年龄组和劳动指标。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情对OECD国家性别就业差距和失业差距的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 疫情可能对女性和男性的劳动力市场产生不对称冲击，但现有证据尚未就性别差距是扩大还是缩小达成一致，需要严谨的因果识别策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重差分（Difference-in-Differences）因果识别框架
AI.method: 采用双重差分设计，使用38个OECD国家2015-2021年的面板数据，比较疫情前（2015-2019）与疫情后（2020-2021）的性别差距变化，控制人力资本、全要素生产率、人口和人均GDP等变量。
AI.findings: （1）总失业性别差距和青年失业性别差距（15-24岁）显著缩小；（2）成人就业性别差距（15-64岁）显著缩小；（3）青年就业性别差距（15-24岁）显著扩大；（4）总就业性别差距和成人失业性别差距无显著变化。总体呈现收敛与发散并存的异质性模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为疫情对性别不平等的影响提供了因果证据，挑战了"疫情一致扩大性别差距"的简单论断，揭示了年龄和劳动指标维度的异质性效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为疫情后具有性别视角的复苏政策提供了依据，建议政策制定应考虑不同年龄段的针对性干预，而非一刀切的性别平等措施。

title: The Internal Rate of Return Investment Rule Always Fails in Competitive Markets
affiliations: Stanford Graduate School of Business and University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School

detail.title: The Internal Rate of Return Investment Rule Always Fails in Competitive Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationship has influenced this study.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding.

detail.abstract: The internal rate of return (IRR) is a ubiquitous performance statistic and decision making criterion in corporate finance and private markets. We provide four results that formalize, sharpen, and expand long-standing critiques of the IRR. We show that in a perfectly competitive market where there is an infinite supply of capital for positive NPV projects, the IRR decision rule will fail for every project. Moreover, we demonstrate that the previously identified pathologies of the IRR decision rule will emerge for any positive NPV project as long as financing is allowed. Taken together, our results imply that the IRR should not be used or taught as an (auxiliary) decision making criterion nor as a performance statistic. It should be used as a sensitivity analysis tool only.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地证明，IRR在完美竞争市场、允许融资等条件下存在根本性缺陷，不应作为决策标准或绩效统计指标，仅应作为敏感性分析工具使用。
AI.research_question: 内部收益率（IRR）作为投资决策标准和绩效统计指标是否存在根本性缺陷？
AI.motivation: IRR在企业金融和私募市场中广泛应用，但长期以来学界对其存在批评。本文旨在通过严谨的形式化分析，系统揭示IRR的缺陷并给出明确结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于完美竞争市场假设、NPV（净现值）理论、资本成本理论及融资约束理论，对IRR决策规则进行数学化分析。
AI.method: 理论推导与形式化证明，通过四个核心定理展示IRR在多种情境下的失败情形。
AI.findings: （1）在完美竞争市场且正NPV项目资本供给无限时，IRR决策规则对所有项目均失效；（2）允许融资时，任何正NPV项目都会出现IRR的已知病态问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化、深化并扩展了对IRR长期批评的理论基础，提供了严谨的数学证明，明确了IRR的适用范围边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议实务界和教学界停止将IRR作为（辅助）决策标准或绩效统计指标，仅将其作为敏感性分析工具使用。

title: Noise-Suppressed Contrastive Learning for Cross-Language Code Clone Detection
affiliations: Jiangsu Normal University, Jiangsu Normal University and Jiangsu Normal University

detail.title: Noise-Suppressed Contrastive Learning for Cross-Language Code Clone Detection
detail.abstract: In real-world engineering software, source code is often cluttered with extensive noise data irrelevant to the core logic, such as comments, debugging statements, redundant code fragments, template codes, and logging outputs. This noise severely interferes with cross-language code clone detection models that rely on syntactic or semantic similarity, causing the high accuracy demonstrated by most existing methods on idealized datasets to degrade significantly in practical scenarios, while also presenting severe challenges to their generalization capability and robustness. To address these challenges, we propose NSCLC, an adaptive noise-suppression framework with two key components:CEN(CodeEnhanceNet) and a triplet-based contrastive learning mechanism. CEN employs multi-head cross-layer attention to model deep contextual dependencies within code, featuring an adaptive noise-suppression and semantic enhancement architecture that autonomously identifies and prunes non-functional tokens while reinforcing cross-lingual semantic consistency. The triplet-based contrastive learning mechanism then optimizes the latent representation space, enabling robust resilience against diverse types and intensities of interference. Experimental results on the AtCoder dataset show that our method achieves a Precision of 0.98, a Recall of 0.99, and an F1-score of 0.99, reaching a new state-of-the-art. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the CEN architecture, demonstrating robust stability and generalization across noise-intensive scenarios, including variable renaming, log statement insertion, statement swapping, and redundant statement deletion.

AI.tldr: 提出NSCLC自适应噪声抑制框架，通过CEN（跨层注意力网络）和三元组对比学习，在含噪跨语言代码克隆检测中达到SOTA（Precision 0.98, Recall 0.99, F1 0.99）。
AI.research_question: 如何有效抑制实际工程代码中的噪声干扰，提升跨语言代码克隆检测模型在真实场景下的鲁棒性和泛化能力？
AI.motivation: 现有跨语言代码克隆检测方法在理想数据集上表现优异，但真实软件代码中充斥着注释、调试语句、冗余代码等噪声，严重干扰依赖语法/语义相似性的检测模型，导致实际性能大幅下降，且模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性面临严峻挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应噪声抑制理论；跨层注意力机制（multi-head cross-layer attention）；三元组对比学习（triplet-based contrastive learning）；语义一致性强化理论。
AI.method: 提出NSCLC框架，包含两大组件：(1) CEN (CodeEnhanceNet)：采用多头跨层注意力建模代码深层上下文依赖，通过自适应噪声抑制与语义增强架构，自主识别并修剪非功能token，同时强化跨语言语义一致性；(2) 三元组对比学习机制：优化潜在表示空间，实现对不同种类和强度噪声的鲁棒抗干扰。
AI.findings: 在AtCoder数据集上，Precision达0.98、Recall达0.99、F1-score达0.99，达到新SOTA。消融实验验证了CEN架构的有效性，在变量重命名、日志语句插入、语句交换、冗余语句删除等强噪声场景下均表现出稳定的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了自适应噪声抑制与语义增强的理论框架，将跨层注意力机制应用于代码噪声识别与修剪，为处理代码噪声问题提供了新的理论视角；三元组对比学习在噪声鲁棒表征方面的理论贡献，拓展了对比学习在代码分析领域的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为真实工程场景下的跨语言代码克隆检测提供了实用的噪声抑制解决方案，显著提升了模型在含噪环境下的实际性能（F1 0.99）；可应用于代码复用检测、软件维护、代码抄袭检测等实际工程任务。

title: When Uncertainty Raises Hiring
affiliations: University of Liverpool Management School

detail.title: When Uncertainty Raises Hiring
detail.abstract: We study when productivity volatility raises hiring. In the U.S., total productivity volatility predicts higher unemployment and lower labor-market tightness. After removing the component explained by current aggregate conditions and their recent history, however, volatility predicts lower unemployment, higher tightness, and higher job finding. We develop a labor search model with aggregate productivity risk, match-specific productivity, hiring costs, and flexible or sticky wage setting. Volatility affects job finding through state-dependent hiring cutoffs and vacancy creation. The aggregate response is positive when these margins improve in states with large unemployment weight. Sticky wages amplify this response by limiting pass-through of surplus gains to workers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了生产率波动性如何促进招聘。去除当前经济状况的影响后，美国的生产率波动性反而能预测更低的失业率、更高的市场紧密度和更高的求职成功概率。作者构建了一个包含聚合生产率风险、匹配特定生产率、招聘成本和灵活/粘性工资设定的劳动搜索模型，发现波动性通过状态依赖的招聘阈值和职位创造影响求职，粘性工资通过限制盈余传递放大这一正向效应。
AI.research_question: 生产率波动性何时以及如何促进招聘？即，在什么条件下，生产率波动性会降低失业率、提高劳动力市场紧密度？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为生产率波动性会抑制招聘、推高失业率，但作者发现去除当前经济状况影响后，波动性反而有正向预测作用，这一矛盾现象需要理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动搜索模型（labor search model），包含：聚合生产率风险、匹配特定生产率、招聘成本、状态依赖的招聘阈值、职位创造机制，以及灵活工资与粘性工资设定。
AI.method: 理论建模与实证分析相结合。先对美国数据进行分解，识别去除当前经济条件影响后的波动性成分；再构建搜索与匹配模型进行机制分析。
AI.findings: 1. 原始生产率波动性与失业率正相关；2. 去除当前经济条件影响后，波动性与失业率负相关、与市场紧密度和求职成功概率正相关；3. 波动性的正向效应取决于两个条件：招聘阈值和职位创造在失业权重较大的状态下改善；4. 粘性工资通过限制盈余向工人的传递来放大这一正向效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 阐明了生产率波动性影响劳动力市场的双重渠道（招聘阈值与职位创造）；2. 揭示了波动性产生正向效应的条件——状态依赖的失业权重；3. 引入粘性工资机制，解释了为何波动性在某些情况下能促进就业而非抑制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解经济波动对就业的影响提供了新的视角，提示不应简单将波动性视为负面因素；2. 为劳动力市场政策设计提供参考，尤其是工资粘性环境下的就业促进策略。

title:
שקיפות בעידן הבינה המלאכותית: המשפט הישראלי
Transparency in the Era of Artificial Intelligence: The Israeli Legal Perspective
affiliations: , and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
שקיפות בעידן הבינה המלאכותית: המשפט הישראלי
Transparency in the Era of Artificial Intelligence: The Israeli Legal Perspective
detail.abstract:
In recent years, there has been significant growth in the use of artificial intelligence (AI). Despite its efficiency, AI usage presents challenges, particularly in places where decisions have significant implications for human rights. This article focuses on algorithmic transparency in the AI era in the context of the right to freedom of information of government authorities.

Within this framework, the article examines the principles of transparency concerning the right to information in the AI era. It examines how Israeli courts address this issue regarding traditional algorithms, and how it affects the AI era. The article advocates recognizing algorithmic transparency as part of the right to freedom of information, considering both the language and the purpose of the law, and considering global trends advocating transparency in artificial intelligence. Algorithmic transparency as part of the right to freedom of information is crucial to enable continued effective oversight of government authorities’ actions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在人工智能时代，算法透明度应被视为政府信息公开权（信息自由权）的一部分，并以以色列法院的案例为切入点，论证这一主张的正当性与必要性。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能时代，算法透明度是否以及如何构成政府信息公开权（信息自由权）的一部分？以色列法院如何处理传统算法透明度问题，这对AI时代有何启示？
AI.motivation: AI使用快速增长，但在涉及人权的重要决策中（尤其是政府行为）缺乏透明度，现有的信息公开法律框架尚未明确涵盖算法透明度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息自由权理论、算法透明度理论、政府问责制理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、比较法研究（以以色列法院判例为核心）、目的解释方法
AI.findings: 算法透明度应被承认为信息自由权的一部分；以色列法院对传统算法的处理方式为AI时代的透明度要求奠定了基础；无论是从法律文本还是立法目的出发，算法透明度对维持有效的政府监督至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 将算法透明度理论融入信息自由权的理论框架，拓展了传统信息公开权的边界，为AI时代政府决策的透明度提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者和法院（尤其是以色列及类似法域）提供了将算法透明度纳入信息自由法的法律解释路径；有助于加强公众对政府AI决策的监督，保护公民权利。

title: Beyond Objective Measures: Subjective Wellbeing and Life Satisfaction among Youth

detail.title: Beyond Objective Measures: Subjective Wellbeing and Life Satisfaction among Youth
detail.abstract: The study aims to address the gap between measures of individual wellbeing using Subjective Wellbeing (SWB), moving beyond the traditional measures to understand the extent to which material conditions contribute to perceived life satisfaction. Drawing from the primary data collected from the age group 18-29, this study uses the India Youth Development Index (YDI) and Personal wellbeing Index (PWI). The findings of the study reveal the incongruity between the objective and subjective wellbeing measure. Where objective measures suggest the moderate but uneven wellbeing among the participants, subjective wellbeing is reported consistently high. The mismatch between OWB and SWB is more visible in domain-level analysis, especially between low objective wellbeing in community participation, social justice and employment domains, parallel to consistent high subjective wellbeing, in relationship, community and achieving domains. Qualitative findings suggest the role of relationships and social support, central to subjective wellbeing. The study contributes to the larger wellbeing domain by highlighting the domainspecific and youth-focused evidence and advocating the need to bridge subjective and objective measures in assessing human development.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于印度18-29岁青年的主观幸福感（SWB）与客观幸福感（OWB）数据，发现两者存在显著不一致：客观指标显示中等但不均衡的幸福感，而主观幸福感普遍较高。这种矛盾在社区参与、社会公正和就业等具体领域尤为突出，定性分析揭示社会关系和支持是主观幸福感的核心来源。
AI.research_question: 物质条件（客观幸福感）在多大程度上影响青年人感知的生活满意度（主观幸福感）？客观与主观幸福感之间存在何种关系？
AI.motivation: 传统幸福感受到主要依赖客观经济指标（如收入、GDP）来衡量，忽略了个人对生活的主观感知。研究旨在填补这一空白，特别是针对青年群体，探讨主观与客观幸福感之间的脱节问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主观幸福感理论（SWB）、个人幸福感指数（PWI）、印度青年发展指数（YDI）
AI.method: 采用印度青年（18-29岁）的一手调查数据，同时使用印度青年发展指数（YDI）作为客观幸福感指标，个人幸福感指数（PWI）作为主观幸福感指标，并辅以定性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 客观幸福感呈中等但不均衡水平；主观幸福感普遍较高。2. 客观与主观幸福感之间存在明显不一致。3. 社区参与、社会公正和就业等领域的客观幸福感低，但人际关系、社区和成就领域的主观幸福感持续高。4. 定性结果表明，人际关系和社会支持是主观幸福感的核心。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了针对青年群体的领域特异性证据，揭示主观与客观幸福感在不同领域的不匹配。2. 强调在人类发展评估中需要弥合主观与客观指标的差距。3. 丰富了幸福感研究领域，特别是从青年视角出发的理论探索。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供证据，表明仅靠客观经济指标不足以反映青年人的真实幸福感。2. 建议在青年发展政策中更关注社会关系和社区支持等主观维度。3. 推动发展评估指标体系的改进，纳入主观幸福感指标。

title: Malaria Vaccine Rollout in Nigeria: Current Status and Challenges
affiliations: Covenant University, Covenant University, Federal University of Technology and

detail.title: Malaria Vaccine Rollout in Nigeria: Current Status and Challenges

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Malaria remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality in Nigeria, particularly among children under five, despite ongoing control efforts. The introduction of malaria vaccines (RTS, S/AS01 and R21/Matrix-M) offers a new preventive strategy. This systematic review assessed the status of malaria vaccine rollout in Nigeria, focusing on implementation, awareness, acceptance, and health system readiness. A comprehensive search of PubMed, Scopus, ScienceDirect, Google Scholar, and grey literature (2015–2026) identified 12 eligible studies involving caregivers, healthcare workers, and national programme data. Vaccine acceptance among caregivers was consistently high, ranging from 76.6% to 95.6%, with generally positive perceptions across regions. However, awareness levels were highly variable, ranging from 9.7% in Lagos to 79.6% among hospital pharmacists. Vaccine-specific awareness, such as recognition of R21/Matrix-M, was low (15.5% in some populations). Among healthcare workers, physicians demonstrated 68.9% adequate knowledge, whereas nurses showed predominantly poor knowledge. Pharmacists reported 79.6% awareness but expressed concerns regarding vaccine safety and efficacy. Health system readiness remained limited, with facility preparedness scores in northern Nigeria ranging from 33% to 51%. Nigeria demonstrates strong malaria vaccines acceptance but persistent gaps in awareness, knowledge, and implementation capacity. Strengthening health systems and addressing operational constraints are essential for successful malaria vaccine rollout.

AI.tldr: 尼日利亚对疟疾疫苗的接受度很高（76.6%-95.6%），但认知水平差异大（9.7%-79.6%），卫生系统准备不足（设施准备度仅33%-51%），亟需加强健康系统和解决运营瓶颈。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚疟疾疫苗推广的现状如何？重点关注实施、认知、接受度和卫生系统准备情况。
AI.motivation: 疟疾仍是尼日利亚五岁以下儿童发病和死亡的主要原因，尽管已有持续防控措施。RTS,S/AS01和R21/Matrix-M疫苗的引入提供了新的预防策略，但需要系统评估其推广现状。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统综述方法学；疫苗接受度与认知理论；卫生系统准备度框架。
AI.method: 系统综述，检索PubMed、Scopus、ScienceDirect、Google Scholar和灰色文献（2015-2026年），最终纳入12项符合条件的研究，涉及 caregivers、医护人员和国家项目数据。
AI.findings: 1） caregivers疫苗接受度高达76.6%-95.6%；2）认知水平差异大（拉各斯9.7%至药师79.6%），R21/Matrix-M特异性认知低至15.5%；3）医护人员中医生知识充足率68.9%，护士知识普遍差，药师担忧安全性和有效性；4）尼日利亚北部设施准备度仅33%-51%。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了疟疾疫苗推广中的接受度、认知与卫生系统准备度证据，揭示了高接受度与低认知、低准备度之间的“接受-能力缺口”。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚及其他疟疾流行国家提供政策依据：需在保持高接受度的同时，着力提升公众和医护人员的疫苗认知、加强卫生基础设施建设，以保障疫苗成功落地。

title: Heterogeneous Interest Rate Sensitivity across Industries and States
affiliations: University of Iowa

detail.title: Heterogeneous Interest Rate Sensitivity across Industries and States
detail.abstract: This paper examines employment responses to monetary policy across U.S. industries and states using quarterly state–industry panel data from the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW) spanning 1990–2023. Using local projection instrumental variable (LP-IV) methods with high-frequency monetary policy surprises as instruments for federal funds rate changes, I find substantial heterogeneity in cumulative employment responses across sectors and regions. While monetary tightening reduces aggregate employment, the average response masks large differences across sectors and regions. Administrative services, construction, and durable goods manufacturing exhibit the largest cumulative employment declines following monetary tightening, while utilities, arts and entertainment, and health care display comparatively small responses. States also differ markedly in their employment responses to monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1990-2023年美国季度州-行业面板数据，通过局部投影工具变量法（LP-IV）研究了货币政策对各行业和各州就业的异质性影响，发现不同行业和地区的就业对货币紧缩的反应存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 货币政策对美国不同行业和不同州的就业有何异质性影响？
AI.motivation: 平均就业反应掩盖了行业和地区间的巨大差异，理解这种异质性对于精准评估货币政策的分配效应至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制（利率渠道、信贷渠道等）；局部投影工具变量法（LP-IV）
AI.method: 使用季度州-行业面板数据（QCEW, 1990-2023），采用局部投影工具变量法（LP-IV），以高频货币政策意外作为联邦基金利率变化的工具变量。
AI.findings: 货币紧缩总体上降低了就业，但不同行业反应差异显著：行政服务、建筑业和耐用品制造业就业下降最大，而公用事业、艺术娱乐和医疗保健行业反应较小。不同州之间的就业反应也存在明显差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地使用州-行业面板数据分解货币政策的就业效应，揭示了行业和地区维度的异质性模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和政策制定者提供了货币政策行业和地区分配效应的实证证据，有助于制定更具针对性的宏观调控和区域发展政策。

title: Sex Differences in Socioeconomic Inequalities in Diabetes Prevalence Across 30 European Countries: A Sex-Stratified Multi-Dimensional Analysis of the WHO Health Inequality Data Repository

detail.abstract:
Background: Diabetes disproportionately burdens socioeconomically disadvantaged populations, yet whether this inequality differs by sex across Europe remains poorly characterised. We quantified sex-stratified diabetes inequality across 30 European countries. 

Methods: We analysed WHO Health Inequality Data Repository (HIDR) Eurostat data (2014 and 2019; n = 30 countries). Absolute inequality was measured using the concentration index D. Sex differences were tested with paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests and quantified using Hodges-Lehmann estimators. Cross-dimensional consistency was assessed with Spearman rank correlations. Ecological regression examined GDP, Gini coefficient, female employment, and obesity prevalence as predictors. 

Findings: In 2019, female D exceeded male D in 20 of 30 countries for economic inequality (median: 7·4 pp [IQR 5·5–9·3] vs 5·4 pp [IQR 3·8–7·1]; Hodges-Lehmann 1·70 pp; rank-biserial r = 0·557 [large]; p = 0·007) and in 28 of 30 countries for education (Hodges-Lehmann 2·80 pp; r = 0·897; p < 0·001). No significant sex difference was observed for place of residence (p = 0·608). Cross-dimensional consistency was confirmed by positive Spearman correlations between economic, education, and age dimensions (r = 0·51–0·52; BH-adjusted p < 0·05). Eastern European countries had the highest female economic D (median 10·2 pp). GDP per capita was the only significant ecological predictor (WLS R² = 35·2%; β = −2·35 per log-unit, p < 0·001). 

Interpretation: Women in lower socioeconomic positions bear a disproportionate diabetes burden across Europe, concentrated in Eastern Europe. Sex differences are consistent across economic and education dimensions. Gender-sensitive interventions are needed.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了30个欧洲国家的糖尿病不平等数据，发现社会经济地位低的女性比男性承受更严重的糖尿病负担，尤其在东欧国家，且这种性别差异在经济学和教育维度上一致存在。
AI.research_question: 欧洲各国糖尿病不平等是否存在性别差异？
AI.motivation: 糖尿病对社会经济弱势群体的负担不成比例地更大，但欧洲范围内这种不平等是否存在性别差异尚不清楚，因此需要量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康不平等理论、性别交叉性理论、社会经济地位与健康关系理论
AI.method: 使用WHO健康不平等数据存储库的Eurostat数据（2014和2019年，30个国家），通过集中指数D衡量绝对不平等，采用配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验及Hodges-Lehmann估计量检验性别差异，Spearman秩相关评估跨维度一致性，生态回归分析GDP、基尼系数、女性就业率和肥胖率等预测因素。
AI.findings: 2019年，30个国家中有20个国家女性的经济不平等D值高于男性（中位数7.4 pp vs 5.4 pp）；28个国家的教育维度不平等D值女性更高；居住地无显著性别差异。东欧国家女性经济不平等最高（中位数10.2 pp）。人均GDP是唯一显著的生态预测因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了糖尿病不平等中性别维度的系统性差异，验证了交叉性视角在健康不平等研究中的适用性，证明社会经济不平等与性别不平等在糖尿病负担上的交互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲各国制定性别敏感的糖尿病干预政策提供数据支持，指出东欧国家应优先关注低社会经济地位女性的糖尿病防控，强调需结合经济和教育维度设计针对性干预措施。

title: Bound by Tradition: Cultural Gender Norms and Occupational Choice
affiliations: Lund University

detail.title: Bound by Tradition: Cultural Gender Norms and Occupational Choice
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether cultural gender norms about occupations, defined as a society's perception of what is appropriate work for men and women, contribute to persistent gender-stereotypical occupational choice. Using large-scale international survey data and high-quality administrative records, I study whether second-generation immigrant men (women) are less likely to work in an occupation that is perceived as female (male)-typical work in their country of ancestry. I find robust evidence that men, but not women, adhere to occupation-specific cultural gender norms: men are less likely to work in an occupation that is perceived as female work in their country of ancestry, while there is no such effect for women. To investigate mechanisms behind this result, I design an international survey experiment. The results corroborate the gender asymmetry found in the observational data and reveal a social perception penalty for men in heavily female-dominated occupations, but no comparable consistent penalty for women in male-dominated fields. Taken together, the findings of this paper suggest that persistent social norms are a key factor behind the slow integration of men into female-dominated occupations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究文化性别规范如何影响职业选择，发现男性（而非女性）会因来源国的职业性别规范而回避被视为"女性化"的职业，社会对进入女性主导职业的男性存在认知惩罚。
AI.research_question: 文化性别规范（社会对男女适合从事何种工作的认知）是否以及如何导致持续存在的性别刻板职业选择？
AI.motivation: 尽管女性在男性主导职业中的比例有所增加，但男性进入女性主导职业的进展极为缓慢，这一不对称现象背后的原因尚不明确，本文试图从文化性别规范角度解释这一谜题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化性别规范理论、社会认知惩罚理论（性别不对称的规范遵循行为）
AI.method: 混合方法：1）利用大规模国际调查数据和高质行政记录，分析第二代移民的职业选择与其来源国文化性别规范的关系；2）设计国际调查实验，检验社会对跨性别职业选择者的认知惩罚。
AI.findings: 1）男性会回避那些在其来源国文化中被视为"女性化"的职业，而女性不存在相应的回避行为；2）社会对进入女性主导职业的男性存在显著的认知惩罚，但对进入男性主导职业的女性则没有一致性的惩罚。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了职业性别隔离中隐含的性别不对称机制——文化规范对男性的约束力强于对女性的约束力，补充了社会规范与职业选择关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为促进男性进入女性主导职业（如护理、小学教育等）提供了政策启示：需要改变社会对男性从事"女性化"职业的负面认知和惩罚机制。

detail.abstract: In today's digital landscape, social media marketing has become a powerful tool for businesses to engage customers and drive sales. This study marks the first empirical investigation in Albania on the influence of social media marketing on e-commerce sales and e-loyalty. The primary objective of this research is to examine the relationship between social media marketing, e-commerce sales, and e-loyalty within the Albanian context. The marketing in various social media platforms, such as Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, are examined to determine their effects on e-commerce sales and e-loyalty. The study employs a quantitative approach, utilizing a sample of 183 subjects, representing a diverse cross-section of the Albanian e-commerce sector. Data were analyzed using factor analysis, correlation and regression models. The results of the study demonstrated a significant positive impact of social media marketing on both e-commerce sales and e-loyalty. The findings revealed that businesses that effectively utilize social media marketing strategies experience higher levels of e-commerce sales and foster greater customer loyalty compared to those with limited or ineffective social media presence. These outcomes offer valuable empirical insights and practical implications for businesses to develop effective strategies, enhance ecommerce performance, and foster long-term customer loyalty.

AI.research_question: 在阿尔巴尼亚背景下，社交媒体营销如何影响电子商务销售和电子忠诚度？

AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定有效的社交媒体营销策略、提升电商销售业绩和培养长期客户忠诚度提供了实证依据和实践指导。

detail.abstract: Many nations, states, and geographic regions have focused on tourism as a means to economic growth. Most recently, East Asia has experienced a huge influx in tourist dollars as demand grew more than twice as fast as world averages. Tourist often follows the recommendation of others who have had a pleasant experience. The main objective of this study is to examine the factors that influence consumer perceptions of service quality in a mid-priced hotel chain in Malaysia. A random sample of 50 hotel guests provided both survey and interview data regarding the efficacy of different services. The results provide insights and lead to suggestions for change in hotel management practices.

title: Ticket Scalping in the Digital Age: An Analysis of Regulatory Frameworks in India and the European Union
affiliations: National Law Institute University (NLIU), Bhopal and

detail.title: Ticket Scalping in the Digital Age: An Analysis of Regulatory Frameworks in India and the European Union
detail.abstract: The phenomenon of ticket scalping, where tickets for concerts, sporting events, and other live performances are resold at exorbitant prices by intermediaries, has emerged as a significant challenge for consumer protection in the digital era. In India, the absence of a robust regulatory framework leaves consumers vulnerable to exploitative practices, as recent controversies surrounding high-profile concerts such as Coldplay and Diljit Dosanjh have demonstrated. By contrast, the European Union has undertaken regulatory measures, including consumer protection directives and specific restrictions on automated ticket-buying software (“bots”), to address the distortions caused by scalpers in the entertainment market. This paper undertakes a comparative analysis of Indian and EU consumer law frameworks, examining how each jurisdiction conceptualises the consumer in the context of secondary ticket markets, and the extent to which existing laws address issues of unfair trade practices, contractual imbalance, and access to cultural goods. Drawing upon statutory provisions, judicial decisions, and policy interventions, the study argues that while the EU offers more developed protections against scalping, both systems reveal gaps in balancing market efficiency with consumer fairness. The paper also engages with broader normative questions that whether cultural participation should be treated as a consumer right, the role of digital platforms in regulating resale markets, and the ethical dimensions of profiteering from scarcity. In conclusion, the paper proposes a model framework for India inspired by EU practices, advocating for legislative clarity, stronger enforcement, and a consumer-centric approach to ensure fair access to entertainment and cultural experiences.

AI.tldr: 本文比较印度与欧盟在票务转售（黄牛）领域的消费者保护法律框架，指出印度缺乏有效监管而欧盟有更完善的措施，并提出印度可借鉴欧盟经验构建立法清晰、执行有力的消费者导向框架。
AI.research_question: 印度与欧盟的消费者法律框架如何分别应对票务黄牛问题？现有法律在多大程度上解决了不公平贸易行为、合同失衡和文化商品获取问题？
AI.motivation: 印度缺乏针对票务黄牛的健全监管框架，而近期Coldplay、Diljit Dosanjh等高知名度演唱会引发的争议凸显了消费者在二级票务市场中的脆弱性，亟需比较研究以寻找改革路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者保护理论；比较法学框架；公平交易与合同平衡理论；文化权利作为消费者权利的规范性探讨。
AI.method: 比较分析法，对比印度与欧盟的成文法规定、司法判决和政策干预措施。
AI.findings: 欧盟在反黄牛方面提供了更成熟的保护措施（如消费者保护指令、针对抢票机器人的限制），但两套体系在平衡市场效率与消费者公平方面均存在不足。印度几乎缺乏专门监管，消费者处于弱势地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 将文化参与纳入消费者权利范畴进行规范性讨论；揭示了市场效率与消费者公平之间的结构性张力；提出了数字平台在二级票务市场监管中的角色理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度提出了借鉴欧盟实践的模式框架，建议包括立法明晰化、加强执法力度以及采取以消费者为中心的政策路径，以确保娱乐文化商品的公平获取。

title: Critical Legal Power for Twenty-First Century Change
affiliations: University at Buffalo Law School

detail.title: Critical Legal Power for Twenty-First Century Change

publicationDetails.detailsText: University at Buffalo School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2025-028
publicationDetails.journalName: University at Buffalo School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
In his book Poverty Law and Legal Activism, Adam Gearey studies a prime period of 20 th century U.S. poverty law to illuminate critical legal studies as a theory of activism. Gearey recounts how radical anti-poverty lawyers of the 1960s and 1970s reflected on their work with clients as a process of seeing and struggling together with "lives that slide out of view." This essay explores how today's critical legal activists and academics continue this commitment to developing law's transformative power. 

Turning from academia to poverty lawyering as a ground for legal theory, Gearey offers a refreshing response to the idea that critique is an "an unaffordable luxury." Critical Legal Studies has been faulted for taking a "traditionally elitist approach to law by remaining confined within elite institutions and purveyed by law professors, sometimes in impenetrable language." By focusing on the everyday struggles of poverty law work, Gearey identifies legal critique not only as thinking about law, but as a practice of changing what we do and who we are. 

This vision suggests how critique can respond to the current era's multiple crises in the face of a tidal wave of disdain for reason, law, and democracy. Across the political spectrum, a widespread culture of fear, division, and distraction seduces people into complicity with systems of personal and mass destruction. In this context, social change will require more than revealing the irrationality and injustice of existing institutions or defending noble moral principles. It will also require collective practices of learning and caring to generate power for good.

This essay begins by turning to contemporary social movements working to transform the structures keeping many lives and communities “in close proximity to death,” as Gearey describes the condition of poverty. Three themes from contemporary grassroots activism can guide legal responses to today’s human and environmental disasters. First, solutions to poverty require a comprehensive redesign of law, politics, and economy, not simply targeted inclusion or redistribution within existing institutions. Second, collective transformative praxis is fundamental to resisting poverty and other socioeconomic harms. Third, political economic transformation involves affirming and redirecting law’s structural power.

Next, this essay situates today’s struggles for socioeconomic justice in a context of disillusionment with legal liberalism’s capacity to correct the systemic failures underlying poverty. The law-and-economics school of thought answers liberal law’s shortcomings with a deceptive ideal of efficiency. That ideal has helped to rationalize and amplify conditions of growing inequality and insecurity, fueling popular support for authoritarianism. Critique must now challenge both the liberal ideal of law’s neutrality and the neoliberal and illiberal valorization of law’s inequality.

The final section considers how critical theory can follow activists’ lead in affirming law’s power for social and economic justice. I highlight two recent strands of critical theory, one focused on human vulnerability and the other on money, both of which offer ambitious visions for changing the systems that make poverty and other catastrophic conditions appear reasonable, tangential, or intractable.

AI.tldr: 本文通过回顾亚当·吉里（Adam Gearey）对1960-70年代美国贫困法律与法律行动主义的研究，探讨当代批判法律学者和行动者如何延续法律 transformative power 的承诺。文章从当代草根社会运动中提炼出三个主旨——全面重新设计法律、政治与经济；集体变革实践；肯定并引导法律的结构性力量——并批判了法律自由主义与法律经济学的不足，最后提出脆弱性与货币两个批判理论新方向。
AI.research_question: 当代批判法律行动者和学者如何延续并发展法律 transformative power 的承诺，以回应贫困及多重社会危机？
AI.motivation: 在当今普遍对理性、法律和民主不屑一顾的文化氛围中，揭示制度的不理性与非正义已不足以推动社会变革，需要探索集体学习与关爱的实践以产生向善的力量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判法律研究（Critical Legal Studies）；贫困法律行动主义；法律的结构性权力；脆弱性理论；货币理论。
AI.method: 文献分析与理论建构，结合对当代草根社会运动的案例提炼，以及批判理论（脆弱性与货币两条进路）的整合评述。
AI.findings: ① 解决贫困需要全面重新设计法律、政治与经济，而非仅在现有制度内进行包容或再分配；② 集体变革实践是抵御贫困与社会经济伤害的根本；③ 政治经济转型需要肯定并重新引导法律的结构性权力；④ 批判须同时挑战法律自由主义的"中立性"神话与新自由主义/非自由主义对法律不平等的推崇。
AI.theory_contributions: 将批判法律研究从精英学术机构重新扎根于贫困法律工作的日常斗争实践，提出批判不仅是对法律的思考，更是改变"我们做什么"和"我们是谁"的实践。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代社会运动提供三个实操指引（全面制度再设计、集体变革实践、法律结构性权力的重新定向），并指出脆弱性与货币两条批判理论路径可作为推动社会经济正义的政策工具。

title: Beyond Exposure: Predicting AI Adoption Based on Comparative Advantage
affiliations: Yale University, , Yale University and Columbia University - Columbia Business School

detail.title: Beyond Exposure: Predicting AI Adoption Based on Comparative Advantage

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-75
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We document and explain the gap between measures of AI exposure and measures of AI adoption in the workplace. This leads us to propose a new AI adoption index based on comparative advantage. Using the representative German DiWaBe employee survey linked to worker and establishment information, we compare worker-reported AI use to prominent exposure measures and find that the relationship is weak. Motivated by this gap, we develop a framework in which adoption depends not only on technical feasibility-AI's absolute advantage measured by exposure-but on profitability-AI's comparative (dis)advantage relative to a specific worker-balancing AI productivity against AI user costs and worker productivity against wages. We operationalize this framework at the task level by (i) estimating worker productivity relative to pay, (ii) mapping exposure indices into AI productivity, and (iii) inferring task-specific AI user costs from revealed-preference adoption. The resulting occupation-level index accounts for 60% of cross-occupation variation in observed AI adoption, compared to 14% for an exposure-only model. The two approaches diverge substantially for approximately 30% of workers, highlighting that comparative advantage-not exposure alone-is crucial for assessing AI's labor-market impact. * We thank Christina Patterson for an insightful discussion. We benefited from comments by audiences at the Women in Macro Conference 2026 and the Montreal Workshop on Markets with Frictions 2026. The data access was provided via on-site use at the Research Data Centre (FDZ) of the German Federal Employment Agency (BA) at the Institute for Employment Research (IAB) and remote data execution.

AI.tldr: 本文发现AI暴露度（技术可行性）与AI实际采纳之间存在较大差距，提出基于比较优势的新AI采纳指数，该指数能解释60%的职业间采纳差异，远超仅基于暴露度的模型（14%）。
AI.research_question: 如何解释AI暴露度（技术可行性）与AI实际采纳之间的差距？比较优势视角能否更好地预测AI在工作场所的采纳？
AI.motivation: 现有AI暴露度指标与实际采纳率之间的相关性很弱，说明仅靠技术可行性无法解释AI的落地情况。需要一个新的理论框架来理解AI采纳的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于比较优势的AI采纳框架：采纳不仅取决于技术可行性（AI的绝对优势，即暴露度），还取决于盈利性（AI的比较优势/劣势）。该框架平衡了AI生产率与AI用户成本，以及工人生产率与工资之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用德国DiWaBe员工调查数据（链接工人和企业信息），将员工报告的AI使用与主流暴露度指标对比。在任务层面操作化比较优势框架：（i）估计工人生产率相对于工资的比率；（ii）将暴露度指数映射为AI生产率；（iii）通过显示偏好推断任务层面的AI用户成本。
AI.findings: 基于比较优势的新AI采纳指数能解释60%的职业间采纳差异，而仅基于暴露度的模型仅能解释14%。两种方法对约30%的工人的预测存在显著分歧。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于比较优势的AI采纳理论框架，将技术可行性（暴露度）与经济学中更根本的盈利性（比较优势）区分开来，为理解AI采纳提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了更准确的AI采纳预测工具，有助于评估AI对劳动力市场的真实影响，识别哪些职业真正会采纳AI而非仅仅在技术层面"暴露"于AI。

reference: BAFFI Centre Research Paper No. 274
title: Private Credit, SRTs and the Banking System: Mind the Protection Gap

detail.title: Private Credit, SRTs and the Banking System: Mind the Protection Gap

publicationDetails.journalName: BAFFI Centre on Economics, Finance & Regulation Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Private credit funds have emerged as major players in corporate lending and protection sales to banks within the SRT market. This paper models a contagion loop between the banking system and private credit funds working through SRTs. The loop is activated by two elements whose interaction is scarcely formalised in the literature: the circular leverage embedded in SRT financing and the liquidity mismatch introduced by semiliquid private credit funds. Together, they can result in shrinking protection for banks, i.e. a protection gap. Implemented through a simulation, the model provides evidence on the impact of this mechanism on banks' capital relief and lending capacity, and represents a useful risk-assessment tool to both private and public agents.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了银行体系与私募信贷基金之间通过SRT（重大风险转移）工具形成的传染循环模型，揭示了SRT融资中的循环杠杆与私募基金的半流动性错配如何共同导致银行保护缺口，并通过模拟验证了这一机制对银行资本释放和贷款能力的影响。
AI.research_question: 私募信贷基金通过SRT市场与银行系统之间的传染循环如何形成，以及这种循环对银行保护水平和贷款能力有何影响？
AI.motivation: 私募信贷基金已成为SRT市场中企业贷款和保护销售的主要参与者，但文献中对其与银行系统之间通过SRT形成的循环杠杆和流动性错配的交互作用缺乏正式建模。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传染循环模型，整合了SRT融资中的循环杠杆机制和私募信贷基金的半流动性特征引发的流动性错配理论。
AI.method: 通过模拟仿真实施模型分析。
AI.findings: SRT融资中的循环杠杆与私募基金的半流动性错配共同作用，导致银行保护萎缩（即保护缺口），进而影响银行的资本释放和贷款能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次正式化了SRT市场中银行-私募基金传染循环中循环杠杆与流动性错配的交互机制，弥补了相关文献的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共和私人部门提供了一种有用的风险评估工具，有助于理解和防范SRT市场中的系统性风险。

reference: KIEP Research Paper, 전략지역심층연구 (CR), 25-01
title: 브라질 내수시장의 특징과 정책적 시사점: 비공식 경제를 중심으로(Understanding the Brazilian Consumer Economy and Suggesting Policy Implications to Korea Government: Large-Scale Informal Economy Involved)
affiliations: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Korea Institute for International Economic Policy and Korea Institute for International Economic Policy

detail.title: 브라질 내수시장의 특징과 정책적 시사점: 비공식 경제를 중심으로(Understanding the Brazilian Consumer Economy and Suggesting Policy Implications to Korea Government: Large-Scale Informal Economy Involved)

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Brazil has become one of the most attractive partners, especially in light of recent changes in the global environment. Rising uncertainty and instability call for the need to diversify trading partners. As of 2024, Brazil’s GDP has reached 2.2 trillion US dollars. Brazil ranks as the world’s seventh-largest economy, following the United States, China, the European Union, Japan, India, and the United Kingdom. Despite its significance, however, relatively little research has been conducted in Korea to investigate and understand the Brazilian economy. This report aims to analyze Brazil’s consumer market through the lens of the informal economy in particular. The informal economy refers to economic activities that would be included in GDP if monitored by the government but are not officially documented due to institutional or regulatory contexts. The size of Brazil’s informal economy is so large that understanding it is essential to understanding the Brazilian economy in depth. More specifically, the informal economy share in Brazil amounts to 33.4% of GDP. This figure is significantly high for a country with a decent level of GDP per capita compared to other Latin American countries.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了巴西消费市场，特别关注非正规经济。巴西非正规经济占GDP的33.4%，对于理解巴西经济至关重要。尽管巴西是全球第七大经济体，但韩国对此研究不足。本文旨在通过非正规经济视角深入剖析巴西消费市场。
AI.research_question: 如何通过非正规经济的视角理解和分析巴西的消费市场？
AI.motivation: 全球环境变化（不确定性和不稳定性上升）促使各国需要多元化贸易伙伴；巴西作为全球第七大经济体（GDP达2.2万亿美元）具有重要战略意义，但韩国对巴西经济的研究相对缺乏，尤其是对其庞大的非正规经济缺乏深入认识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非正规经济理论——指未被政府正式记录但若被监管本应纳入GDP的经济活动，因制度或监管环境原因而未被官方记录。
AI.method: 基于巴西非正规经济规模（GDP的33.4%）的数据分析，结合巴西消费市场特征的定性研究。
AI.findings: 巴西非正规经济占GDP比重高达33.4%，对于一个人均GDP水平尚可的国家而言，这一比例显著偏高，远超其他拉美国家。非正规经济是理解巴西消费市场和经济全貌的关键维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非正规经济视角引入巴西消费市场分析，强调了非正规经济在理解新兴市场经济体中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国及其他国家了解巴西市场、制定对巴西贸易与投资策略提供参考；提醒企业关注巴西非正规经济中的消费机会与风险。

title: Researching Regulatory Innovation: The UK Digital Regulation Cooperation Forum
affiliations: University of Glasgow - School of Law and University of Glasgow

detail.title: Researching Regulatory Innovation: The UK Digital Regulation Cooperation Forum

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The paper is based on field work undertaken with the consent of the UK Digital Regulation Cooperation Forum (DRCF).
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was obtained under the processes of the University of Glasgow.
declarations.funderStatement: Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC), Research Infrastructure Award Number: AH/Y007662/1

detail.abstract: As digital technologies and AI develop at unnerving speed, can regulation keep pace? By inventing a notable innovatory model, the UK's Digital Regulation Cooperation Forum (DRCF) has shown that statutory agencies can cross boundaries and pool their knowledge. Other states have adopted the forum's prototype at a time of far-reaching geopolitical and geoeconomic powerplays and profound domestic crises. Drawing on our in-depth interviews and engagement with the DRCF's staff, we reflect both on its neo-regulatory practice and doing fieldwork on regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了英国数字监管合作论坛（DRCF）的创新监管模式，展示了法定机构如何跨越边界、整合知识以应对数字技术和AI快速发展带来的监管挑战。通过深度访谈和实地调研，文章反思了这一新监管实践及其研究方法。
AI.research_question: 在数字技术和AI快速发展背景下，监管机构如何通过跨边界合作与知识整合来跟上技术变革的步伐？
AI.motivation: 数字技术和AI发展速度令人不安，传统监管模式难以跟上。英国DRCF创新模型的出现为监管改革提供了新思路，且这一模式已被其他国家采纳。作者希望通过深度调研揭示这一新监管实践的内在逻辑和方法论意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新监管实践（neo-regulatory practice）、跨机构合作与知识整合理论、监管田野调查方法论
AI.method: 深度访谈（in-depth interviews）和与DRCF工作人员的互动参与（engagement）
AI.findings: 英国DRCF通过创新模式打破了法定机构间的传统边界，实现了知识整合；该模式在 geopolitical 和 geoeconomic 权力博弈及国内危机背景下被其他国家采纳；新监管实践既改变了监管方式，也改变了研究监管的田野工作方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"新监管实践"（neo-regulatory practice）这一概念，丰富了数字时代跨机构监管合作的理论框架；对监管田野调查方法进行了反思和拓展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他国家和地区的数字监管改革提供了可借鉴的创新模式（DRCF原型）；展示了法定机构如何有效跨越边界、整合知识以应对快速发展的技术挑战。

reference: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 586; 139 Harvard L. Rev. Forum 237 (2026)
title: Institutional Design, Drug Policy, and the Limits of Abstraction
affiliations: and Indiana University Maurer School of Law

detail.title: Institutional Design, Drug Policy, and the Limits of Abstraction

declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A, this is a law policy paper.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: N/A, this is a law policy paper.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 586
publicationDetails.journalName: Indiana University Maurer School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This article is a response to Professors Matthew Lawrence and David Pozen’s Drug Scheduling as Institutional Design, in a spirit of engagement rather than opposition. The goal of this response is not to contest their central framework. Rather, we seek to identify several context-dependent areas that bear on the ultimate success of the suggested reforms and the Article’s institutional account — especially for readers less familiar with the operational details at the intersection of drug law and health regulation. The Parts that follow elaborate these considerations.

Part I situates the Article’s institutional design framework within a broader interdisciplinary literature and examines the demands that a pragmatic institutional approach imposes, emphasizing the need for grounding in the operational complexity of contemporary drug regulation. Part II clarifies the distribution of authority among federal agencies and why those allocations matter for scheduling reform. Part III turns to practitioners and enforcement dynamics, exploring how prescribing regulation and criminal enforcement shape the institutional environment in which reform would operate. Part IV considers opioid treatment programs and harm reduction as institutional case studies, particularly regarding proposed Schedule A, and Part V assesses whether the Article’s proposed reforms constitute structural redesign or incremental layering within the CSA framework.

AI.tldr: 本文回应Lawrence和Pozen关于《药物调度作为制度设计》的论文，从实务操作视角识别影响改革成功的关键情境因素，涵盖机构权力分配、执法动态、阿片类治疗项目及减害策略等议题。
AI.research_question: 在药物调度制度改革的制度设计框架中，哪些情境依赖性因素会影响改革建议的最终成功？
AI.motivation: 回应Lawrence和Pozen的论文，为不熟悉药物法与健康监管交叉领域操作细节的读者补充实务层面的考量因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度设计理论、药物法律与健康监管的交叉学科视角
AI.method: 批判性回应与情境分析、案例研究（阿片类治疗项目与减害策略）
AI.findings: 制度改革的成功取决于对机构权力分配、执法动态、处方监管等情境因素的深入理解；提出的改革建议存在结构性重新设计与渐进式分层两种可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度设计框架置于更广泛的交叉学科文献中，补充了实务操作复杂性对制度设计的影响分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者厘清联邦机构的权力分配如何影响调度改革，指出处方监管和刑事执法对改革环境的塑造作用，评估了拟议的Schedule A在阿片类治疗和减害领域的适用性。

title: Informal Housing and Self-help Spatial Practices under Compound Risk in Lisbon’s Urban Periphery
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Informal Housing and Self-help Spatial Practices under Compound Risk in Lisbon’s Urban Periphery
detail.abstract: Informal and self-built housing in urban peripheries is increasingly exposed to compound risks produced by the interaction of climatic hazards, public-health crises, infrastructural deficits and socio-spatial vulnerability. This article examines Santa Marta de Corroios, a self-built neighbourhood in the municipality of Seixal, in Lisbon’s urban periphery, as an exploratory qualitative case study of informal housing under compound risk. The COVID-19 pandemic is treated not as an isolated crisis, but as a stress test that exposed the limits of public-health measures assuming the home could function as a safe space for isolation, hygiene, care, remote work and schooling. Based on field observation, photographic records, semi-structured conversations, a focus-group walk with women members of the residents’ association, and housing and demographic data provided by local actors, the article analyses how residents identify and respond to overlapping pandemic, climatic and housing-related vulnerabilities. The findings show that interventions in roofs, patios, thresholds, openings, drainage paths and domestic layouts are not framed locally as formal disaster risk reduction or planned climate adaptation. Nevertheless, they can be interpreted as self-help spatial practices: incremental, experience-based adjustments through which households and community members partially reduce exposure to flooding, overheating, poor ventilation, spatial overcrowding and storm-related damage. The article argues that these practices should not be romanticised as substitutes for public investment, but they provide situated knowledge for more effective, health-responsive and climate-adaptive upgrading strategies in precarious urban territories.

AI.tldr: 本文以里斯本城市边缘的Santa Marta de Corroios自建社区为案例，探讨非正规住房如何在新冠疫情、气候灾害和基础设施匮乏的复合风险下，通过居民的自助空间实践（如改造屋顶、庭院、排水等）来降低暴露风险，并指出这些实践虽不能替代公共投资，但为不稳定的城市区域的健康响应与气候适应改造提供了地方性知识。
AI.research_question: 在非正规自建住房社区中，居民如何识别并应对由疫情、气候灾害、基础设施缺陷和社会空间脆弱性相互作用产生的复合风险？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情暴露了"家庭作为安全空间"假设在非正规住房中的局限性，同时气候灾害和基础设施不足加剧了脆弱性。研究旨在揭示被主流减灾政策忽视的自助空间实践，为更有效的改造策略提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复合风险理论（compound risks）、自助空间实践（self-help spatial practices）、地方性知识（situated knowledge）
AI.method: 探索性定性案例研究：实地观察、摄影记录、半结构化交谈、与居民协会女性成员的焦点小组步行访谈（focus-group walk），以及地方行为者提供的住房和人口数据。
AI.findings: 居民对屋顶、庭院、门槛、开口、排水路径和室内布局的改造虽未被视为正规的减灾或适应措施，但可理解为渐进式、基于经验的自助空间实践，部分降低了洪水、过热、通风不良、空间拥挤和风暴破坏的暴露风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非正规住房中的日常空间改造重新概念化为"自助空间实践"，丰富了复合风险下非正规住区适应能力的理论理解，挑战了将减灾和适应仅视为正式制度行为的传统视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和城市规划者提供启示：应重视并整合居民的地方性知识，而非浪漫化或忽视这些实践，从而制定更健康响应和气候适应的城市改造升级策略。

reference: NBER Working Paper No. w35290
title: What Investment Data Implies about the AI Transition
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - Finance Department and Point72

detail.title: What Investment Data Implies about the AI Transition

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The five largest U.S. technology firms spent $380 billion on capital expenditure in 2025 and are forecast to spend roughly double that in 2026. These firms risk bankruptcy unless expected profits grow commensurately. We embed this observation in a two-sector open-economy model with rare productivity booms. We calibrate the boom size to match the observed increase in investment projected through 2027, implying that a boom raises AI-sector productivity by a factor of roughly 2.7. We then calibrate a two-year window of a 50% annual probability of an increase of the same magnitude, generating a range of scenarios consistent with the wide variety of industry forecasts, along with an elevated permanent probability tied to the valuation of the aggregate market. The implied additional cumulative GDP growth ranges from 5 to 58 percentage points by 2030, with AI shares of the economy ranging from 8% to 39%. Long-term annual growth is in expectation approximately 7% but with substantial risk. With risk aversion of 3, and an elasticity of intertemporal substitution equal to 1, the risk-free rate increases by approximately half a percentage point, and the equity premium rises by approximately 3 percentage points.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国五大科技公司大规模资本支出（2025年3800亿美元，2026年预计翻倍）对经济和金融市场的影响。通过一个两部门开放经济模型，假设存在罕见的AI生产率爆发，校准结果显示AI生产率提升约2.7倍，到2030年额外GDP增长5-58个百分点，长期年增长率约7%，但伴随巨大风险，风险溢价上升约3个百分点。
AI.research_question: 美国大型科技公司的大规模AI相关资本支出如何影响宏观经济（GDP增长、行业结构）和金融市场（无风险利率、股权溢价）？
AI.motivation: 观察到美国五大科技公司（苹果、微软、谷歌、亚马逊、Meta）在2025-2026年间的资本支出呈现历史性激增（2025年3800亿，2026年预计翻倍），这引发了对AI投资泡沫风险和宏观经济影响的担忧，需要系统性地评估这种投资规模下的合理经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两部门开放经济模型（AI部门与非AI部门），内嵌罕见生产率爆发（rare productivity booms）假设，结合风险厌恶和跨期替代弹性等偏好参数。
AI.method: 理论建模与校准分析。构建两部门开放经济模型，将生产率爆发规模校准至与2027年投资预测一致，设定两年窗口期内50%年概率的生产率爆发，结合市场估值隐含的永久概率，生成多种情景。
AI.findings: （1）AI生产率爆发将使AI部门生产率提升约2.7倍；（2）到2030年额外累积GDP增长5-58个百分点；（3）AI占经济比重8%-39%；（4）长期年增长率约7%但风险巨大；（5）在风险厌恶系数3、跨期替代弹性1的条件下，无风险利率上升约0.5个百分点，股权溢价上升约3个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"罕见生产率爆发"引入两部门开放经济模型，提供了在高度不确定性下量化AI投资宏观经济效应的理论框架，特别是将投资规模与生产率冲击的概率分布联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了AI大规模投资的经济增长情景范围（5-58个百分点的GDP增长差异），警示了金融市场风险（股权溢价大幅上升），帮助理解AI投资泡沫与实体经济之间的传导机制。

title: Fixed Payoffs and Floating Prices: Self-Fulfilling Bubbles in On-Chain Prediction Markets

detail.title: Fixed Payoffs and Floating Prices: Self-Fulfilling Bubbles in On-Chain Prediction Markets
detail.abstract: We show that overpricing in on-chain prediction markets is self-fulfilling: for the same fundamentals, a bubble and a no-bubble equilibrium coexist. The bubble survives only for longshots, and a global-games refinement selects a unique tipping point. The cause is institutional. A one-dollar cap and a two-sided market seem to let a contrarian short an overpriced contract via the complementary token, but that short is fully collateralized with no credit, so disciplining a longshot ties up nearly a dollar and invites a squeeze, making discipline a coordination problem. Capital-weighted clearing underprices favorites. We prove uniqueness and identify levers that restore discipline.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了链上预测市场中，过度定价是一种自我实现的现象：相同基本面下，泡沫均衡与无泡沫均衡共存。泡沫只存在于冷门事件中，全球博弈精炼可选出唯一的 tipping point。原因在于制度设计：1美元上限和双边市场看似允许逆向投资者通过互补代币做空高定价合约，但该做空是全额抵押、无信用的，因此约束冷门事件需占用近1美元资金并易遭挤仓，使约束行为成为协调问题。资本加权清算会低估热门事件。本文证明了均衡的唯一性，并识别出恢复约束力的政策杠杆。
AI.research_question: 链上预测市场的过度定价机制是什么？为什么冷门事件（longshots）容易出现泡沫？如何恢复市场的约束力（disciplining）？
AI.motivation: 链上预测市场（如Augur、Polymarket）常出现对冷门事件的严重高估，传统理论难以解释这一系统性偏离。本文试图从市场制度设计（1美元上限、双边市场、全额抵押做空、资本加权清算）出发，解释泡沫的自实现本质及均衡唯一性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自实现泡沫模型、全球博弈（Global Games）精炼、协调博弈、全额抵押做空机制下的挤仓（squeeze）风险。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建一个包含泡沫均衡与无泡沫均衡的协调博弈模型，应用全球博弈方法选择唯一的 tipping point，并通过比较静态分析识别影响均衡的政策杠杆。
AI.findings: 1）过度定价是自实现的，相同基本面下泡沫与无泡沫均衡共存。2）泡沫仅存于冷门事件（longshots），热门事件（favorites）在资本加权清算下被低估。3）全球博弈精炼可选出唯一的 tipping point。4）约束冷门事件的成本高（需锁定近1美元）、易遭挤仓，导致约束行为成为协调问题。5）识别出可恢复约束力的政策杠杆（如调整清算规则、降低抵押成本等）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次将自实现泡沫理论应用于链上预测市场制度。2）将全球博弈方法引入保证金交易和抵押品约束的分析中。3）揭示全额抵押做空下的挤仓协调问题与泡沫共存的经济学逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为链上预测市场（如Polymarket）的设计者提供防止泡沫的制度建议。2）识别出资本加权清算导致热门事件被低估的问题。3）提出恢复市场约束力的具体杠杆，如调整做空抵押要求、优化清算规则等。

reference: NBER Working Paper No. w35292
title: Reducing Gun Violence at Scale
affiliations: Cornell University, University of Pennsylvania - Department of Criminology, University of Pennsylvania, University of Pennsylvania, University of Pennsylvania, Abt Global, University of Pennsylvania and University of Pennsylvania

detail.title: Reducing Gun Violence at Scale

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Baltimore's homicide rate fell by roughly 60% between 2022 and 2025, an exceptional decline among large U.S. cities. At the start of this period, Baltimore launched a strategy that concentrated police and social service resources on a small set of people thought to be driving group-involved gun violence. The approach—“focused deterrence”—has been implemented in some form by cities across the U.S. The strategy was introduced first in the Western police district, one of the highest-violence communities in the U.S. Relative to comparable Baltimore neighborhoods, we estimate that within 18 months shootings and homicides in the Western district fell by roughly one third and carjackings by about 40%, with no spillovers elsewhere in the city. These gains came without expanding overall enforcement: total arrests were flat even as arrests for serious violent crimes rose sharply, indicating that the strategy redirected police authority toward serious violence rather than widening the net of the justice system. Person-level and qualitative evidence point to deterrence, incapacitation, services, and community messengers' legitimacy as contributing channels, with no single mechanism explaining the bulk of the decline. The social value of the averted violence is roughly 35 times the program's first-year spending. Citywide, Baltimore's homicide rate over this period was about 25% below a synthetic counterfactual built from other large cities. The timing of Baltimore's homicide decline and the absence of a larger-than-expected drop in other violent crimes are consistent with the expansion of focused deterrence across the city and a broader shift toward a targeted, partnership-based response to group violence. Baltimore's experience offers an important blueprint for how cities can achieve reductions in gun violence at scale.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 巴尔的摩市通过实施“聚焦威慑”策略，在2022至2025年间将 homicide 率降低约60%。该策略集中警务和社会服务资源于一小部分被认为驱动群体枪支暴力的个人，在西区试点18个月内枪击和凶杀案下降约三分之一，劫车案下降约40%，且未导致整体逮捕增加或暴力外溢。城市整体 homicide 率比合成反事实低约25%，每投入1美元可产生约35倍的社会价值。
AI.research_question: 聚焦威慑策略能否在大城市大规模降低枪支暴力，其效果、机制和成本效益如何？
AI.motivation: 美国城市枪支暴力问题严峻，巴尔的摩市 homicide 率在2022-2025年间大幅下降约60%，这一异常降幅为研究大规模暴力干预策略的有效性提供了独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 聚焦威慑理论（Focused Deterrence），结合威慑、 incapacitation（隔离 incapacitation）、社会服务和社区信使的合法性等机制。
AI.method: 准实验设计，比较巴尔的摩西区与可比社区；使用合成控制法（synthetic counterfactual）比较城市整体 homicide 率与其他大城市；结合个人层面和定性证据分析机制。
AI.findings: 西区18个月内 shootings 和 homicides 下降约三分之一，carjackings 下降约40%，无溢出效应；整体逮捕未增加，但严重暴力犯罪逮捕显著上升；城市整体 homicide 率比合成反事实低约25%；社会价值约为项目首年支出的35倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证检验了聚焦威慑在大城市规模下的有效性，揭示了威慑、 incapacitation、服务和社区合法性等多重机制共同作用，且指出没有任何单一机制主导效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他城市提供了可规模化的枪支暴力干预蓝图，展示了聚焦威慑策略在不扩大执法网的前提下精准降低暴力犯罪并产生极高社会投资回报率的可行性。

title: From Financial Crisis to Pandemic Shock: A Pixel-Level Assessment of Multidimensional Socioeconomic Impact and Resilience in the Nile River Basin
affiliations: Tongji University, Tongji University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Tongji University, Tongji University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Financial Crisis to Pandemic Shock: A Pixel-Level Assessment of Multidimensional Socioeconomic Impact and Resilience in the Nile River Basin
detail.abstract: Global crises pose severe challenges to the sustainable development of ecologically fragile regions. However, constrained by the coarse granularity and scarcity of traditional statistical data, it is difficult to precisely characterize the spatiotemporal evolution of multidimensional socioeconomic impacts in these regions under crises. To address these data limitations, this study constructs a transferable pixel-level multidimensional assessment framework, conducting an in-depth comparative analysis of the socioeconomic impacts of two major events in the Nile River Basin: the 2008 Global Financial Crisis (GFC) and the 2020 COVID-19 pandemic. Based on the Growth-Poverty-Inequality (GPI) trilemma theory, the study integrates nighttime light remote sensing data with multisource socioeconomic spatial indicators to construct the Economic Impact Index (EII), quantifying regional economic dynamics and class mobility. It further derives the Economic Shock Resilience Index (ESR) to comprehensively assess the relative shock-absorbing capacity of various regions within the basin. The study finds: (1) Regarding impact characteristics, the GFC triggered larger fluctuations with significant spatial differentiation (impact intensity was approximately 4.1 times that of the COVID-19 pandemic), but it propelled only a very small proportion (1.91%) of the population into higher-income groups. In contrast, the economic contraction during the initial phase of the COVID-19 pandemic exhibited strong synchronicity across the entire region, with income class mobility nearly stagnating. (2) Regarding resilience evolution, the basin exhibits significant divergent pathways: regions with stronger infrastructure support and higher levels of digitalization achieved continuous leaps in resilience, while regions affected by geopolitical conflicts fell into a state of long-term, high-vulnerability lock-in. The spatial assessment framework proposed in this study not only provides a method for spatially quantifying crisis impacts in data-scarce regions but also a GeoAI-compatible and spatially explicit analytical foundation for targeted post-crisis recovery prioritization and resilience-oriented policy design.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用夜间灯光等多源遥感数据，构建了一个可迁移的像素级多维评估框架，对尼罗河流域2008年全球金融危机和2020年新冠疫情两大危机的社会经济影响进行了深入比较分析，揭示了不同危机下区域经济冲击特征与韧性演化的差异。
AI.research_question: 如何在数据稀缺的生态脆弱区域，精确刻画全球危机下多维社会经济影响的时空演化特征？
AI.motivation: 传统统计数据粒度粗、稀缺，难以精确刻画生态脆弱区在危机下社会经济影响的时空演化，亟需探索新的数据与方法框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增长-贫困-不平等（GPI）三难困境理论
AI.method: 整合夜间灯光遥感数据与多源社会经济空间指标，构建经济影响指数（EII）和经济冲击韧性指数（ESR），进行像素级多维评估与比较分析。
AI.findings: (1) 2008年金融危机冲击强度约为新冠疫情的4.1倍，空间分异显著，但仅1.91%人口跃入高收入群体；新冠疫情初期经济收缩全区域同步性强，收入阶层流动性近乎停滞。(2) 流域内韧性演化路径分化显著：基础设施与数字化水平高的地区韧性持续跃升，地缘冲突影响地区陷入长期高脆弱性锁定状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将GPI三难困境理论拓展至空间显式的危机影响评估中，为数据稀缺区域提供了可迁移的量化方法框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了GeoAI兼容的空间显式分析基础，可用于灾后恢复优先级排序和韧性导向的政策设计。

reference: NBER Working Paper No. w35205
title: Tatonnement and Price Setting in General Equilibrium
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Tatonnement and Price Setting in General Equilibrium

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
A foundational question in General Equilibrium theory—when is an equilibrium stable?—has remained largely unresolved for over 150 years despite important contributions. This paper proposes a resolution.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一般均衡理论中一个150年未决的基础性问题——均衡何时稳定——的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 一般均衡理论中，均衡在什么条件下是稳定的？
AI.motivation: 尽管有许多重要贡献，但一般均衡的稳定性问题在150多年来一直未能得到解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡理论（General Equilibrium Theory）
AI.method: 理论分析，提出新的稳定性条件
AI.findings: 提出了一个解决一般均衡稳定性问题的方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 解决了一般均衡理论中长达150年的基础性理论难题，为均衡稳定性提供了判定条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济政策制定和市场经济分析提供了理论基础，有助于理解市场均衡的稳定性特征。

title: Prediction Markets as Shadow Financial Markets: Completion, Risk Migration, and the Limits of Product-Based Regulation
affiliations: and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business
