Using the ArcelorMittal–ILVA enforcement chain as a natural experiment, I document four enforcement events between 2019 and 2024 in which Italian criminal law produced direct, material consequences for a listed multinational, including a formal withdrawal notice and a subsequent insolvency declaration, and test whether equity markets priced these events in real time. Using daily closing prices pulled from Bloomberg Terminal, I construct a market model event study across four Tier 1 events with significance testing using the Boehmer-Musumeci-Poulsen standardized cross-sectional method. I find no statistically significant abnormal returns in short event windows around any of the three 2019 enforcement events, despite the October 2019 scudo penale removal triggering ArcelorMittal's contractual withdrawal clause within 13 days. Bloomberg terminal news records confirm zero ILVA-related coverage in the week of the legislative vote. The sole statistically significant result is a cumulative abnormal return of +15.59% in the [-1,+20] window following the withdrawal notice, reflecting market participants pricing Italian government intervention rather than the underlying criminal enforcement event. A confirmed data gap in the ArcelorMittal 5-year EUR CDS series across the entire 2019 enforcement window further suggests the credit market was structurally absent during the most consequential legal events in the company's Italian history. I argue that Italian parliamentary legislative records constitute a systematically unindexed alternative data source carrying material corporate information, and that the 13-day gap between the enforcement event and public disclosure represents a structurally exploitable information asymmetry for legislative monitors.

AI.tldr: 本文以安赛乐米塔尔-ILVA执法链为自然实验，发现欧洲战略工业资产中立法刑事豁免周期是一个被错误定价的股权因子。2019年三次执法事件均无显著异常收益，唯一显著的+15.59%累积异常收益反映的是市场对政府干预的定价而非执法事件本身，且信用市场在关键执法窗口期结构性缺席。
AI.research_question: 股权市场是否实时定价了欧洲战略工业资产中立法刑事执法事件的影响？特别是意大利刑事法律对上市跨国公司（安赛乐米塔尔）产生直接重大后果时，市场是否有效反应？
AI.motivation: 立法刑事豁免周期作为被错误定价的股权因子，在现有文献中未被充分研究；意大利议会立法记录作为系统性未索引的另类数据源，可能携带重大公司信息，存在结构性可剥削的信息不对称。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场效率理论（事件研究法）；信息不对称理论；立法政治风险与公司金融交叉理论
AI.method: 市场模型事件研究法，使用Bloomberg终端日度收盘价，Boehmer-Musumeci-Poulsen标准化横截面检验方法，研究四个Tier 1事件，同时使用Bloomberg新闻记录和CDS数据验证。
AI.findings: (1) 2019年三次执法事件在短窗口内均无显著异常收益；(2) 2019年10月scudo penale撤销触发合同退出条款，但Bloomberg新闻记录显示立法投票周零相关报道；(3) 唯一显著结果为退出通知后[-1,+20]窗口CAR为+15.59%，反映市场定价意大利政府干预而非执法事件；(4) 安赛乐米塔尔5年期欧元CDS序列在2019年整个执法窗口存在数据缺口，信用市场结构性缺席。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了立法刑事豁免周期作为被错误定价的股权因子，揭示了法律执行风险与市场定价之间的结构性脱节，提出立法记录作为另类数据源的理论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法监测者提供了13天信息不对称窗口的可剥削机会；提示投资者需要关注立法刑事豁免周期作为未被定价的风险因子；对监管机构和跨国公司具有风险评估与信息披露的实践启示。

title: Intergenerational Redistribution in the Green Transition
affiliations: Roma Tre University - Department of Law, Banque de France and Ecole Polytechnique, Palaiseau

detail.title: Intergenerational Redistribution in the Green Transition
detail.abstract: We study the intergenerational distributional effects of carbon pricing during the green transition in an overlapping-generations New Keynesian model calibrated to euro-area household micro data. Climate policy generates systematic redistribution across cohorts through two channels: a labor-income channel, driven by wage compression and lower labor demand, and a financial-wealth channel, driven by asset revaluation and higher real returns. The laborincome channel dominates quantitatively, generating persistent welfare losses of up to 6 percent in permanent-consumption equivalents for working-age households, while retirees experience comparable gains. Revenue recycling can mitigate these asymmetries, requiring 40 to 68 percent of carbon-tax revenues to be directed toward financial-income tax relief. Monetary policy has limited influence on the overall redistributive pattern.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个世代交叠的新凯恩斯模型，研究碳定价在绿色转型过程中的代际分配效应。研究发现，碳定价通过劳动收入渠道（工资压缩和劳动力需求下降）和金融财富渠道（资产重估和实际回报上升）在不同代际间产生系统性再分配，其中劳动收入渠道占主导，导致在职家庭福利损失高达6%，而退休家庭则获得同等程度的福利改善。收入循环利用可缓解这种不对称，需将40%-68%的碳税收入用于金融收入税减免，货币政策对此影响有限。
AI.research_question: 碳定价政策在绿色转型过程中如何在不同代际之间产生分配效应？
AI.motivation: 绿色转型中的碳定价政策可能对不同代际产生不对称的影响，现有研究对代际分配效应的关注不足，需要量化分析其机制和幅度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 世代交叠（Overlapping-Generations, OLG）模型、新凯恩斯模型
AI.method: 构建世代交叠的新凯恩斯模型，使用欧元区家庭微观数据进行校准，模拟分析碳定价的代际分配效应。
AI.findings: （1）碳定价通过劳动收入渠道（工资压缩和劳动力需求下降）和金融财富渠道（资产重估和实际回报上升）产生代际再分配；（2）劳动收入渠道占主导地位，导致在职工作年龄家庭福利损失高达6%（永久消费等价），而退休家庭获得同等程度的福利改善；（3）收入循环利用可缓解代际不对称，需将40%-68%的碳税收入用于金融收入税减免；（4）货币政策对整体再分配格局影响有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在世代交叠-新凯恩斯框架下系统分析碳定价政策的代际分配效应，区分了劳动收入渠道和金融财富渠道两种传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为碳定价政策的代际公平性设计提供了量化依据，特别是收入循环利用（将碳税收入用于金融收入税减免）的具体比例建议（40%-68%），对政策制定者设计更具包容性的气候政策具有直接指导意义。

title: When Bonds Stop Hedging Stocks: Time-Varying Correlation and the Inflation Regime of 2022
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: When Bonds Stop Hedging Stocks: Time-Varying Correlation and the Inflation Regime of 2022

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether the conditional correlation between US equity and Treasury returns structurally shifted following the inflation episode of 2022. Using monthly data from January 2000 to March 2026, a TARCH(1,1) model characterises univariate volatility dynamics of S&P 500 log-returns, and a DCC-GARCH(1,1) model extracts a time series of conditional correlations jointly on equity and bond returns. The conditional correlation averaged 0.280 in the pre-2022 period and fell to-0.013 post-2022, a decline of 0.293 confirmed by a Chow test (F = 94.47, p < 0.001). A driver regression of the extracted correlation on TIPS breakeven inflation and the VIX finds no significant linear relationship (R 2 = 0.082), consistent with the shift operating as a discrete structural regime change rather than a continuous response to observable macroeconomic variables. Rolling outof-sample forecasts from the TARCH(1,1) produce significantly lower RMSE than a naive benchmark (0.034 versus 0.045, DM =-2.393, p = 0.021). The results indicate that the flight-to-quality mechanism broke down precisely when investors needed it most, with implications for portfolio diversification in inflationary regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文发现美国股票与国债之间的条件相关性在2022年通胀之后发生了结构性断裂，从正相关（0.280）骤降至接近零（-0.013），且这一变化是离散的制度转换而非对宏观变量的连续反应，并验证了TARCH模型在波动率预测中的优越性。
AI.research_question: 美国股票与国债收益率之间的条件相关性在2022年通胀事件后是否发生了结构性转变？
AI.motivation: 2022年通胀飙升可能破坏了传统的"避险机制"（flight-to-quality），即在市场动荡时资金从股票流向国债、股债呈负相关的模式。检验这一机制是否在投资者最需要时失效，对投资组合多元化策略具有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: DCC-GARCH（动态条件相关广义自回归条件异方差）模型、TARCH（阈值自回归条件异方差）模型、Chow结构性断点检验、Diebold-Mariano预测比较检验、飞行质量（flight-to-quality）机制。
AI.method: 使用2000年1月至2026年3月月度数据，先以TARCH(1,1)模型刻画标普500对数收益率的单变量波动动态，再用DCC-GARCH(1,1)模型提取股票与债券收益率的条件相关系数序列，通过Chow检验确认结构性断点，通过驱动回归（以TIPS盈亏平衡通胀率和VIX为自变量）检验相关性是否对宏观变量连续响应。
AI.findings: 条件相关性从2022年前的0.280降至2022年后的-0.013，降幅0.293，Chow检验高度显著（F=94.47, p<0.001）；驱动回归R²仅0.082，表明该变化为离散制度转换而非连续响应；TARCH(1,1)滚动预测的RMSE（0.034）显著优于朴素基准（0.045），DM统计量为-2.393（p=0.021）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统论证2022年通胀事件导致股债条件相关性发生结构性断点，挑战了传统的"避险机制"持续有效的假设，并证明该变化是离散的制度转换而非对宏观变量的平滑响应，丰富了资产定价与金融传染理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资组合管理具有直接启示：在通胀制度下，传统的60/40股债多元化策略可能失效，投资者需要重新审视资产配置框架，考虑其他替代避险资产或动态调整策略。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Neuroimaging: The Past, The Present and Its Limitations
affiliations: and Shroomery

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in Neuroimaging: The Past, The Present and Its Limitations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Stroke remains one of the leading causes of death and long-term disability worldwide, with rapid diagnosis being essential for effective treatment and improved patient outcomes. Neuroimaging techniques such as computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) play a central role in stroke diagnosis; however, manual interpretation of these scans can be time-consuming and subject to variability. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI), particularly machine learning and deep learning approaches, has emerged as a promising solution for enhancing the speed and accuracy of stroke neuroimaging analysis. This paper explores the evolution of AI in neuroimaging, from early computational models to modern convolutional neural networks and advanced architectures such as U-Net. It explores current AI applications in CT and MRI-based stroke detection, including lesion segmentation, large vessel occlusion detection, infarct core estimation, and ischemic penumbra assessment. The paper also discusses modern developments such as AI-assisted ASPECTS scoring, hybrid machine learning frameworks, and transfer learning models that have demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy and improved workflow efficiency. In addition, major limitations and concerns are addressed, including dataset bias, lack of generalizability, ethical and legal challenges, data privacy risks, clinician burnout, and others. Future directions in the field, including federated learning, explainable AI, radiomics, and precision stroke medicine are also highlighted. Overall, AI has the potential to significantly transform stroke neuroimaging by supporting faster, more reliable, and more personalized clinical decision-making, although further validation and responsible implementation remain essential for widespread clinical adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了人工智能（尤其是机器学习和深度学习）在卒中神经影像学中的应用，涵盖从早期计算模型到现代CNN、U-Net等架构的发展，探讨了AI在CT和MRI卒中检测中的具体应用（如病灶分割、大血管闭塞检测、梗死核心评估等），并讨论了数据偏差、泛化性、伦理隐私等局限与未来方向（联邦学习、可解释AI、影像组学等）。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何提升卒中神经影像学诊断的速度与准确性？其当前应用、局限性及未来发展方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 卒中致死致残率高，快速诊断至关重要，但传统手动影像判读耗时且存在变异性，亟需AI技术提升诊断效率与可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习、深度学习（CNN、U-Net）、迁移学习、混合机器学习框架、可解释AI、影像组学、联邦学习。
AI.method: 文献综述，梳理AI在神经影像学中的技术演进、应用场景（CT/MRI）、模型架构（从早期计算模型到U-Net等先进架构）及评估指标。
AI.findings: AI在病灶分割、大血管闭塞检测、梗死核心评估、缺血半暗带评估、ASPECTS评分等方面展现了高诊断准确率和流程效率提升；但存在数据集偏倚、泛化性不足、伦理法律挑战、数据隐私风险、临床倦怠等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了AI技术在卒中影像领域的理论演进路径，从传统机器学习到深度学习再到可解释AI和联邦学习，为后续研究提供了理论框架参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床医生和医院管理者提供了AI辅助卒中诊断的实践指南，指出了当前部署的障碍（如泛化性、隐私、伦理）以及未来落地方向（如精准医学、影像组学）。

title: Sticky Priors: Prediction Markets and Institutional Belief Rigidity

detail.title: Sticky Priors: Prediction Markets and Institutional Belief Rigidity
detail.abstract: This paper examines the growing role of prediction markets as decentralized mechanisms of expectation formation in environments characterized by declining institutional credibility, macroeconomic uncertainty, and informational fragmentation. We introduce the concept of Sticky Priors-the tendency of institutions, policymakers, and the public to resist Bayesian updating of their beliefs even in the face of contradicting evidence-as a unifying framework to explain why official forecasting mechanisms systematically underperform prediction markets during periods of high uncertainty. Sticky Priors are distinct from the Sticky Expectations of Mankiw and Reis (2002): where the latter describes staggered updating across heterogeneous agents, Sticky Priors describes the institutional and narrative anchoring of prior beliefs themselves, driven by political incentives, reputational concerns, and cognitive entrenchment. Drawing on rational expectations theory (Muth, 1961), Hayekian dispersed information (Hayek, 1945), the efficient market hypothesis (Fama, 1970), decision markets (Hanson, 1999), and behavioral economics (Kahneman, 2011; Thaler & Sunstein, 2008), we develop a theoretical framework that situates prediction markets as the primary mechanism capable of forcing prior updating under financial discipline. We focus primarily on Argentina-a recurring case study in institutional fragility, hyperinflation, and credibility collapse-while extending the analysis to the United States, where the Federal Reserve's 'transitory' inflation narrative of 2021 represents a paradigmatic case of institutional Sticky Priors. The evidence suggests that under conditions of high institutional stress, decentralized probabilistic markets exhibit superior responsiveness to new information precisely because they impose an immediate financial cost on agents who fail to update. We propose four testable hypotheses, including a novel hypothesis on the inverse relationship between institutional prior rigidity and prediction market accuracy, and outline an empirical agenda for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在制度可信度下降、宏观经济不确定性和信息碎片化环境下，预测市场作为去中心化预期形成机制的作用。提出"粘性先验"概念，解释为何官方预测机制在高不确定性时期系统性落后于预测市场，并聚焦阿根廷与美国案例，提出四个可检验假设。
AI.research_question: 在制度可信度下降、宏观经济不确定性和信息碎片化的环境中，预测市场如何作为去中心化的预期形成机制发挥作用？为何官方预测机制在高不确定性时期系统性表现不如预测市场？
AI.motivation: 现有研究未能充分解释为何官方预测机制（如央行、政府机构）在高不确定环境下系统性落后于去中心化的预测市场。本文提出"粘性先验"概念，填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性预期理论（Muth, 1961）、哈耶克分散信息理论（Hayek, 1945）、有效市场假说（Fama, 1970）、决策市场理论（Hanson, 1999）、行为经济学（Kahneman, 2011; Thaler & Sunstein, 2008）。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与案例分析相结合，以阿根廷为主要案例，美国（2021年美联储"暂时性"通胀叙事）为延伸案例，提出四个可检验假设并勾勒未来实证研究议程。
AI.findings: 在高制度压力条件下，去中心化的概率市场对信息的响应速度优于官方机制，因为预测市场对未能更新信念的参与者施加了直接的财务成本。制度先验刚性程度与预测市场准确性之间存在反比关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"粘性先验"（Sticky Priors）概念，区别于Mankiw和Reis（2002）的"粘性预期"，强调制度与叙事层面对先验信念的锚定效应，拓展了预期形成理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、央行和金融机构提供启示：在高不确定环境下，应重视预测市场作为补充性信息聚合机制的价值，并认识到制度性认知僵化对预测准确性的危害。

title: What the Product Knows: India's Missing Intelligence Layer

detail.title: What the Product Knows: India's Missing Intelligence Layer
detail.abstract: India has invested heavily in agricultural data infrastructure — TraceNet, APEDA documentation, FSSAI licensing, digital mandis, e-NAM, Agristack. Yet product-level information remains fragmented. This synthesis paper draws on the four preceding SGPIS papers to document a structural condition: product information is generated at every stage of India's food and agriculture systems but does not accumulate into a portable, reusable product identity. The paper introduces the concept of non-accumulation in product information systems and argues that the gap is structural — not a data deficit, but an architectural absence. India has the documentation. What it lacks is a disclosure layer that makes producer-declared product information portable across buyers, institutions, and markets.

AI.tldr: 印度在农业数据基础设施上投入巨大，但产品级信息仍然分散。本文提出“非积累”概念，指出问题不在于数据缺失，而在于缺乏使生产者声明的产品信息在买家、机构和市场间可携带的披露层架构。
AI.research_question: 为什么印度投入大量资源建设农业数据基础设施，产品级信息仍然碎片化且不可复用？
AI.motivation: 印度在TraceNet、APEDA、FSSAI、e-NAM、Agristack等数据基础设施上投入巨大，但产品层面的信息仍然分散、不可携带、不可复用，需要解释这一结构性矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息非积累（non-accumulation）概念：产品信息系统中的结构性缺口——不是数据赤字，而是架构性缺失，缺乏使生产者声明的产品信息可跨买家、机构和市场携带的披露层。
AI.method: 综合评述（synthesis paper），基于前四篇SGPIS论文进行归纳与理论提炼。
AI.findings: 印度食品和农业系统各阶段都在生成产品信息，但这些信息并未积累成可携带、可复用的产品身份。问题根源是结构性的架构缺失，而非数据不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“非积累”这一新概念，将产品信息碎片化问题从数据短缺重新定义为架构性缺失，为理解农产品信息系统的结构性瓶颈提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出印度不需要更多数据基础设施，而是需要一个披露层（disclosure layer），使生产者声明的产品信息能够在不同买家、机构和市场间流通，为农业信息系统的政策设计和架构改进提供了明确方向。

title: Autocratic Legalism and Extraterritorial Security Creep: Implications for Human Rights in Hong Kong and the 2026 Iranian Athletic Defections

detail.title: Autocratic Legalism and Extraterritorial Security Creep: Implications for Human Rights in Hong Kong and the 2026 Iranian Athletic Defections
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the systemic fragmentation of the international human rights architecture caused by contemporary national security frameworks. Utilizing a blackletter legal methodology alongside comparative case-study analysis, the study exposes an "enforcement deficit" where modern states maintain a formal veneer of international treaty compliance while effectively neutralizing civil liberties.
The paper evaluates this phenomenon through a dual-track mechanism of control. First, it analyzes the intra-territorial structural transformations within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR). It explores how localized national security legislation subverts traditional common law presumptions, establishes parallel judicial tracks, and circumvents the proportionality tests domesticated by Article 39 of the Basic Law and the Hong Kong Bill of Rights Ordinance. Second, the paper assesses the external, extraterritorial projection of state power through a dense empirical evaluation of the Islamic Republic of Iran women’s national football team during the 2026 AFC Women's Asian Cup in Australia. It details how the Iranian security apparatus deployed non-lethal, digital, and proxy-based coercion against athletes' domestic families to suppress symbolic speech (Article 19 ICCPR) and force the withdrawal of valid asylum claims (Article 14 UDHR). 
Finally, the study synthesizes these internal and external legal tracks by tracing the restrictive, non-refoulement procedural pipeline of Hong Kong’s Unified Screening Mechanism (USM). It demonstrates how localized judicial activism collapses when intersecting with overriding national security mandates, leaving individuals structurally unprotected by geographic boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了当代国家安全框架如何系统性地碎片化国际人权体系——通过香港的内部司法异化与伊朗对海外运动员的外部权力投射，形成双重压制机制，最终在港统一筛查机制中暴露"执法赤字"：人权在国家安全叙事下被地理边界彻底解构。
AI.research_question: 当代国家安全框架如何系统性地碎片化国际人权架构，导致"执法赤字"——即国家在形式上遵守国际条约的同时，实质上削弱公民自由？
AI.motivation: 揭示国家安全框架与人权保护之间的深层冲突，尤其是当代国家如何通过双重机制（内部司法改造+外部域外权力投射）实现对人权义务的表面遵守与实质规避。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际人权法的"执法赤字"理论；国家安全与人权的二元张力；域外管辖权与国家主权延伸理论；比例原则与司法审查理论。
AI.method: 黑体字法律分析（blackletter legal methodology）与比较案例研究（comparative case-study analysis）。
AI.findings: 1. 香港：国家安全立法颠覆普通法推定，建立平行司法轨道，规避《基本法》第39条及《香港人权法案条例》的比例原则审查；2. 伊朗：在2026年亚足联女子亚洲杯期间，安全机构通过非致命、数字及代理人方式胁迫球员家属，压制象征性言论（《公民权利和政治权利国际公约》第19条），迫使球员撤回有效庇护申请（《世界人权宣言》第14条）；3. 香港统一筛查机制（USM）中的不驱回程序在国家安全指令面前失效，司法能动主义在国家安全议题上全面塌陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了"内部司法改造+外部域外权力投射"的二元分析框架，揭示了国家安全框架下人权保护的地理边界困境，丰富了国际人权法"执法赤字"的理论内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际人权监督机构提供了国家安全与人权冲突的系统性分析工具；警示了"制度内规避"的隐蔽性对人权保护的深层威胁；为跨境人权保护机制的改革提供了实证基础。

title: All in Good Faith…Or So We Wish? Everything That Is Wrong with Voluntary Carbon Markets

detail.title: All in Good Faith…Or So We Wish? Everything That Is Wrong with Voluntary Carbon Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Carbon markets have emerged as a dominant response to the perceived insufficiency of climate action. Yet when the stakes concern the future trajectories of both humanity and the planet, the assumptions underlying such mechanisms warrant careful scrutiny. This essay intentionally adopts a devil’s advocate position to interrogate the credibility of privately regulated Voluntary Carbon Markets (VCMs) against the standards of science, economics, and justice. In doing so, it uses VCMs as a lens through which to engage broader debates in the philosophy of science and technology concerning market rationality, technological solutionism, and the production of climate knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文采用"魔鬼代言人"立场，批判性审视自愿碳市场(VCMs)在科学、经济和正义标准下的可信度，并将其作为探讨市场理性、技术解决方案主义和气候知识生产等更广泛科技哲学议题的透镜。
AI.research_question: 自愿碳市场(VCMs)在科学、经济和正义标准下是否具有可信度？VCMs如何折射出市场理性、技术解决方案主义和气候知识生产等更广泛的科技哲学问题？
AI.motivation: 碳市场已成为应对气候行动不足的主流方案，但其基础假设在关乎人类和地球未来轨迹的重大问题面前值得被严格审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场理性、技术解决方案主义、气候知识生产（科学哲学与科技哲学）
AI.method: 批判性理论分析（魔鬼代言人立场）
AI.findings: 论文从科学、经济和正义三个维度揭示了VCMs面临的可信度挑战，并指出其反映了更深层的市场理性与技术解决方案主义问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将VCMs作为分析透镜，连接了碳市场批判与科学哲学、技术哲学中关于市场理性、技术解决方案主义和气候知识生产更广泛的学术辩论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者和实践者提出警示，要求对碳市场机制的基础假设进行更严格的审视。

title: A Quantitative Analysis of Bangladesh's Oil production Capability through Gas Byproduct & Template For Gas Dependent Economies

detail.title: A Quantitative Analysis of Bangladesh's Oil production Capability through Gas Byproduct & Template For Gas Dependent Economies

declarations.ethicsApproval: I consent

detail.abstract: Bangladesh is facing imminent natural gas exhaustion (8.46 TCF reserves,Q1 2030 depletion) alongside $1.02B annual gasoline import costs amid $20B forex reserves crisis.This study presents the first research on "Oil production from Gas Byproducts in Gas based economies. Transforming 2.68M barrels of naphtha byproduct into high quality OCTANE (A92 / A95). Achieving 16.9% of self sufficiency against 35,000 barrels per day in national demand. Transforms the gas crisis liability into $864M pre-exhaustion revenue, as 66% gas deficit while preserving power to allocation This might as well be First systematic model for gas-dependent economies.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出在天然气依赖型经济中，将天然气副产品（石脑油）转化为高辛烷值汽油（A92/A95）的系统模型。以孟加拉国为例，研究显示该方案可将2.68百万桶石脑油转化为汽油，满足国内16.9%的需求（日产35,000桶），并在天然气枯竭前创造8.64亿美元收入，同时缓解66%的天然气赤字，将危机转化为经济机遇。
AI.research_question: 在天然气依赖型经济中，如何将天然气副产品（石脑油）转化为高辛烷值汽油，以应对天然气枯竭危机并实现能源自给？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国面临天然气即将枯竭（8.46万亿立方英尺储量，预计2030年第一季度耗尽）、每年10.2亿美元的汽油进口成本以及200亿美元外汇储备危机的三重困境，亟需找到替代方案将天然气副产品转化为高价值燃料，实现能源安全和经济收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 天然气依赖型经济中的副产品价值转化理论、能源自给自足模型、天然气枯竭危机管理框架。
AI.method: 基于孟加拉国天然气数据的案例研究，量化分析石脑油副产品转化为汽油的可行性、产出量及经济效益。
AI.findings: 1) 可将2.68百万桶石脑油转化为高辛烷值汽油（A92/A95）；2) 实现国内日均需求35,000桶的16.9%自给率；3) 在天然气枯竭前创造8.64亿美元收入；4) 缓解66%的天然气赤字，同时保障电力分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出针对天然气依赖型经济的"副产品转燃料"系统模型，为资源枯竭型经济体提供理论框架，填补了天然气副产品高价值转化领域的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国及其他天然气依赖型经济体提供可操作的能源转型方案：1) 减少汽油进口依赖，节省外汇；2) 将天然气枯竭危机转化为收入来源；3) 优化天然气资源配置，优先保障电力供应。

title: AI Computing Hardware as an Accounting Asset: Disclosure Framework for Depreciation, Impairment, and Infrastructure Risk

detail.title: AI Computing Hardware as an Accounting Asset: Disclosure Framework for Depreciation, Impairment, and Infrastructure Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, surveys, interviews, experiments, or private identifiable information. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The rapid buildout of artificial intelligence infrastructure has transformed GPUs, TPUs, servers, networking equipment, power systems, and cooling assets from routine technology equipment into strategically significant economic assets. Under current U.S. GAAP, companies generally disclose broad property and equipment categories, depreciation methods, and estimated useful lives, but investors receive limited information about the age, utilization, workload allocation, collateral status, and obsolescence risk of AI computing hardware. This paper develops a conceptual disclosure framework for AI computing hardware and related data center infrastructure. It argues that full fair-value accounting for GPU fleets is not necessary, but that existing disclosures are increasingly insufficient for evaluating impairment indicators, depreciation estimates, collateralized financing, and expected cash flows. The paper proposes a phased disclosure approach that begins in Management's Discussion and Analysis, where management can explain the economic assumptions behind AI infrastructure investment before operational metrics are mature enough for audited PP&E footnotes. The proposed framework emphasizes disaggregation by chip generation, workload category, deployment status, useful-life assumption, utilization, natural-resource constraint, and collateral exposure. By connecting engineering and infrastructure data to financial-reporting judgments, the paper seeks to improve investor understanding of the economics and risks of the AI data center buildout.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个针对AI计算硬件和数据中心基础设施的概念性披露框架，认为现行GAAP下的披露不足以让投资者评估AI基础设施的减值指标、折旧估计、抵押融资和预期现金流，并建议采用分阶段披露方法，从管理层讨论与分析开始，逐步过渡到经审计的固定资产附注。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个概念性披露框架，以改善投资者对AI计算硬件及相关数据中心基础设施的经济特征和风险的理解？
AI.motivation: AI基础设施（GPU、TPU、服务器、网络设备、电源和冷却资产）正从常规技术设备转变为具有战略意义的经济资产，但现行GAAP下的披露方式使投资者难以获取关于其使用年限、利用率、工作负载分配、抵押状态和过时风险等信息，现有披露对评估减值指标、折旧估计、抵押融资和预期现金流日益不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公允价值会计理论、资产减值会计理论、信息披露理论、折旧会计理论
AI.method: 概念性框架构建与理论分析
AI.findings: (1) 对GPU集群进行完全公允价值会计并无必要；(2) 现有披露在评估减值指标、折旧估计、抵押融资和预期现金流方面日益不足；(3) 提出分阶段披露方法：先在MD&A中解释AI基础设施投资的经济假设，待运营指标成熟后再纳入经审计的PP&E附注；(4) 披露重点包括按芯片代际、工作负载类别、部署状态、使用寿命假设、利用率、自然资源约束和抵押风险进行分解。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将工程和基础设施数据与财务报告判断相连接，弥合技术与会计之间的鸿沟；(2) 为AI专用资产这一新兴资产类别建立系统性的披露概念框架；(3) 对公允价值会计在AI硬件资产中的适用边界进行理论界定。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为监管机构（如SEC、FASB）制定AI基础设施披露准则提供参考；(2) 为公司在管理层讨论与分析中披露AI投资假设提供实操指引；(3) 帮助投资者更有效地评估AI基础设施投资的经济实质和风险状况。

title: Selective Index Timing via Probabilistic Gradient Boosting: Evidence from KOSPI 200

detail.title: Selective Index Timing via Probabilistic Gradient Boosting: Evidence from KOSPI 200

keywords: false signal suppression JEL Classification: G11

detail.abstract: Index-level return forecasting is a structurally low signal-to-noise problem: directional accuracy is only marginally above chance even with modern machine learning models, and false defensive signals-months in which the model triggers a position reduction but the market subsequently rises-compound into long-run underperformance. Rather than treating the point forecast as the final object, this paper explores a different question: can a probabilistic ML model's own predictive uncertainty serve as a selective decision filter, determining when its defensive signals should be acted upon and when they should be discarded? This paper introduces a proof-of-concept framework for uncertainty-based selective index timing, which we refer to as Variance-Adaptive Risk Defense (VARD). A single probabilistic gradient boosting model, trained under a Gaussian NLL objective with SGLD posterior sampling, produces-from a single inference call-a directional forecast and two complementary uncertainty estimates: aleatoric uncertainty σ 2 a (irreducible data noise) and epistemic uncertainty σ 2 e (parametric uncertainty from insufficient training signal). Rolling percentile ranks of both components serve as endogenous rejection scores: the strategy executes a defensive allocation only when both ranks fall below a pre-specified threshold, and abstains otherwise. Using KOSPI 200 monthly timing as a low-SNR empirical testbed (136-month expandingwindow OOS, 2015-2026), we show that starting from a direction-only baseline that already contains a weak timing signal, uncertainty-based rejection concentrates the model's 64 defense candidates into 19 retained actions, raising the retained-signal hit rate from 56% to 79%. The ablation decomposition provides evidence that aleatoric and epistemic components capture partially distinct false-signal regimes. The results should be interpreted as a single-market proof of concept rather than evidence of cross-market robustness: VARD refines a weak directional signal by selectively deciding when not to act on it, rather than independently creating a directional timing signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于预测不确定性的选择性择时框架VARD。在指数收益预测这一低信噪比任务中，不直接使用点预测，而是通过概率机器学习模型输出的随机性不确定性和认知不确定性来筛选防御信号，只在模型"确信"时执行减仓操作。在KOSPI 200上的实证表明，该方法将防守信号的命中率从56%提升至79%，同时将64次候选防御行动压缩至19次保留行动。
AI.research_question: 在低信噪比的指数收益预测任务中，能否利用概率机器学习模型自身的预测不确定性作为选择性决策过滤器，判断何时应当执行防守信号、何时应当放弃执行？
AI.motivation: 传统指数择时中的方向预测准确率仅略高于随机水平，且错误的防守信号（市场上涨但模型触发减仓）会带来长期的累积回撤。因此，与其追求更好的点预测，不如探索"何时不行动"这一视角，利用不确定性信息来过滤低置信度的防守信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测不确定性的双组分分解：随机性不确定性（数据固有的不可约噪声）和认知不确定性（模型参数因训练信号不足而产生的不稳定性）。采用滚动百分位数排名作为拒绝分数，只有两种不确定性均低于阈值时才执行防守操作。
AI.method: 以高斯负对数似然为目标函数，结合SGLD后验采样的概率梯度提升模型，一次推理同时输出方向预测和两种不确定性估计。在KOSPI 200月度择时数据上采用136个月扩展窗口样本外测试（2015-2026），通过不确定性阈值筛选防守信号。
AI.findings: 不确定性筛选将64次候选防守行动压缩至19次保留行动，保留信号的命中率从56%提升至79%。消融实验表明，两种不确定性捕获了部分不同的错误信号模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将不确定性量化从模型诊断工具拓展为主动决策过滤器，提出"基于不确定性的选择性执行"这一新概念，并给出了双组分不确定性联合决策的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低信噪比下的指数择时提供了一种不依赖于改进点预测精度的替代路径：通过更少但更可靠的行动来提升整体策略表现。该方法计算成本低（单次推理即可获得所有所需信息），具有实际部署的可行性。

title: Unjust Prices
affiliations: Fordham University School of Law

detail.title: Unjust Prices

keywords: and Hyperdynamic Pricing Evokes Ancient Intuitions About

detail.abstract:
This Essay looks at the moral debate around three new pricing practices that are central to the pricing revolution: surveillance pricing, hyperdynamic pricing, and hyperexperimental pricing, I explore whether the just price tradition, which never fully left us, is present in these debates and what it might have to say about them.

All three forms of pricing, I argue, lie at the extreme on a continuum (dynamic pricing is often embraced; price gouging reviled; experiments loved; hyper-experimentation hated; personal treatment loved; surveillance pricing hated) which make them particularly interesting. Moreover, the fog of prices that results when these practices are braided together may be worthy of independent moral exploration.

I argue that moral intuitions around surveillance pricing echo both major ways of understanding just price theory: they violate the notion that the buyer is getting the common estimation of the worth, and they violate any notion of a tie to cost. The functional secrecy operates as a cousin to fraud, as it is real-time withholding of key information that a buyer would find useful. When it comes to hyperdynamic pricing, the lack of inequality between consumers softens the intuition, but the more that dynamic pricing reveals a disconnect between cost and demand, the less likely it is to be acceptable, and the more it is constant, the more it obscures the possibility of a common estimation price. When it comes to experimentation, the experiments’ intensity and ongoing nature and the intimacy of information used are all qualitative elements that can make experiment unjust because it destroys the possibility of common estimation and it means that most prices are not equal exchanges.

Finally, the braided nature of these practices leads to a fog of prices, in which the use of any technique is itself unclear, and that lack of clarity represents an independent moral harm.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了三种新型定价实践（监控定价、超动态定价、超实验定价）的道德争议，分析"公平价格传统"如何体现在这些争论中，并指出三种定价方式的交织使用会形成"价格迷雾"，构成独立的道德伤害。
AI.research_question: 监控定价、超动态定价和超实验定价这三种新型定价实践存在哪些道德问题？公平价格传统如何理解和评判这些实践？
AI.motivation: 定价革命催生了新型定价实践，引发了道德争议，但缺乏系统的理论框架来审视这些争议背后的道德逻辑。本文希望借助公平价格传统来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公平价格理论（just price theory）：包括"共同估价"（common estimation of worth）和"与成本的关联"（tie to cost）两种理解方式。
AI.method: 规范性道德论证与概念分析。
AI.findings: （1）监控定价侵犯了公平价格的两种核心观念——买方无法获得共同估价，也无法感知价格与成本的关联，其功能性保密类似于欺诈；（2）超动态定价的接受度取决于消费者之间的不平等程度、成本与需求之间的脱节程度以及价格变动的持续性；（3）超实验定价的强度、持续性和信息亲密性会破坏共同估价的可能性，使价格不再是公平交换；（4）三种定价方式交织使用形成"价格迷雾"，构成独立的道德伤害。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经典的公平价格理论重新引入数字时代的定价道德讨论，为理解新型定价实践提供了规范性的理论分析框架，并提出了"价格迷雾"这一新概念作为独立道德伤害类型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和政策制定者评估监控定价、超动态定价和超实验定价的道德边界提供理论依据；提醒消费者和企业关注定价透明度与公平交换的伦理价值。

title: Rawlsianism as Utilitarianism: Weak Semigroup Structures of Individual Values and Social Welfare
affiliations: Northwest University and Northwest University - School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Rawlsianism as Utilitarianism: Weak Semigroup Structures of Individual Values and Social Welfare
detail.abstract: We develop an abstract algebraic theory of weak semigroups as a basic mathematical tool for aggregating individual values into social welfare. When there exists a common individual value space that is a weak fully-rationally-ordered abelian semigroup, the space of value distributions equipped with an anonymous social welfare ordering naturally forms a social value space that is a weak rationally-ordered abelian semigroup. This social value space can never be linearly ordered, even if the common individual value space is Euclidean. Based on the weak semigroup structures of individual and social values, we can reexamine the axiomatic foundations of utilitarianism from an ordinal as well as algebraic perspective. Our analysis reveals that the axiomatization of abstract utilitarianism is quite sensitive to the underlying ordinal and algebraic structures of the common value space. In particular, under the assumptions of anonymity, the Pareto indifference principle, and the weak Pareto principle, utilitarianism over a weak strictlyrationally-ordered abelian semigroup is characterized by monotonicity, while utilitarianism over a weak strictly-rationally-ordered abelian monoid is characterized by translation invariance. Finally, we characterize Rawlsianism over any rationally ordered common value space as a special form of abstract utilitarianism.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了弱半群的抽象代数理论，用于将个体价值聚合为社会福利。通过建立社会价值空间的结构，从序和代数角度重新审视了功利主义和罗尔斯主义的公理化基础。
AI.research_question: 如何利用弱半群的代数结构，从序和代数的视角对功利主义和罗尔斯主义进行公理化刻画？
AI.motivation: 传统福利经济学中价值聚合的公理化方法多基于基数效用假设，本文试图从更基础的序和代数结构出发，为个体价值到社会福利的聚合提供更一般的数学工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弱半群（weak semigroup）理论、弱有理序阿贝尔半群、匿名性、帕累托无差异原则、弱帕累托原则、单调性、平移不变性。
AI.method: 公理化分析与代数推导。在弱半群框架下定义个体价值空间与社会价值空间，推导不同序结构下功利主义和罗尔斯主义的公理条件。
AI.findings: （1）社会价值空间即使个体价值空间为欧几里得空间，也无法线性排序；（2）在弱严格有理序阿贝尔半群上，功利主义由单调性刻画；（3）在弱严格有理序阿贝尔幺半群上，功利主义由平移不变性刻画；（4）罗尔斯主义可被视为抽象功利主义的一种特殊形式。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）发展了弱半群理论作为社会选择与福利经济学的基础工具；（2）揭示了功利主义的公理化对价值空间的序结构与代数结构高度敏感；（3）将罗尔斯主义统一到抽象功利主义的框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社会福利函数的设计提供了更一般的代数与序理论基础，有助于理解不同价值聚合规则（如功利主义与罗尔斯主义）之间的深层联系与适用条件。

title:
A Fokker–Planck Framework for Variance Dynamics:
Structural Reconstruction and Decomposition of Implied Volatility

detail.title:
A Fokker–Planck Framework for Variance Dynamics:
Structural Reconstruction and Decomposition of Implied Volatility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available financial market data and does not involve human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently by the author through Quant Finance Lab Kagoshima (QFLK) and received no external funding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个数学框架，通过定义基于已实现方差（RV）与隐含波动率（IV）关系的状态变量，并建模其Fokker-Planck型随机过程，从结构上解释隐含波动率的生成机制，将IV从外生预测目标重构为可由价格方差动态内生解释的变量。
AI.research_question: 隐含波动率（IV）的内部结构及其生成机制是什么？如何从数学上显式描述IV与已实现方差（RV）之间的动态关系？
AI.motivation: 传统上隐含波动率主要被视为预测目标，但其内在结构和底层动态机制尚不明确。本文试图从结构性角度解释IV的生成过程，而非仅将其作为外生市场指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: Fokker-Planck型随机过程；均值回复随机过程；状态依赖扩散模型；平稳分布理论。
AI.method: 定义状态变量 x_t = log(RV_t / IV_t)，假设其服从具有均值回复性和状态依赖扩散的随机过程；使用美国权益市场SPY数据和VIX指数进行参数估计；检验理论推导的平稳分布与经验分布的一致性。
AI.findings: 所提出的框架成功捕捉了IV与RV之间关系的基本动态；模型实现了IV的结构性分解，可拆分为系统性成分（由RV-IV动态隐含的结构波动）和残差成分（动态风险溢价，反映市场情绪、供需失衡和非线性风险感知）；IV应被视为可由价格方差动态内生重构的变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出基于RV-IV关系的结构性IV生成机制框架；将IV从外生预测目标重新定义为内生变量，为波动率动态提供了新的理论基础；通过Fokker-Planck过程将波动率动态与平稳分布理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险管理、波动率建模和动态资产配置提供了新的理论工具；结构性分解IV的方法有助于区分系统性波动成分与市场情绪驱动的风险溢价成分。

title: Association for the Promotion of Political Economy and the Law (APPEAL): Transforming Law and Economic Power
affiliations: University at Buffalo Law School

detail.title: Association for the Promotion of Political Economy and the Law (APPEAL): Transforming Law and Economic Power

publicationDetails.detailsText: University at Buffalo School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2025-025
publicationDetails.journalName: University at Buffalo School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Law and Political Economy, volume 4, issue 1, 2023[10.5070/LP64162693]

detail.abstract: This article reflects on the Association for the Promotion of Political Economy and Law (APPEAL), formed in 2012 as the first contemporary scholarly group named for the emerging field of Law and Political Economy (LPE). APPEAL organizes academics and allies to address urgent social problems by exploring possibilities for reorienting the economy toward justice, equality, and democracy. To mobilize ideas for change, APPEAL emphasizes collaborative intellectual communities. I situate APPEAL in the context of a neoliberal political movement to capture law's power by investing in the Law and Economics message that economic power inevitably limits democracy and social justice. Though vastly outmatched in funding, APPEAL brings together experts in economics, law, and other disciplines to clarify and change influential neoliberal ideas about both law and economics. I highlight APPEAL participants' scholarship showing the interconnected social, political, and legal nature of economic power as the basis for transforming economic politics and policy.

AI.tldr: 本文反思了2012年成立的APPEAL组织，该组织是法律与政治经济学（LPE）领域的首个当代学术团体。APPEAL通过构建合作性学术社群，组织学者和盟友应对紧迫社会问题，探索将经济重新导向正义、平等与民主的可能性。文章将APPEAL置于新自由主义政治运动的背景下，该运动通过投资"法律与经济学"话语——即经济权力必然限制民主与社会正义——来捕获法律的力量。尽管资金远不及对方，APPEAL仍汇聚经济学、法学等多学科专家，澄清并改变新自由主义关于法律与经济的有影响力的观念。文章强调APPEAL参与者的学术成果揭示了经济权力的社会性、政治性和法律性相互关联的本质，以此作为转变经济政治与政策的基础。
AI.research_question: APPEAL学术组织如何通过构建合作性知识社群，在资源悬殊的条件下挑战新自由主义"法律与经济学"话语，并重新构想法律、经济与民主之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 新自由主义政治运动通过推动"法律与经济学"范式，塑造了"经济权力必然限制民主与社会正义"的支配性叙事，从而捕获了法律的力量。面对这一失衡局面，需要反思如何组织学术力量，提出替代性方案，将经济重新导向正义、平等与民主。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与政治经济学（LPE）视角；新自由主义批判理论；法律与经济学运动的意识形态分析；知识社群与学术动员理论。
AI.method: 反思性/自反性组织分析（reflective organizational analysis），结合对APPEAL组织历程的梳理及其参与者学术成果的评述。
AI.findings: 1. APPEAL通过构建合作性学术社群，有效组织了多学科专家挑战新自由主义法律与经济观念。2. 尽管资金远不及新自由主义法律与经济学运动，APPEAL仍通过学术协作产生了重要影响。3. APPEAL参与者的研究表明，经济权力本质上是社会性、政治性和法律性相互建构的，这为转变经济政治与政策提供了理论基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 为法律与政治经济学（LPE）领域提供了组织层面的实证反思；揭示了知识生产组织（如APPEAL）在挑战主流学术范式中的作用机制；阐明了经济权力的社会-政治-法律三位一体性质，丰富了法律与政治经济学的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学者和活动家提供了如何组织学术力量以对抗资源雄厚的新自由主义话语体系的实践策略；展示了跨学科合作在重塑经济政策讨论中的可行性；为构建更民主、公正的经济秩序提供了知识动员的组织范式。

title: Explaining the Historical Rise and Recent Decline in Social Security Disability Insurance Enrollment
affiliations: University of Chicago, University of Oslo - Department of Economics and University of Chicago

detail.title: Explaining the Historical Rise and Recent Decline in Social Security Disability Insurance Enrollment

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-73
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: After substantial growth in the 1990s and 2000s, enrollment in the U.S. Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) program has been declining since 2013. We use detailed administrative data to quantify the contributions of various factors to trends in SSDI enrollment, focusing especially on the decline in the 2010s. A statistical decomposition suggests that the vast majority of the decline in SSDI enrollment since 2013 is attributable to declines in application rates-and, to a lesser extent, award rates-within demographic groups. There is very little contribution from changes over time in demographic characteristics, eligibility, or exit from SSDI. The decline in SSDI enrollment rates is disproportionately driven by low-to-middle-skilled men who, over time, have become less likely to apply for SSDI and more likely to work. Consistent with this descriptive evidence, we present results from a causal analysis suggesting that improved labor market opportunity for less-skilled men is a key explanation for the decline in SSDI enrollment. We also investigate several other popular hypotheses for the decline in SSDI applications, including lower award rates at the appeals level, and find evidence at odds with them.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国SSDI行政数据，发现2013年以来该项目注册人数下降的主要原因是申请率下降（尤其是低技能男性），而劳动力市场改善是关键驱动因素，其他流行假说缺乏证据支持。
AI.research_question: 2013年以来美国SSDI注册人数下降的主要驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: SSDI项目在1990-2000年代经历了大幅增长后，2013年起出现持续下降，理解这一转折的原因对社会保障政策和劳动力市场研究具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人口统计分解框架，将SSDI注册率的变化分解为申请率、批准率、退出率以及人口结构变化等要素，结合劳动力市场机会假说进行因果分析。
AI.method: 使用详细行政数据进行统计分解，结合描述性证据和因果分析（针对低技能男性劳动力市场机会改善），并对其他竞争性假说进行检验。
AI.findings: 2013年以来SSDI注册下降几乎完全归因于人口组内申请率下降（以及较小程度的批准率下降），人口结构变化贡献极小；低至中等技能男性是下降的主要驱动群体，他们申请减少且就业增加；因果分析表明劳动力市场机会改善是关键解释；其他假说（如上诉阶段批准率下降）缺乏证据支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统量化了SSDI注册下降的多重因素贡献，首次通过因果识别证实了劳动力市场机会改善对伤残保险申请减少的驱动作用，反驳了其他流行解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SSDI政策评估提供了实证依据，表明改善低技能群体就业机会可有效降低伤残保险依赖，对社会保障制度改革具有政策启示。

reference: Contract Management, NCMA, May/June 2026, pp. 24-33; GWU Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-43; GWU Law School Public Law Research Paper No. 2026-43
title: The Story of FAR Part 12: From Origin to Overhaul
affiliations: George Washington University - Professorial Lecturers

detail.title: The Story of FAR Part 12: From Origin to Overhaul

keywords: the Federal Acquisition Streamlining Act of 1994
the Competition in Contracting Act of 1984 (CICA)
Simplified Procedures for Certain Commercial Items

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-43
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Law School Public Law Research Paper No. 2026-43
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
As a drafter of Part 12, I examine the regulation on Commercial Acquisitions in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) from its origins to the changes proposed by the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO).  The article is divided into: issues writing Part 12, the maintenance of Part 12, and the RFO proposed changes. 

Issues drafting Part 12:  The section is limited to:
Individuals with expertise in Simplified Acquisition and individuals with expertise in Major Systems Acquisition drafted Part 12.  The Simplified Acquisition group focused on volume, while the Major Systems group focused on individual contracts for high-dollar purchases.  The Simplified Acquisition group created the SF 1449 for small-dollar buys; the Major System group agreed to require only the SF 1449. 

The definition of Commercial Items in the Federal Acquisition Streamlining Act (FASA):  This definition includes more than one type of product and commercial services.  Well-developed commercial marketplaces with multiple sellers adequately protect buyers.  However, buyer protections may be weakened when acquiring newly offered items or items with unique governmental modifications. So, Part 12 was written for commercial products that are most like Commercial-off-the-Shelf (COTS) items.  Also, Part 12 was not written for the acquisition of commercial services.     

Terms and conditions (T&Cs):   No standard set of T&Cs exists in the commercial marketplace.  The relative strength of buyers and sellers controls T&Cs.  Also, different commercial markets have different T&Cs.  FAR 52.212-4, Contract Terms and Conditions-Commercial Items, balances seller and buyer commercial T&Cs, concepts from FAR clauses, and principles from the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) to create a generic clause for commercial products.   Tailoring allows contracting officers to modify FAR 52.212-4 for a particular marketplace without deviations; waivers limit the addition of T&Cs inconsistent with the commercial marketplace practices.

Maintenance of Part 12:  The FAR Council limited the flexibility of Part 12  by adding tables to Part 12 that appear to constraint tailoring. The FAR Council also placed the explanation of the flexibilities of Subpart 13.5, Simplified Procedures for Certain Commercial Items, in a Federal Register Notice and not the FAR.  Subpart 13.5 is an “other competitive procedure” that qualifies as “full and open” competition. 

Revolutionary FAR Overhaul: The delight of discovering Subpart 13.5 caused the RFO to conflate selected procedures from Part 13 into Part 12 and then limit Part 13 to noncommercial acquisitions.  Instead, Part 12 should contain policies unique to Commercial acquisitions and allow contracting officers to use any available procedure in the FAR.  The procedures mandated by the Competition in Contracting Act (CICA), not the FAR, create the hated complexity of government competitions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了《联邦采购条例》第12部分（商业采购）的起草、维护及拟议改革，分析了简化采购与主要系统采购两大群体的分歧，以及商业项目定义、条款与条件的制定逻辑，并批评了"革命性FAR改革"中混淆程序的做法。
AI.research_question: FAR第12部分（商业采购法规）在起草、维护和改革过程中存在哪些问题？如何改进？
AI.motivation: FAR第12部分自制定以来存在定义模糊、条款灵活性受限、程序混淆等问题，影响商业采购效率，作者作为起草者从亲历者视角揭示内在矛盾并推动改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦采购法规体系（FAR）、商业项目定义（FASA）、合同条款与条件平衡理论、统一商法典（UCC）原则、竞争性采购程序理论（CICA）。
AI.method: 法规分析兼参与式观察——作者作为FAR第12部分起草者，基于起草经历和法规文本分析进行论述。
AI.findings: 1) 起草群体分歧：简化采购组重数量，主要系统组重单笔高额采购；2) 商业项目定义过宽，但第12部分实际只适用于最接近现成商用（COTS）的产品，未覆盖商业服务；3) 条款与条件（FAR 52.212-4）试图平衡各方利益但缺乏统一标准；4) FAR委员会通过增加表格限制了第12部分的灵活性；5) RFO改革错误地将第13部分程序并入第12部分，实际复杂性源自《竞争合同法》（CICA）而非FAR本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了商业采购法规制定过程中群体博弈对规则设计的影响；澄清了FAR程序复杂性的真正来源（CICA而非FAR）；提出了商业采购法规应保留程序使用灵活性的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为FAR第12部分的修订提供历史依据和改进方向；建议第12部分仅包含商业采购特有政策，允许合同官自由使用FAR中任何可用程序；提醒政策制定者避免将程序混搭导致更大混乱。

reference: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-72
title: Serial Innovators
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics

detail.title: Serial Innovators

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-72
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: A select group of great innovators have produced more than one major contribution. These exceptional individuals are known far beyond their own disciplines, and are routinely described as unique. Yet although their extraordinary accomplishments obviously make them outliers, the processes by which they arrive at their discoveries follow patterns that are shared by innovators more generally. This paper examines these patterns for six great serial innovators of the modern era: the experimental Henry Ford, who worked tirelessly by trial and error to make better cars more efficiently, and the conceptual Albert Einstein, Pablo Picasso, Walt Disney, Miles Davis, and Steve Jobs, who formulated surprising new ideas and products by connecting previously unrelated elements. These contrasting methods of discovery resulted in sharply contrasting life cycles of creativity, as Einstein, Picasso, Disney, Davis, and Jobs all made major contributions during their 20s, but Ford did not make his first great innovation until he was 45.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了六位伟大序列式创新者（亨利·福特、爱因斯坦、毕加索、迪士尼、迈尔斯·戴维斯、乔布斯）的创新模式，发现实验型（福特）与概念型（其他五位）创新者有着截然不同的创造力生命周期。
AI.research_question: 伟大的序列式创新者（多次做出重大贡献的杰出人物）是如何实现创新的？实验型与概念型创新者的创造力生命周期有何不同？
AI.motivation: 尽管这些序列式创新者被视为"独一无二"的 outlier，但他们抵达发现的路径可能遵循可辨识的普遍模式。现有研究往往关注单次重大创新，忽视了多次重大贡献者背后的共性规律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实验型创新（trial and error，逐步试错改进）与概念型创新（连接先前不相关的元素，产生突破性新想法）的二元框架。
AI.method: 对六位序列式创新者的历史案例比较分析，聚焦其创新方法与创造力生命周期的差异。
AI.findings: 实验型创新者（福特）的创造力周期较晚，45岁才做出首次重大创新；概念型创新者（爱因斯坦、毕加索、迪士尼、戴维斯、乔布斯）均在20多岁做出主要贡献。两种不同的发现方法导致了截然不同的创造力生命周期。
AI.theory_contributions: 将创新者区分为"实验型"与"概念型"两种认知风格，并系统论证了这两种风格与创造力生命周期（早熟 vs. 晚成）之间的因果关联，拓展了对杰出创新者异质性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织和个人提供了识别和培养不同类型创新人才的启示：实验型创新需要长期积累与耐心投入，概念型创新则应重视年轻时的跨界思维与灵感涌现。

title: Hedge Funds through Tough Times
affiliations: University of Trento - Department of Economics and Management and University of Trento - Department of Economics and Management

detail.title: Hedge Funds through Tough Times

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: Refer to the manuscript.

detail.abstract: This study is motivated by the lack of proper study on estimating unconditional, direct, and time-varying tails for Hedge funds (HFs). Using an autoregressive conditional Fréchet model, we first estimate the asymmetric timevarying right and left tails for four HFs' strategies during 2005-2025. The left tails' reactions to the market crises suggest poor market timing in HFs, with the 2008 crisis generating the greatest tail jump. We then employ a time-varying parameter vector autoregression to study the response of HFs' left tail and performance to shocks in VIX, repo rate, Amihud liquidity, and real economic expectations. We compare the left tail responses to macroeconomic shocks of September 2008, February 2020 and September 2022. The results point to persistent homogeneous exposure to market crises. We also find that the 2022 crisis has a longer-lasting impact on HFs' tails, compared to the 2008 or 2020 crisis, implying lower resilience in the HF industry. The liquidity shocks take the longest to dissipate, and positive repo shocks curb the left tails acting as a buffer against market crises. Since 2022, repo shocks trigger greater responses in HFs' performance. While Equity Hedge benefits from turbulent market, calm market drives up Event-driven performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用自回归条件Fréchet模型和时变参数向量自回归模型，分析了2005-2025年间四种对冲基金策略的非对称时变尾部风险，以及尾部风险对宏观经济冲击的响应。研究发现：对冲基金在历次危机中表现出持续的同质化风险暴露，2022年危机影响最为持久，流动性冲击消散最慢，而回购利率正向冲击能缓冲尾部风险。
AI.research_question: 对冲基金的无条件、直接和时变尾部风险如何估计？其对宏观经济冲击的响应模式如何？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对对冲基金无条件、直接和时变尾部风险的恰当估计，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自回归条件Fréchet模型（估计时变尾部）；时变参数向量自回归模型（分析尾部对宏观冲击的响应）。
AI.method: 首先用自回归条件Fréchet模型估计2005-2025年间四种对冲基金策略的左右尾时变特征；然后用时变参数向量自回归模型分析尾部风险及绩效对VIX、回购利率、Amihud流动性指标和实体经济预期的冲击响应。
AI.findings: （1）左尾对市场危机的反应表明对冲基金市场择时能力较差，2008年危机产生最大尾部跳跃；（2）对2022年9月、2020年2月和2008年9月三次危机的比较显示，2022年危机对对冲基金尾部影响更持久，行业韧性下降；（3）流动性冲击消散最慢；（4）正向回购利率冲击能缓冲尾部风险；（5）2022年以来回购冲击对绩效影响更大；（6）权益对冲基金受益于动荡市场，而事件驱动型基金在平静市场中表现更好。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将自回归条件Fréchet模型与时变参数向量自回归模型结合，系统刻画对冲基金尾部风险的时变特征及其对宏观冲击的非线性响应机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为对冲基金投资者和监管者提供尾部风险预警信号，揭示了不同危机环境下对冲基金行业韧性的变化规律，以及回购利率作为危机缓冲工具的作用。

title: The Daughters of Disaster: Famine, Gender Preferences, and Cohort Sex Ratios in China
affiliations: Peking University - Guanghua School of Management

detail.title: The Daughters of Disaster: Famine, Gender Preferences, and Cohort Sex Ratios in China
detail.abstract: Disasters can reshape social preferences in ways that persist long after the immediate crisis has passed. This paper studies whether China's Great Famine, from 1959 to 1961, durably shifted family preferences toward daughters. Using prefecture-by-cohort sex ratios from the 1990 Census, I find that famine severity predicts lower sex ratios primarily among post-famine cohorts born from 1963 to 1970, not only among famine-born cohorts. This pattern is robust to alternative famine measures, province exclusions, and migration corrections. Fertility histories show that women from harder-hit areas reported fewer sons among both births and surviving children, with postnatal losses rising more for boys. A nationally representative social survey reveals that respondents in more affected areas express stronger daughter preferences, without a corresponding shift toward broader gender egalitarianism. These findings show that catastrophic shocks can reshape child-gender valuation, generating persistent daughter preference in China despite its long-standing son preference.

AI.tldr: 本文发现中国大饥荒（1959-1961）持久地改变了家庭对女儿的偏好，饥荒严重程度较高的地区在饥荒后出生队列（1963-1970）中出现了更低的性别比（即更多女孩），且这种效应源于对女儿偏好的增强，而非整体性别平等观念的提升。
AI.research_question: 中国大饥荒是否以及如何持久地改变了家庭对女儿的偏好？
AI.motivation: 灾难可能重塑社会偏好并长期持续，但现有文献缺乏对重大历史灾难如何影响子女性别偏好的研究，尤其是在中国这个长期存在强烈"男孩偏好"的社会中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾难冲击与社会偏好重塑理论、子女性别偏好形成机制、代际传递效应
AI.method: 使用1990年人口普查的地级市-队列层面的性别比数据，结合饥荒严重程度的代理变量进行实证分析；辅以生育史数据和社会调查数据进行机制检验。
AI.findings: 饥荒严重程度显著预测了更低的性别比（即更多女孩），这一效应主要体现在1963-1970年的饥荒后出生队列，而非仅在饥荒期间出生的人群。受饥荒影响更严重的女性生育的儿子更少（包括出生数和存活数），且男孩的产后损失更高。受影响地区的受访者表现出更强的女儿偏好，但并未伴随整体性别平等观念的提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统证明了重大灾难冲击可以持久改变子女性别偏好，挑战了"男孩偏好"是根深蒂固文化特征的既有认知；揭示了偏好变化的代际传递机制而非简单的人口构成效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国性别比失衡的历史根源提供了新视角，对人口政策制定及灾后人道主义干预的长期社会影响评估具有政策启示。

title: When Work Becomes Non-Viable: Cost-of-Participation Shocks and Systemic Labor Contraction

detail.title: When Work Becomes Non-Viable: Cost-of-Participation Shocks and Systemic Labor Contraction
detail.abstract:
Labor-market stability can mask a constraint when participation costs rise faster than returns to labor. This study introduces an SIR-macro framework to model Resource Lock, a threshold where work becomes financially non-viable for workers near subsistence margins. Using observed retail pricing across all 50 states in the United States, the framework links cost shocks to labor withdrawal, economic contraction, and permanent exit.

The system yields a combined Q3–Q4 2026 GDP decay of $257.4 billion, with $75.7 billion direct and $181.7 billion indirect, indicating that most contraction arises through downstream propagation. The model identifies 1.2 million permanent exits and a $105 billion productivity loss, concentrated in Tier I states.

These results suggest labor participation can shift discretely under cost pressure, producing nonlinear withdrawal, system-wide losses, and structural scarring while linking retail price dynamics to macroeconomic outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"资源锁定"（Resource Lock）概念，指当参与成本上升速度快于劳动回报时，工作变得财务上不可行，导致劳动力退出、经济收缩和永久性退出。基于美国50州零售价格数据，SIR-宏观框架预测2026年Q3-Q4 GDP下降2574亿美元，120万永久退出，1050亿美元生产力损失，主要集中在Tier I州。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场稳定性如何掩盖参与成本上升快于劳动回报时的约束机制？"资源锁定"如何通过零售价格冲击影响劳动力退出和经济产出？
AI.motivation: 传统劳动力市场分析关注失业率和工资水平，但忽略了接近生存线的工人在成本快速上升时可能非线性退出劳动市场，产生系统性经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: SIR-宏观框架（SIR-macro framework）、资源锁定（Resource Lock）阈值模型、非线性劳动力退出理论、下游传播（downstream propagation）机制。
AI.method: 构建SIR-宏观框架建模资源锁定；使用美国50州零售价格观测数据；通过成本冲击与劳动力退出、经济收缩和永久性退出的关联进行仿真模拟。
AI.findings: Q3-Q4 2026年GDP衰减2574亿美元（直接757亿，间接1817亿）；120万永久性劳动力退出；1050亿美元生产力损失；收缩主要来自下游传播效应；影响集中在Tier I州。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"资源锁定"概念解释劳动力参与在成本压力下的离散跳跃性变化；建立非线性退出与系统性损失的微观-宏观联系；将零售价格动态与宏观经济结果进行理论链接。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别劳动力退出阈值提供分析工具；提示应关注零售价格波动对劳动力市场的间接和系统性影响；指出Tier I州作为风险集中区域需重点干预。

title: Impacts of Dobbs v. Jackson on Medical Residency Training

detail.title: Impacts of Dobbs v. Jackson on Medical Residency Training

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Publicly available data, deemed exempt by Johns Hopkins University Institutional Review Board.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Using national data on outcomes of the National Resident Matching Program between 2019-2024 and a difference-in-differences approach, this study examines the effects of state abortion restrictions enabled by the US Supreme Court Decision in Dobbs v. Jackson on the supply of medical residents to training programs located in states restricting abortion. There was a significant decline in the supply of medical residents to abortion restricting states, primarily among those training in obstetrics and gynecology. Less able to fill quotas for new residents, residency programs entered subsequent Match cycles with smaller quotas and relied on comparatively less-competitive applicants to fill them. The share of female residents practicing in restrictive states also declined with the exception of more prestigious hospitals, which maintained similar cohort sex composition pre-post restriction. Findings carry both short and long-term implications for care access. Residents are a key provider for vulnerable populations, commonly staffing free and student-run clinics and taking on large shares of Medicaid and charity care patients in hospital settings, and, residency location is highly predictive of future practice patterns, so impacts on resident labor can drive long term consequences for future provider availability. Incentive programs such as loan repayment and location-specific subsidies may be useful tools in correcting reductions in the resident workforce across states where abortion is illegal.

AI.tldr: 2019-2024年美国全国住院医师匹配数据表明，Dobbs判决后实施堕胎限制的州出现了住院医师供给显著下降，尤其是妇产科领域；这些州的住院医师项目在后续匹配中不得不缩小配额并招收竞争力较弱的申请者。
AI.research_question: Dobbs案判决后，州级堕胎限制政策对美国住院医师（medical residents）在限制堕胎州的供给产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: Dobbs案推翻了罗诉韦德案，各州堕胎政策出现分化。住院医师是弱势群体医疗服务的重要提供者且未来执业地点高度受训地点影响，了解堕胎限制对医学劳动力供给的影响对医疗服务可及性具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力供给理论、医师人力资本迁移理论、政策对医疗劳动力市场的冲击效应
AI.method: 双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），使用2019-2024年全国住院医师匹配项目（NRMP）全国数据
AI.findings: (1)堕胎限制州的住院医师供给显著下降，以妇产科最为明显；(2)限制州的项目在后续匹配轮次中缩小了配额，且招收了竞争性较弱的申请者；(3)限制州中女性住院医师比例下降，但声望较高的医院除外；(4)这些效应具有短期和长期的影响，因为住院医师执业地点高度预测未来行医地点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政策冲击（堕胎限制）与医学人力资本的地理分布联系起来，拓展了劳动力迁移与医疗政策交叉领域的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了堕胎限制对医疗劳动力供给的负面影响，提出了贷款偿还和地区专项补贴等激励政策作为潜在纠正工具，为医疗政策制定者提供了重要的实证依据。

title: Evaluating the Consequences of a Hypertension Management Incentive
affiliations: McGill University and Providence Medical Research Center - Providence Research Network

detail.title: Evaluating the Consequences of a Hypertension Management Incentive

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare they have no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was approved by Providence's institutional review board (#2023000198).
declarations.funderStatement: Fonds de recherche du Québec #367672 (CB).

detail.abstract:
Question: Did a physician quality metric and financial incentive for hypertension control improve clinical care and patient health? 

Findings: In this observational, difference-in-differences study, the financial incentive increased blood pressure re-measurement-an increase in guideline adherence-with no other impacts in the overall hypertensive population. Among patients with marginally high blood pressure, the financial incentive increased blood pressure re-measurement which improved documented rates of hypertension control, but also reduced medication adjustments and increased hospitalizations for acute cardiovascular events. 

Meaning: While the hypertension control financial incentive improved guideline adherent blood pressure measurement, it produced unintended harms for patients at the treatment margin.

AI.tldr: 一项观察性研究表明，针对高血压控制的财务激励措施虽改善了指南依从性的血压复测，但在治疗边缘患者中却减少了药物调整并增加了急性心血管事件的住院率，产生了意想不到的伤害。
AI.research_question: 针对高血压控制的医生质量指标和财务激励是否改善了临床护理和患者健康？
AI.motivation: 评估财务激励措施在真实医疗环境中对高血压控制的实际效果，特别是识别其潜在的意外后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于激励理论、指南依从性理论和临床决策理论，探讨财务激励对医生行为及患者健康结果的影响机制。
AI.method: 观察性、双重差分（difference-in-differences）研究设计。
AI.findings: 财务激励增加了血压复测（指南依从性提高），但对整体高血压人群无其他影响。在血压偏高的边缘患者中，激励增加了复测率并改善了高血压控制率，但减少了药物调整，并增加了急性心血管事件的住院率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了财务激励在改善过程指标（如复测）的同时，可能在治疗边缘患者中产生非预期的负面健康结果，丰富了激励理论在医疗领域的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者和医疗管理者在设计和实施基于质量的财务激励计划时，需关注其对边缘患者的潜在负面影响，避免为追求指标达标而牺牲患者健康。

reference: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-021
title: Environmental Ambition and Economic Protectionism: The Design of Border Carbon Adjustments
affiliations: ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research, ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research and Carnegie Mellon University

detail.title: Environmental Ambition and Economic Protectionism: The Design of Border Carbon Adjustments

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-021
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Border carbon adjustments (BCAs) are intended to limit carbon leakage while protecting domestic industry, but governments differ over whether border charges should price total embodied emissions or only emissions above an intensity benchmark. We study this design choice in a plant level general equilibrium model of the global steel industry with heterogeneous technologies and vertical supply chains. A rate-based BCA is equivalent to an emissions charge combined with an implicit output subsidy. It therefore weakens the carbon-price signal, encourages reshuffling of cleaner output toward the regulated market, and can induce leakage through underpriced carbon-intensive intermediates. In an EU-style setting with domestic carbon pricing, the rate-based design transmits only 36% of the mass-based border price needed to achieve the same global emissions reduction and yields larger welfare losses. In a US-style setting without a domestic carbon-price anchor, it mainly shifts rents toward domestic downstream industries rather than inducing abatement abroad.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了边境碳调整（BCA）的两种设计——基于总排放量的"质量型"与基于排放强度基准的"比率型"，利用钢铁行业企业层面一般均衡模型，发现比率型BCA相当于排放收费加隐性产出补贴，会削弱碳价信号、引发清洁产出再分配和碳泄漏，在EU和US两种政策背景下均表现不佳。
AI.research_question: 边境碳调整（BCA）的不同设计（基于总排放量的质量型 vs. 基于排放强度基准的比率型）对碳泄漏、减排效果和福利影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 各国对BCA的设计存在分歧，但缺乏对不同设计经济效应的系统性比较研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业层面一般均衡模型，纳入异质性技术、垂直供应链和全球钢铁行业特征。
AI.method: 构建钢铁行业企业层面一般均衡模型，模拟分析质量型与比率型BCA在不同政策背景（EU式国内碳定价 vs. US式无国内碳价）下的效果。
AI.findings: (1) 比率型BCA=排放收费+隐性产出补贴，削弱碳价信号；(2) 鼓励清洁产出向受监管市场再分配；(3) 通过低价碳密集型中间品引发泄漏；(4) EU情境下，比率型仅传递质量型边境价格36%的减排效果，且福利损失更大；(5) US情境下，主要向国内下游行业转移租金，而非促进国外减排。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了比率型BCA的隐性补贴机制及其对碳价信号的扭曲，提供了两种BCA设计在异质性企业框架下的比较分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国（尤其是EU和US）选择BCA设计提供了政策参考，指出基于总排放量的质量型BCA在减排效果上优于基于强度基准的比率型。

title: The Pink Tax a Hidden Violation of Constitutional and Consumer
affiliations: DES Shri Navalmal Firodia Law College

detail.title: The Pink Tax a Hidden Violation of Constitutional and Consumer
detail.abstract: You might have heard a lot about the inequality's women have to face at various places which even include their own homes. But today in this article we are going to talk about women's inequality or gender inequality which is related to Business and Money. You might know about Income tax, corporate tax, and even Toll Tax but do you know about 'Pink Tax'? In this article, we are going to research on whom the Pink tax is imposed, how it is imposed, and who has to pay the tax. We are also going to be aware of how this Pink Tax is looting women. The word 'Loot' is used here because the Pink tax is not a government tax, this clearly means that the government body does not issue this tax but instead, it is a term of Retail Market which is only imposed on women. The shocking thing is that women do not even know that such a type of tax exists. They have no idea about how this tax is looting them. They are not even aware of when, where, and how they are paying this pink tax. Let's understand the 'Pink Tax' in this article.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了"粉红税"（Pink Tax）现象，即零售市场中基于性别对女性产品征收的隐性价格溢价，并非政府法定税收，而是一种市场定价歧视，且多数女性对此毫无察觉。
AI.research_question: 粉红税是什么？向谁征收？如何征收？谁在支付？以及它是如何"掠夺"女性的？
AI.motivation: 揭示女性在消费中面临的无意识性别价格歧视，提高公众（尤其是女性消费者）对粉红税的认知，指出这一隐性"税收"对女性经济利益的侵害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别定价歧视理论、市场细分与价格差异化、消费者认知偏差。
AI.method: 概念分析与现象描述研究，尚未提及严格实证方法。
AI.findings: 粉红税并非政府税收，而是零售市场针对女性产品的隐性加价；大多数女性对此税的存在及支付毫无意识。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确区分粉红税与政府法定税收的概念差异，系统界定粉红税的定义、征收对象及运作机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 唤醒女性消费者对隐性价格歧视的认知，为消费者维权和市场监管提供启示，促进公平定价。

title: Remedies in EU Competition Law: Between Caution, Creativity and Structural Change
affiliations: Tilburg Law and Economics Center (TILEC)

detail.title: Remedies in EU Competition Law: Between Caution, Creativity and Structural Change
detail.abstract: Remedies are central to EU competition law enforcement: without them, identifying anticompetitive conduct is largely futile. Yet the Commission's remedial record in digital markets-exemplified by Microsoft, Google Shopping, and Google Androidreveals a systematic failure of the principles-based, behavioural approach it has long preferred. This article examines the legal framework under Regulation 1/2003, reviews the Commission's enforcement record, considers reform proposals from the academic literature, and argues that the Google AdTech proceedings illustrate why structural intervention has become unavoidable. It concludes with legislative and procedural recommendations.

AI.tldr: 本文指出欧盟委员会在数字市场（如微软、Google Shopping、Google Android）的补救措施执行中存在系统性失败，论证结构性干预已不可避免，并提出立法和程序建议。
AI.research_question: 欧盟竞争法在数字市场的补救措施为何失效？结构性干预是否已成为必要手段？
AI.motivation: 欧盟委员会在数字市场长期偏好基于原则的行为性补救措施，但实际执行效果不佳，亟需审视现行法律框架并提出改革方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟竞争法第1/2003号条例下的法律框架；行为性救济与结构性救济的区分理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例回顾（Microsoft、Google Shopping、Google Android）、学术文献综述、个案分析（Google AdTech）。
AI.findings: 原则性/行为性补救措施在数字市场系统性失败；Google AdTech案表明结构性干预已不可避免。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字市场竞争法中的补救措施选择提供理论依据，论证结构性救济的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出欧盟竞争法补救措施的立法与程序性改革建议，对执法实践具有直接指导意义。

title: Buying Stability: Civil Service Quotas and Elite Co-optation in Imperial China
affiliations: Peking University - Guanghua School of Management and Peking University - Guanghua School of Management

detail.title: Buying Stability: Civil Service Quotas and Elite Co-optation in Imperial China
detail.abstract: How do autocratic states buy political stability from elites, and what are the long-run costs? This paper examines the social and political consequences of the 1427 regional quota reform in the Ming Civil Service Examination System. Using a prefecture-level difference-in-differences design, we show that quota expansion increased social mobility and exam access, but lowered admission quality. The additional quotas were disproportionately absorbed by historically strong prefectures and local elites, suggesting elite co-optation. Quota expansion reduced elite-led rebellions in the short run, while having little effect on peasant uprisings. Extending the analysis to the full Ming dynasty, we find a dynamic reversal pattern. Regions receiving larger quota increases experienced more peasant uprisings in the late Ming, and this pattern remains robust to alternative prefecture-level exposure measures. Place based quotas helped the Ming state buy elite stability, but this political bargain may have shifted the costs of maintaining order onto ordinary peasants and contributed to long run popular instability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了明朝1427年科举配额改革对政治稳定的影响。研究发现，配额扩大增加了社会流动性和考试机会，但降低了录取质量；额外配额被历史强府和本地精英不成比例地吸收，实现了精英共选；短期内减少了精英领导的叛乱，但对农民起义影响不大；长期来看，获得更多配额的地区在明朝晚期经历了更多农民起义。地域配额帮助明朝政府买来了精英稳定，但这种政治交易可能将维持秩序的成本转移到了普通农民身上，导致了长期的民间不稳定。
AI.research_question: 专制国家如何通过精英买取政治稳定，以及这种做法的长期代价是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解专制政权如何通过制度性安排（如科举配额）来购买精英忠诚，并评估这种短期稳定策略的长期社会政治后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精英共选理论、政治稳定与长期代价的权衡理论、社会流动性与政治不稳定关系理论。
AI.method: 采用府级双重差分法（difference-in-differences），分析明朝1427年科举地区配额改革的影响，并将分析扩展到整个明朝时期，使用多种府级暴露测度进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 配额扩大增加了社会流动性和考试机会但降低了录取质量；额外配额被历史强府和本地精英不成比例吸收；短期内减少了精英叛乱但对农民起义影响不大；长期来看配额增加地区在明朝晚期经历了更多农民起义。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了专制国家通过制度性配额购买精英稳定的机制，并系统论证了这种短期稳定策略的长期代价——将稳定成本转移至普通民众，导致民间不稳定加剧。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史及当代社会中地域配额、精英共选等制度的短期收益与长期成本提供了实证依据，对政策制定者评估配额制度的全面影响具有启示意义。

title: The Information Gap in Food Trade Corridors

detail.title: The Information Gap in Food Trade Corridors
detail.abstract: Food trade corridors move products across jurisdictions through a chain of documentation — phytosanitary certificates, export permits, trade manifests, customs declarations, import clearances. This paper examines the structural gap between what trade documentation carries and what buyers at the destination need to understand about the product. Trade documentation confirms regulatory admissibility for movement. It does not carry producer-level product information — origin detail, production practices, compositional attributes, quality context, or health-relevant characteristics. The paper argues that product-level information is generated at source but does not travel through trade corridors in portable, reusable form.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了食品贸易走廊中文件链的结构性缺陷：现有贸易文件仅证明监管合规性，而未能携带生产者层面的产品信息（如产地、生产实践、成分、质量、健康特性），导致信息在跨境流动中丢失。
AI.research_question: 贸易文件所承载的信息与目的地买家所需了解的产品信息之间存在怎样的结构性差距？
AI.motivation: 食品贸易涉及复杂的跨境文件链，但现有文件体系仅关注监管合规，忽视了产品层面关键信息的可携带性和可复用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易文件功能理论、信息可携带性理论、跨境信息传递的结构性缺口理论
AI.method: 概念性分析/理论论证（基于对现有贸易文件体系的批判性审视）
AI.findings: 贸易文件仅确认监管可移动性，不携带生产者层面的产品信息（如产地细节、生产实践、成分属性、质量背景、健康相关特征）；产品层面信息在源头生成，但无法以可携带、可复用的形式通过贸易走廊传递。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别并理论化了贸易文件链中"信息携带"与"信息理解"之间的结构性缺口，提出产品信息生成与传递的分离问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改进食品贸易信息基础设施、设计可携带和可复用的产品信息传递机制提供了理论基础。

title: Envelopment by Multi-Product Firms in Digital Markets: A Case Study of Microsoft's 2026 Expansion of the Microsoft 365 E3 and E5 Bundles
affiliations: Tilburg Law and Economics Center (TILEC)

detail.title: Envelopment by Multi-Product Firms in Digital Markets: A Case Study of Microsoft's 2026 Expansion of the Microsoft 365 E3 and E5 Bundles
detail.abstract: This paper examines, as a case study for competition authorities and policymakers, the competitive risks raised by the conduct of multi-product dominant firms in the digital sector that progressively absorb adjacent functionalities into the bundles they already supply to enterprise customers. The strategy-sometimes described in the economic literature as envelopment-has been a recurrent feature of digital markets for more than two decades. The paper takes as its principal example the announcement, on 4 December 2025, that Microsoft will inject into its Microsoft 365 E3 and E5 enterprise productivity suites a substantial bundle of previously stand-alone, paid-for functionalities-including a remote-assistance product, advanced unified-endpoint-management features, endpoint privilege management, enterprise application management, public-key infrastructure, an email-security tier, and an AI-assisted security operations product-in exchange for an incremental price of three dollars per user per month, with effect from 1 July 2026. The paper sets out the economic mechanism by which conduct of this kind forecloses specialised singleproduct competitors, the empirical features of the market that make foreclosure particularly likely on the present facts, and the long-run consequences for competition and innovation. It identifies two analytical traps that competition authorities should expect dominant firms to exploit-the use of residual product lines to defeat coercion-based analysis, and the use of near-zero incremental cost in software markets to defeat cost-based screens.

AI.tldr: 本文以微软2025年12月宣布将多项独立付费功能捆绑进Microsoft 365 E3/E5企业套件（仅增量收费3美元/用户/月）为例，分析了数字领域多产品主导企业通过渐进吸收相邻功能（即"包络"策略）对竞争构成的威胁，阐述了该行为排挤专业单产品竞争对手的经济机制、市场特征及长期竞争与创新后果，并指出了竞争当局应警惕的两大分析陷阱。
AI.research_question: 多产品主导企业在数字领域通过将相邻功能逐步吸收进已有企业套件（包络策略）会引发哪些竞争风险？其经济机制、市场条件和长期后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字市场中多产品主导企业持续采用"包络"策略（如微软此次大规模捆绑），可能严重排挤专业单产品竞争对手，但竞争当局在反垄断分析中容易落入特定分析陷阱，因此需要系统阐明该行为的经济学机制与识别方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 包络策略（envelopment）理论；多产品市场封锁效应；杠杆理论；成本-价格挤压分析框架。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以微软2025年12月4日的产品捆绑公告为主要案例，结合经济学理论进行机制分析。
AI.findings: 1）该捆绑行为通过极低增量定价（3美元/用户/月）将大量专业功能纳入已有套件，产生显著的排他性效应；2）市场特征（如企业客户对套件的粘性、单产品供应商的脆弱性）使排挤尤为可能；3）长期会削弱专业领域创新；4）竞争当局需警惕两个分析陷阱：主导企业利用残留产品线规避"胁迫"分析，以及利用软件近零边际成本规避成本筛查。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐释了数字市场中"包络"策略的反竞争机制，并首次明确指出竞争分析中两个易被利用的陷阱（残留产品线与近零边际成本），丰富了多产品平台反垄断理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争执法机构和政策制定者提供了分析数字主导企业捆绑行为的具体框架和警示信号，有助于完善反垄断指引与执法实践。

detail.title: The Legal Aspects of Last Resort Lending

publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This chapter offers a comprehensive overview of central bank lender-of-last-resort law. It identifies eleven key elements of last-resort lending law, explains at a high level how these elements interact with one another and with other aspects of banking and finance law, and sketches the current global landscape. It then offers a history of last resort lending law, tracing its evolution around the world over the past several centuries. It concludes with a detailed case study of last resort lending law in the United States and the rise of the global dollar system, drawing on the U.S. experience to illustrate how legal design works in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文全面概述了中央银行的最后贷款人法律，识别了十一个关键要素，探讨了它们之间的相互作用及其与银行和金融法其他方面的关系，并勾勒了当前全球格局。文章追溯了过去几个世纪全球最后贷款人法律的演变历史，并以美国最后贷款人法律及全球美元体系崛起的详细案例研究作为结尾，展示了法律设计如何在实际中运作。
AI.research_question: 中央银行最后贷款人法律的关键要素是什么？这些要素如何相互作用？最后贷款人法律在全球范围内如何历史演变？法律设计在实践中如何运作？
AI.motivation: 最后贷款人制度是金融稳定的核心支柱，但其法律层面的系统性研究相对不足。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供对最后贷款人法律的全景式分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最后贷款人法律理论、金融监管法律框架、货币与银行法律理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与历史分析、比较法研究、案例研究（美国最后贷款人法律与美元体系）。
AI.findings: 识别出最后贷款人法律的十一个关键要素；揭示了这些要素与银行和金融法其他方面的互动机制；呈现了过去几个世纪全球最后贷款人法律的演变脉络；通过美国案例说明了法律设计如何支撑全球美元体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化提出了最后贷款人法律的十一个关键要素分析框架，丰富了金融法领域的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融监管者提供了最后贷款人法律设计的实践指南；通过美国案例为其他国家完善相关法律制度提供了借鉴。

title: Geographic Indication Without Disclosure Depth

detail.title: Geographic Indication Without Disclosure Depth
detail.abstract: Geographic Indication (GI) systems protect the origin name of a product but do not structure the product-level information that makes the origin meaningful. This paper examines the structural gap between GI registration and the disclosure depth buyers, institutions, and consumers need to understand what distinguishes a GI product from a non-GI alternative. The paper documents how GI protects a name while leaving practices, terroir attributes, heritage context, compositional characteristics, and production evidence unstructured and non-portable. A GI tag confirms origin jurisdiction. It does not constitute product-level disclosure.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了地理标志（GI）系统在保护产品原产地名称时，未能结构化呈现使原产地具有意义的产品层面信息，指出GI注册与消费者、机构所需的产品差异化深度信息之间存在结构性鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 地理标志（GI）系统在保护产品名称的同时，为何未能结构化披露产品层面的差异化信息？GI注册与市场所需的产品深度信息之间存在怎样的结构性鸿沟？
AI.motivation: 现有GI系统仅确认产地司法管辖，但未将产品背后的实践、风土属性、遗产背景、成分特征及生产证据等关键区分信息进行结构化整理和可移植化呈现，导致GI标签无法有效向市场传递产品级差异化信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地理标志制度理论、信息经济学中的信号传递与信息披露理论、产品质量差异化理论
AI.method: 概念性分析/理论论证（论文为概念框架性研究，通过逻辑论证揭示GI系统的结构性缺陷）
AI.findings: GI仅确认产地司法管辖，但不构成产品层面的信息披露；GI保护的是名称，而实践、风土属性、遗产背景、成分特征和生产证据等关键区分信息未被结构化，且不可移植。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统剖析了GI系统在"产地保护"与"产品信息披露"之间的结构性错位，为理解地理标志的信息经济学功能提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和从业者指出了GI系统的功能边界——GI标签不等于产品级质量信号，呼吁建立补充性的产品信息披露机制以弥补结构性鸿沟。

title: Neuroaesthetic Responses to African Textiles: Implications for Consumer Emotion and Buying Behavior in African Fashion Marketing
