title: Changing Dynamics and Travel Evading: A Case of Indian Tourists Amidst the COVID 19 Pandemic
affiliations: Amity University, University of Louisiana at Lafayette, Amity University and University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Changing Dynamics and Travel Evading: A Case of Indian Tourists Amidst the COVID 19 Pandemic

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Purpose-This study aims to analyse the factors that caused Indian tourists to avoid travelling abroad because of the recent outbreak of COVID-19 in 2020. It will also identify the relationship between the perceived risk of travelling and the probability of travel evading in India owing to COVID-19. Design/methodology/approach-This study used an online structured questionnaire to collect data from Indian tourists to study six independent variables linked with their behavioural intentions (travel evading). The health belief model was used to examine tourist behaviour. Findings-The results revealed a positive correlation between the perceived risk associated with COVID-19 and travel avoidance. Familiarity with COVID-19 was positively correlated with travel evading behaviours. Practical implications-This study will assist stakeholders from around the world to adequately identify and thoroughly plan for logistical problems associated with travel such as travel insurance and pre-travel booking expenses to reduce travel evading behaviour and promote travel. Originality/value-While a few studies have been conducted related to pandemics (Ebola, MERS-CoV, SARS), there is a paucity of literature that examines the factors which influence tourists' travel evading behaviour owing to COVID-19. Moreover, most of the previous literature on pandemics is concentrated on American and European countries, whereas studies on the Indian sub-continent are very scarce. This study will fill this gap and will identify the factors which influence tourists in India to evade travel in response to COVID-19. The full paper is available at https://doi.org/10.1108/JTF-04-2020-0061

AI.tldr: 本研究基于健康信念模型，分析印度游客因COVID-19疫情而避免出国旅游的因素，发现感知风险和对疫情的熟悉程度与旅行规避行为正相关。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素导致印度游客因2020年COVID-19疫情而避免出国旅游？感知风险与旅行规避行为之间存在什么关系？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有关于埃博拉、MERS-CoV、SARS等大流行的研究，但缺乏关于COVID-19影响游客旅行规避行为的文献；且以往研究多集中于欧美国家，对印度次大陆的研究极少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康信念模型（Health Belief Model）
AI.method: 采用在线结构化问卷调查，收集印度游客数据，研究六个自变量与行为意图（旅行规避）之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. COVID-19感知风险与旅行规避行为呈正相关；2. 对COVID-19的熟悉程度与旅行规避行为呈正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将健康信念模型应用于COVID-19背景下的旅游规避行为研究，填补了关于印度次大陆游客在大流行期间旅行决策行为的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助全球利益相关者识别和规划与旅行相关的后勤问题（如旅行保险、预订费用），以减少旅行规避行为并促进旅游出行。

title: Advancing Energy and Educational Equity in a Last-mile Andean Community

detail.title: Advancing Energy and Educational Equity in a Last-mile Andean Community
detail.abstract:
Remote Andean communities face persistent barriers to modern energy access and digital connectivity that limit instructional time, teaching practice, and student digital literacy. This case study documents a 2025 volunteer supported initiative led by Light Up the World with SAIT and NAIT to provide an integrated energy and connectivity solution for a high altitude public school in Huarcaya, Peru. A community engaged approach guided load assessment, system sizing, and installation planning. The deployment included an eighteen module 6.66 kW solar array, a 15 kWh lithium ion storage bank, three phase distribution to reduce voltage drop across dispersed buildings, campus wide LED lighting, a revitalized computer laboratory, and satellite internet backhaul. Commissioning confirmed electrical safety, load balancing, and network performance; early operation validated through onsite checks and online monitoring.

The integrated system enabled reliable daytime power, safe evening lighting, and meaningful connectivity, allowing teachers to prepare digital lessons, use multimedia instruction, and reinstate computing activities. Community members also gained new access options and modest income through a voucher based model. For volunteers, most of whom were first year students, the high altitude environment and demanding field logistics provided an authentic experiential learning context. Twelve week post return reflections demonstrated particularly high levels of teamwork, resilience, cultural empathy, identity development, and global citizenship, with strong meta cognitive awareness captured through rubric based assessments. These outcomes align with Kolb’s experiential learning cycle and underscore the value of structured pre departure preparation, on site mentorship, and delayed guided reflection. Integrating off grid solar, inclusive digital infrastructure, ethical partnership, and experiential education improved energy access and instructional capacity in a last mile setting and offers a replicable model for remote regions with strong solar resource, committed community participation, and adaptable storage pathways.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了一项2025年由Light Up the World联合SAIT和NAIT在秘鲁Huarcaya高原公立学校开展的志愿项目，通过6.66 kW太阳能阵列、15 kWh锂电池储能、卫星互联网等一体化能源与连接解决方案，解决了偏远安第斯社区的用电与数字鸿沟问题，同时为一年级志愿者提供了高海拔体验式学习环境，提升了其团队协作、韧性和全球公民意识。
AI.research_question: 在偏远安第斯高地学校中，一体化可再生能源与数字连接解决方案能否同时改善能源获取、教学能力与志愿者体验式学习成效？
AI.motivation: 偏远安第斯社区长期面临现代能源和数字连接获取障碍，限制了教学时间、教学实践和学生数字素养；同时，针对一年级学生的工程志愿项目如何在高海拔、后勤困难环境中实现有效的体验式学习，缺乏系统性案例记录。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kolb体验式学习循环理论（具体经验→反思观察→抽象概念化→主动实验）；社区参与式方法；伦理伙伴关系框架。
AI.method: 案例研究法。通过负荷评估、系统设计、安装部署、通电调试和在线监测进行技术验证；通过12周后返校反思、基于量规的评估进行志愿者学习成效测量。
AI.findings: 系统实现可靠日间供电、安全晚间照明和有效网络连接，支持教师开展数字备课、多媒体教学并恢复计算机课程；社区通过代金券模式获得新接入机会和少量收入；志愿者在团队协作、韧性、文化同理心、身份认同和全球公民意识方面表现出高水平提升，与Kolb学习循环一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了Kolb体验式学习循环在极端环境工程志愿项目中的适用性；揭示了结构化行前准备、现场指导和延迟引导性反思对体验式学习成效的关键作用；为偏远地区“能源+数字+教育”一体化干预提供了理论框架支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套可复制的偏远离网地区综合能源与数字连接解决方案（含系统设计与社区参与流程）；展示了以一年级志愿者为主力的高海拔工程项目的可行模式；提出了代金券式社区收益分享机制。

title: Buyer Precision Failure in Early-Stage Ventures: An Exploratory Taxonomic Analysis of 2,715 Documented Failures in Public Post-Mortem Data

detail.title: Buyer Precision Failure in Early-Stage Ventures: An Exploratory Taxonomic Analysis of 2,715 Documented Failures in Public Post-Mortem Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of GTM Right Limited (United Kingdom, Company No. 17222856), the company that develops and commercialises the six-stage framework analysed in this paper. This commercial interest may be perceived to have influenced the framing of the study. The empirical findings reported here are drawn from publicly available datasets named in Section 4.1 of the manuscript, and the limitations of the methodology — including single-coder coding without independent inter-coder reliability — are documented openly in Section 7. Readers should consider this declared commercial interest when evaluating the work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study analysed publicly available secondary data documenting startup failures across six existing datasets. No human subjects were interviewed, surveyed, or directly contacted as part of this research; no patient or participant data was collected. Institutional ethics approval was not required for this form of secondary-data taxonomic analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author. No external grant funding, contract research support, or institutional sponsorship was received. The author received no compensation from any third party for the analysis or its publication.

detail.abstract: This paper documents a classification gap in the public record of early-stage venture failure. Across 2,715 documented startup deaths assembled from six public datasets, representing approximately USD 660 billion in disclosed capital, only one record explicitly identifies buyer precision failure — the failure to name a specific reachable buyer with a defined trigger event and budget cycle — as the primary cause of death. This single-record figure should not be read as a count of how often buyer precision failure occurs in the underlying population of failures. It should be read as a count of how often the failure is named on the headstone. The paper proposes a six-stage framework for classifying commercial failure in early-stage ventures. The six stages — True Validation, Buyer Precision, Revenue Funnel, Buyer + Offer, Market + Funnel, and Commercial Decision — are defined operationally and applied to the master dataset. The paper defines the Stage 2 (Buyer Precision) failure mode in detail, and presents evidence — through dataset analysis and named case vignettes — that Stage 2 failures are systematically absorbed into adjacent labels in public post-mortem data, most often "no market need" (a Stage 1 label) and "bad marketing" or "bad distribution" (Stage 4 and Stage 5 labels). The paper is positioned as exploratory taxonomic analysis rather than confirmatory empirical research, and the limitations of the underlying methodology are documented openly. The intended contribution is a vocabulary correction: a category for a failure mode that occurs frequently in observed startup deaths but appears almost never in the taxonomies used to describe them.

AI.tldr: 本文发现早期创业公司死亡记录中存在一个分类缺口：在2715个公开的创业失败案例中，仅有一条记录明确将"买家精准度失败"列为主要死因。论文提出六阶段商业失败分类框架，并论证Stage 2（买家精准度）失败模式被系统性地归入相邻标签（如"无市场需求"），导致该类型失败在公共数据中几乎不可见。
AI.research_question: 在公开记录的早期创业失败案例中，"买家精准度失败"（无法识别具体的、可触及的、有触发事件和预算周期的买家）这一失败模式是否被系统性低估或错误分类？
AI.motivation: 尽管实践中观察到大量创业失败源于未能精准定位买家，但公开的失败分类体系中几乎找不到这一类别，导致创业者、投资者和政策制定者无法准确诊断失败原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 六阶段商业失败分类框架：Stage 1 真实验证（True Validation）、Stage 2 买家精准度（Buyer Precision）、Stage 3 收入漏斗（Revenue Funnel）、Stage 4 买家+产品（Buyer + Offer）、Stage 5 市场+漏斗（Market + Funnel）、Stage 6 商业决策（Commercial Decision）。
AI.method: 从六个公开数据集汇总2,715个创业死亡案例（涉及约6600亿美元已知资本），进行探索性分类分析，结合数据集统计和命名案例描述（case vignettes）进行论证。
AI.findings: 在2715个案例中，仅1例明确将买家精准度失败列为主因。Stage 2失败被系统性地吸收到相邻标签中，最常见的是被归为"无市场需求"（Stage 1标签）和"糟糕营销/分销"（Stage 4和Stage 5标签）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个更精细的创业失败分类框架（六阶段模型），揭示了现有失败分类体系中的一个系统性缺口，并提供了一个新的分析维度——买家精准度——来理解早期创业失败。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者提供了更精准的失败诊断工具，帮助识别和命名"买家精准度"这一常见但被忽视的失败模式，从而改进创业决策和投资者尽职调查。

title: From Fragmentation to Flow – a Strategic Blueprint for West Bengal Healthcare Reform

detail.title: From Fragmentation to Flow – a Strategic Blueprint for West Bengal Healthcare Reform

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no interest as its completely an independent policy blueprint study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Its a theoretical paper based on publicly available government data.
declarations.funderStatement: Self funded.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive strategic blueprint for the systemic overhaul of West Bengal’s public healthcare system, which serves a population exceeding 100 million. Diagnosing severe structural fragmentation across ten core areas—including epidemiological burden, operational workflow, and fiscal efficiency—the analysis reveals that the state's healthcare network functions as a collection of isolated administrative units rather than an integrated care continuum. It proposes a centralized-strategy, decentralized-execution Federated Operating Model managed through an independent digital monitoring framework.

AI.tldr: 本文为西孟加拉邦公共卫生系统提出了基于"联邦运营模式"的系统性改革蓝图，通过集中战略、分散执行和独立数字监控框架，解决其医疗网络的结构性碎片化问题。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地改革西孟加拉邦公共卫生系统，以解决其结构性碎片化问题并实现一体化医疗照护？
AI.motivation: 西孟加拉邦公共卫生系统存在严重的结构性碎片化，表现为医疗网络由孤立的行政单元而非一体化的照护连续体组成，亟需系统性改革方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦运营模式（Federated Operating Model）——集中战略、分散执行。
AI.method: 对流行病学负担、运营流程、财政效率等十大核心领域进行结构性碎片化诊断分析。
AI.findings: 西孟加拉邦医疗网络由相互隔离的行政单元组成，缺乏整合的照护连续体，在十大核心领域存在严重的结构性碎片化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将联邦运营模式应用到公共卫生系统改革领域，为大型公共医疗系统的碎片化问题提供了新的理论解决框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为西孟加拉邦（服务超1亿人口）的公共卫生系统提供了具体的改革蓝图，包括集中战略与分散执行相结合的管理模式，以及独立数字监控框架的实施路径。

title: Adopters as Bayesian Explorers: A Unified Model for Innovation Diffusion Dynamics
affiliations: University of Tokyo - Department of Technology Management for Innovation and University of Tokyo - Department of Technology Management for Innovation

detail.title: Adopters as Bayesian Explorers: A Unified Model for Innovation Diffusion Dynamics
detail.abstract: Despite decades of research into how new technologies and ideas permeate society, the field remains fragmented, lacking a unified framework to reconcile individual adoption behaviors with macro-scale diffusion dynamics. To address this gap, we introduce the Bayesian Exploration Adoption Model (BEAM), which conceptualizes potential adopters as boundedly rational agents operating under informational and cognitive constraints. Within this model, agents function simultaneously as active information seekers, passive receivers, and cognitive processors. We demonstrate that both classical and non-classical diffusion patterns-including standard S-shaped curves, simple and complex contagions, and the adoption "chasm"-emerge naturally from BEAM through parameter variation, without relying on phenomenon-specific, top-down assumptions. Furthermore, the model's high extensibility facilitates the disentanglement of two frequently confounded mechanisms: the network effect (the objective improvement of the new technology) and the peer effect (the subjective enhancement of its perceived value through social learning). We further demonstrate that these mechanisms can interact synergistically, complicating identification in observational data. Overall, BEAM provides a unified foundation for studying diverse innovation-diffusion dynamics and for evaluating the impacts and synergies of interventions that target distinct adoption bottlenecks, from information campaigns to financial incentives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯探索采纳模型（BEAM），将潜在采纳者视为有限理性主体，统一解释从经典S曲线到复杂扩散模式等多种创新扩散现象，并厘清网络效应与同侪效应的区别与协同作用。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一框架，调和个体采纳行为与宏观扩散动态之间的张力，并解释多样化的创新扩散模式？
AI.motivation: 现有创新扩散研究碎片化，缺乏统一框架来解释从标准S形曲线、简单/复杂传染到采纳"鸿沟"等多样化现象，且网络效应与同侪效应经常被混淆。
AI.theoretical_framework: BEAM基于贝叶斯学习理论，将潜在采纳者建模为信息和认知约束下的有限理性主体，同时扮演主动信息搜寻者、被动接收者和认知处理器三重角色。
AI.method: 通过参数变化模拟，在不依赖现象特定的自上而下假设前提下，展示BEAM如何自然生成多种经典与非经典的扩散模式。
AI.findings: （1）标准S形曲线、简单/复杂传染和采纳"鸿沟"均可通过BEAM参数变化自然涌现；（2）模型的高扩展性有助于分离网络效应（技术客观改进）与同侪效应（社会学习提升主观感知价值）；（3）两种效应可产生协同交互作用，给观察数据中的识别带来挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为创新扩散研究提供统一的理论基础，厘清网络效应与同侪效应的概念区别及其交互机制，弥合个体层面与宏观层面扩散研究的断裂。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估和设计针对不同采纳瓶颈（如信息宣传、经济激励）的干预措施提供理论工具，帮助理解不同干预手段的独立影响与协同效应。

title: The Strategic Secretary Problem
affiliations: and National University of Singapore

detail.title: The Strategic Secretary Problem
detail.abstract: In the classic secretary problem, secretaries have no decision-making agency and are assumed to arrive in a random order. Motivated by modern online labor platforms, we consider a novel variant in which secretaries are strategic agents who choose their arrival times after privately observing their own quality scores. We model the interaction between a hiring firm and N + 1 strategic secretaries as a game and characterize the structure of its equilibria. This paper addresses two main questions. First, how do strategic secretaries choose their arrival times in equilibrium? Second, does granting secretaries strategic agency improve or reduce the firm's ability to select the best candidate? We show that when the firm can commit to a hiring policy and observe secretaries' quality scores, strategic behavior can improve the firm's probability of hiring the best secretary to approximately 0.71, compared with 0.58 in the classic problem. However, when the firm cannot commit ex ante, or when the firm observes only rank-based information about applicants, the probability of hiring the best secretary under strategic arrival is the same as in the classic problem. Our analysis highlights that granting applicants greater strategic agency can improve hiring outcomes, but only when accompanied by appropriate institutional conditions. In particular, firms should strengthen their ability to commit to hiring policies and prioritize access to more accurate quality signals.

AI.tldr: 本文在经典秘书问题基础上引入策略性秘书——她们在观察自身质量分数后自主选择到达时间，构建博弈模型分析均衡结构。研究发现，当企业能够承诺招聘政策并观察到质量分数时，策略行为可将招聘到最佳候选人的概率从经典问题的0.58提升至约0.71；但若企业无法事前承诺或仅能获得排名信息，概率与经典问题无异。
AI.research_question: （1）策略性秘书在均衡中如何选择到达时间？（2）赋予秘书策略性自主权是提升还是削弱了企业选聘最佳候选人的能力？
AI.motivation: 经典秘书问题假设秘书无决策自主权且随机到达，但现代在线劳工平台（如Upwork、Freelancer）中，求职者可自主选择投递时间，因此需要重新审视策略性行为对招聘结果的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论视角下的策略性到达时间选择模型，结合经典秘书问题的最优停止理论。
AI.method: 建立N+1个策略性秘书与一家招聘企业的博弈模型，刻画均衡结构，并在不同制度条件（企业能否承诺政策、能否观察质量分数 vs. 仅观察排名）下推导招聘概率的解析结果。
AI.findings: （1）当企业可承诺招聘政策并观察质量分数时，策略性行为将招聘最佳候选人的概率从0.58提升至约0.71；（2）当企业无法事前承诺或仅能观察排名信息时，策略性到达下的招聘概率与经典问题相同。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经典秘书问题拓展至策略性主体情境，构建了内生化到达时间的博弈模型，揭示了策略性自主权改善招聘效果所需的条件边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线劳工平台和招聘企业提供管理启示：应加强承诺招聘政策的能力，并优先获取更精确的求职者质量信号，以充分利用申请者策略性行为带来的招聘改善潜力。

title: Misvaluing Time: Salvage Modeling and Lead-Time Decisions
affiliations: Aalto University, National Chengchi University (NCCU), Ningbo China Institute for Supply Chain Innovation and University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: Misvaluing Time: Salvage Modeling and Lead-Time Decisions
detail.abstract: The assumption that the value of unsold goods at the end of a demand period is constant is widespread in inventory theory. It is common, for example, to assume that a fashion product can be liquidated at a constant salvage value if still in inventory when the demand period has ended. We show that, under general mathematical conditions, this modeling assumption will cause companies to underestimate both the value of lead-time reduction and the cost of lead time increases. Assuming a constant residual value in an environment where salvage values are allowed to depend on the amount of overage will systematically bias the value of lead time negatively.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，库存理论中普遍假设需求期末未售出商品的残余价值恒定，会导致企业系统性地低估缩短提前期的价值，也低估提前期延长的成本。当残余价值实际取决于超量库存时，这种恒定残余价值假设会对提前期的价值产生负向偏差。
AI.research_question: 恒定残余价值假设如何影响企业对提前期价值（包括缩短和延长）的评估？
AI.motivation: 库存理论中广泛假设未售出商品的价值恒定（如时尚产品在期末以固定残值清算），但这种假设可能不切实际，因为残余价值通常取决于超量库存的数量。作者想要揭示这种假设偏差对提前期估值的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 库存理论、残余价值依赖库存超量的数学模型、提前期价值评估偏差分析。
AI.method: 数学建模与理论分析，在一般数学条件下推导恒定残余价值假设与残余价值依赖库存超量情形下的提前期价值差异。
AI.findings: 在一般数学条件下，恒定残余价值假设会导致企业对缩短提前期的价值和延长提前期的成本都系统性低估；当实际残余价值随超量库存变化时，该假设会对提前期价值产生负向偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了库存理论中一个常见假设（恒定残余价值）的重要偏差，为更准确的提前期价值评估提供了理论纠正依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒企业在评估供应链提前期的经济价值时，应考虑残余价值随超量库存变化的实际情况，避免因错误假设导致投资决策偏差（如低估缩短提前期的收益）。

title: Decarbonising General Practice: Identifying System-Level Conditions for Sustained Change
affiliations: University of Warwick, University of Warwick, University of Warwick and

detail.title: Decarbonising General Practice: Identifying System-Level Conditions for Sustained Change

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval:
The study received ethical approval from the Health Research Authority and Health and Care Research Wales (IRAS
446 ID 327991; REC reference 23/PR/1169).
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR) Health and Social Care Delivery Research Programme (HSDR) award ID: NIHR53231.

detail.abstract:
Background: Decarbonisation of healthcare is a strategic priority in the UK, yet little is known about the system-level mechanisms that enable sustainability initiatives to become embedded within non-hospital settings. This paper reports the integrative synthesis from the GPNET-0 study, explaining how decarbonisation actions are mobilised, sustained, or displaced in general practice.

Methods: We conducted a theory-informed synthesis across qualitative, survey, and economic strands of a multi-level mixed-methods study.  A structured analytic matrix was used to integrate 174 discrete findings.  Realist logic guided development of explanatory configurations linking institutional conditions, organisational processes, and implementation outcomes.  Configurations were refined into programme theory testable statements. 

Findings: Across 17 explanatory configurations, decarbonisation was shaped less by individual attitudes than by interacting structural mechanisms.  Three mechanisms consistently underpinned implementation: legitimacy (clear policy signals and leadership endorsement), system-level alignment (coherence between national, regional, and practice-level governance), and workability (integration under constrained capacity).  Actions framed as discretionary, champion-led, or additive to existing workload were repeatedly displaced.  By contrast, initiatives embedded within governance expectations and aligned with routine practice processes were more likely to be sustained and normalised.

Interpretation: Decarbonisation in general practice is not primarily a behavioural challenge, but a structural implementation problem. Sustained change depends on institutional embedding, governance, coherence, and operational feasibility within everyday practice environments.  The programme theory presented here provides a system-level explanatory framework to inform future implementation strategies and empirical testing in general practice.

AI.tldr: 本文通过GPNET-0研究的综合整合，揭示了全科医疗脱碳行动的系统层面机制。研究发现，脱碳的实施并非主要受个体态度影响，而是受合法性、系统一致性及可操作性三种结构性机制驱动。那些被视为可自由裁量、依赖个别带头人、或增加工作负担的行动往往难以持续，而嵌入治理预期并与常规工作流程一致的措施更易被制度化。
AI.research_question: 全科医疗中脱碳行动如何被动员、维持或被替代？哪些系统层面的机制使可持续举措得以嵌入非医院环境中？
AI.motivation: 尽管英国医疗系统脱碳是战略优先事项，但关于非医院环境中系统级机制如何使可持续举措得以嵌入的知识仍然匮乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现实主义逻辑（Realist logic）指导下的项目理论（Programme theory），关注制度条件、组织过程与实施结果之间的解释性配置关系。
AI.method: 多层面混合方法研究的理论指导综合整合，涵盖定性、调查和经济三个分支，采用结构化分析矩阵整合174个离散发现，通过现实主义逻辑开发解释性配置并完善为项目理论可检验陈述。
AI.findings: 识别出三种关键实施机制：合法性（明确的政策信号和领导背书）、系统一致性（国家、区域与诊所层面治理的连贯性）以及可操作性（在有限能力下的整合）。被框定为可自由裁量、依赖带头人、或附加于现有工作量的行动反复被替代，而嵌入治理预期并与常规流程一致的举措更易持续和正常化。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文通过提出系统层面的解释性框架，将脱碳挑战从个体行为问题重新概念化为结构性实施问题，阐明了制度嵌入、治理连贯性与操作可行性在可持续变革中的理论作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全科医疗脱碳提供了可检验的项目理论，指导未来实施策略的制定；明确了政策制定者应通过制度嵌入和治理一致性而非依赖个体倡导来推动可持续变革。

title: Language, Power and Regional Recognition: Ashutosh Mukhopadhyay, the University of Calcutta and the Campaign for Vernacular Higher Education in Colonial India
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Language, Power and Regional Recognition: Ashutosh Mukhopadhyay, the University of Calcutta and the Campaign for Vernacular Higher Education in Colonial India
detail.abstract: Between 1906 and 1923, Ashutosh Mukhopadhyay served five terms as Vice-Chancellor of the University of Calcutta, using those years to achieve what earlier generations had failed to accomplish: the sustained institutional recognition of Bengali, Assamese, Odia and Urdu across every level of the university curriculum, from matriculation to the postgraduate degree. Drawing on convocation addresses, commission reports and contemporaneous biographical accounts, this article argues that Mukhopadhyay’s campaign constituted a deliberate form of cultural nationalism pursued not through confrontation but through institutional strategy. The article situates this campaign against the progressive exclusion of modern Indian languages from the curriculum after 1868, the resistance of the colonial establishment, and the strategic use of the Raleigh Commission (1902) and University Act of 1904. Particular attention is given to the Assamese case and the commissioning of the Anthology of Assamese Literature (Axomiya Sahityar Xaneki), whose significance for the historiography of Indian language rights and regional cultural identity has not previously been assessed for an international readership. The article introduces the concept of institutional nationalism — the pursuit of nationalist cultural objectives through patient reform of inherited colonial structures — as an analytical frame for understanding Mukhopadhyay’s approach, and concludes that his multilingual educational vision anticipated the constitutional and institutional settlements of independent India in ways existing scholarship has not adequately recognised. In tracing this history, the article speaks to questions that remain unresolved across South Asia: who decides which languages belong in a university, and by what institutional means can that decision be contested and changed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究阿舒托什·穆克帕迪亚在1906-1923年间担任加尔各答大学副校长时，通过制度策略而非对抗手段，将孟加拉语、阿萨姆语、奥里亚语和乌尔都语纳入大学课程体系，提出"制度民族主义"概念以分析其多语教育愿景如何预示了独立印度的制度安排。
AI.research_question: 穆克帕迪亚如何通过制度策略推动印度本土语言进入大学课程体系？其多语教育愿景对独立印度的制度安排有何预示意义？
AI.motivation: 既有研究对穆克帕迪亚的语言政策贡献认识不足，且其推动阿萨姆语文学选集编纂的历史意义尚未被国际学术界充分评估。此外，南亚地区关于"谁决定大学使用何种语言"的问题至今未解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度民族主义（institutional nationalism）——通过耐心改革继承下来的殖民结构来追求民族主义文化目标。
AI.method: 历史档案分析，涉及毕业典礼演讲、委员会报告及同时代传记资料。
AI.findings: 穆克帕迪亚通过制度策略（而非对抗）成功将多种印度本土语言纳入大学教育体系；其多语教育愿景预示了独立后印度的语言制度安排；阿萨姆语文学选集的编纂对印度语言权利史学具有重要但未被充分认识的意义。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"制度民族主义"概念，为理解殖民时期通过制度内改革实现民族主义目标提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当今南亚关于大学语言政策的争议提供了历史借鉴，揭示了通过制度手段可以如何挑战和改变语言决策。

reference: NBER Working Paper No. w35291
title: Incentives, Evidence, and Reminders for Bureaucrats: Overcoming Barriers to Policy Scale Up
affiliations: Stockholm School of Economics, Tecnologico de Monterrey, Yale University, Columbia University and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Incentives, Evidence, and Reminders for Bureaucrats: Overcoming Barriers to Policy Scale Up

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Scaling up effective policies often requires the attention of frontline bureaucrats with many competing responsibilities. Even when policymakers adopt effective programs, implementation may not follow. In a nationwide experiment in the Dominican Republic, we test interventions to increase school principals' implementation of an educational program proven effective in a previous RCT. Only 37% of control schools verifiably implemented the intervention when ordered to by the Ministry of Education, compared with 83% in the original trial. Implementation was no higher among schools that previously implemented the program in the RCT, suggesting that fixed costs of adoption do not explain non-adoption. We find precise null effects of sharing research evidence, providing modest financial incentives, or offering implementation assistance to principals. In contrast, additional reminder calls increased implementation by 20 percentage points. A second experiment targeting a different mandated program yields the same pattern: reminders produce large effects, while monitoring messages have smaller effects. Our findings point to limited attention among bureaucrats as an important barrier to scaling policies.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 在多米尼加共和国的一项全国性实验中，研究发现即使政策被证明有效，一线官僚（校长）因注意力有限，执行率仅为37%。提供研究证据、小额激励或实施帮助均无效，而额外的提醒电话使执行率提升20个百分点。提醒策略在另一项不同政策的实验中同样有效，表明注意力限制是政策大规模推广的主要障碍。
AI.research_question: 为什么已被随机对照试验证明有效的教育政策在规模化推广时执行率大幅下降？如何提高一线官僚（校长）的政策执行率？
AI.motivation: 尽管有效的政策（如基于RCT的教育项目）已被识别，但在真实大规模推广中执行率极低（仅37%），与原始试验的83%形成鲜明对比。需要识别阻碍政策规模化的具体机制和有效干预手段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力经济学——一线官僚面临多重竞争性职责，有限的注意力是影响政策执行的关键瓶颈，而非固定采纳成本或激励不足。
AI.method: 全国性随机对照实验（RCT），包含两个子实验：实验1测试分享研究证据、小额财务激励、实施协助、提醒电话等干预措施对校长执行已证明有效的教育项目的影响；实验2在同一背景下测试提醒消息与监控消息对另一项不同政策执行率的影响。
AI.findings: （1）仅有37%的对照学校按教育部要求执行了项目，远低于原始RCT的83%；（2）先前在RCT中参与执行的学校并未表现出更高的执行率，说明固定采纳成本不是主要障碍；（3）分享研究证据、小额激励、实施协助均无显著效果；（4）额外的提醒电话使执行率提高20个百分点；（5）在第二个实验中，提醒产生较大效果，监控消息效果较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别出注意力限制（而非经济激励或信息不足）是政策规模化过程中一线官僚执行失败的核心机制，丰富了注意力经济学在公共政策执行领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了低成本、可规模化的政策执行促进策略——简单的提醒电话即可显著提升执行率，而昂贵的激励或研究证据传播未必有效。
